endogenous_note: Your cells make NMN themselves every day as the middle step of the NAD+ salvage pathway: NAMPT joins nicotinamide to a sugar phosphate (5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate) to form NMN, and NMNAT enzymes then convert NMN into NAD+. There is no dietary requirement for NMN at any intake, and NAMPT is feedback inhibited by nicotinamide, NAD+ and ATP (PMID 36746631), so the loop is actively regulated at the exact step the supplement targets. The implication for a buyer is blunt: the product is an internal intermediate of a self-regulating pathway, and the only genuine dietary need upstream of it is the ordinary niacin r ...
endogenous_note_zh: 细胞每天自己合成 NMN, 它是 NAD+ 补救合成通路的中间步骤: NAMPT 把 nicotinamide 与磷酸糖 (5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate) 连接成 NMN, 再由 NMNAT 系列酶把 NMN 转成 NAD+。任何摄入水平下都不存在 NMN 的膳食需要量, 而 NAMPT 受 nicotinamide、NAD+ 和 ATP 的反馈抑制 (PMID 36746631), 补充剂瞄准的正是这个被主动调控的步骤。对购买者的含义很直接: 这个产品是一条自我调节通路的内部中间物, 它上游唯一真实的膳食需求是每日 14 到 16 mg NE 的常规烟酸需要量, 普通饮食已经覆盖。算一下更清楚: 仅靠色氨酸提供 16 mg NE 需要约 960 mg 色氨酸, 而每日 60 到 80 g 蛋白质的常规摄入能提供数倍于此的量。NMN、nicotinami ...
pathway: Nicotinamide + 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate to NMN by NAMPT (rate-limiting; feedback inhibited by nicotinamide, NAD+ and ATP, PMID 36746631); nicotinamide riboside to NMN by NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2); NMN to NAD+ by NMNAT1 (nucleus), NMNAT2 (cytosol/Golgi) and NMNAT3, textbook-assigned to mitochondria. That last assignment is outdated: NMNA ...

daily_amount_zh: 内源性 NMN 自身的生成速率 NOT ESTABLISHED, 人体全身 NAD 合成速率也没有测定值, 部分原因在于供给只有对照 PARPs、sirtuins、CD38 和 SARM1 的消耗才有意义。有来源的参照值: 烟酸 RDA 男性 16 mg NE/day, 女性 14 mg NE/day, 膳食色氨酸 6 ...
still_matters_when: Genuine niacin deficiency states (pellagra, chronic alcohol use, isoniazid therapy, Hartnup disease, carcinoid), where plain nicotinamide or nicotinic acid at vitamin doses is the established and far cheaper correction. Inborn errors of NAD synthesis (HAAO, KYNU, NADSYN1) are a separate clinical situation. Pharmacological NAD raising in ageing or metabolic disease remains experimental and is not a ...
still_matters_when_zh: 真正的烟酸缺乏状态 (pellagra、长期饮酒、isoniazid 治疗、Hartnup 病、类癌), 此时用维生素剂量的 nicotinamide 或 nicotinic acid 是既成熟又便宜得多的纠正办法。NAD 合成的先天性缺陷 (HAAO、KYNU、NADSYN1) 属于另一类临床情形。在衰老或代谢病中用药理手段提升 NAD 仍属实验性质, 不能作为补足缺乏的理由。

endogenous_note: NR is also an internal NAD intermediate: the body generates it by stripping the phosphate off NMN using CD73 and alkaline phosphatases, and it circulates in human blood and appears in milk without anyone supplementing. The first-pass finding that oral NR is mostly broken down to nicotinamide in the liver comes from mouse tracer work (PMID 27721479 mouse arm; PMID 29685734 in C57BL/6 mice), so the species label matters; the human evidence is pharmacokinetic. Supplementing does raise blood NAD metabolites measurably, which makes NR a real pharmacological agent, and it still does not correct any deficiency in a pers ...
endogenous_note_zh: NR 同样是体内的 NAD 中间物: 机体通过 CD73 和碱性磷酸酶把 NMN 上的磷酸去掉来生成它, 在无人补充的情况下它也存在于人血液循环并出现在乳汁中。口服 NR 在肝脏首过时大部分被降解为 nicotinamide, 这一结论来自小鼠示踪研究 (PMID 27721479 的小鼠部分; PMID 29685734 使用 C57BL/6 小鼠), 因此物种标注很重要; 人体证据属于药代动力学层面。补充确实能可测量地提高血中 NAD 代谢物, 这使 NR 成为一种真实的药理制剂, 但对饮食正常的人它并不纠正任何缺乏。NR、NMN、nicotinamide 和 nicotinic acid 都汇入同一个 NAD 池, 其中两种维生素形式的价格只有它的零头。
pathway: NR to NMN by nicotinamide riboside kinases NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2), then NMN to NAD+ by NMNAT1-3. NR is formed endogenously by dephosphorylation of NMN (NT5E/CD73, alkaline phosphatases) and degraded to nicotinamide by purine nucleoside phosphorylase. The Preiss-Handler route runs in parallel and is what makes the trial's biomarker interpreta ...

daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED for endogenous NR turnover. Sourced anchors: niacin requirement 14 to 16 mg NE/day (IOM 1998); in human dosing, a single-subject pilot showed blood NAD+ rising up to 2.7-fold after one oral NR dose, and t ...
daily_amount_zh: 内源性 NR 周转量 NOT ESTABLISHED。有来源的参照值: 烟酸需要量 14 到 16 mg NE/day (IOM 1998); 在人体给药中, 一项单个受试者的先导研究显示单次口服 NR 后血 NAD+ 最高升高 2.7 倍, 而首个正式药代动力学试验 (100、300 和 1,000 mg) 显示血中 ...
still_matters_when: The same niacin deficiency and inborn-error settings listed for NMN, where vitamin-dose nicotinamide is the standard fix. Beyond that, use rests on clinical trial endpoints for a named condition, since there is no NR deficiency state to treat.
still_matters_when_zh: 与 NMN 条目所列相同的烟酸缺乏和先天性缺陷情形, 此时维生素剂量的 nicotinamide 是标准处理。除此之外, 使用只能依据针对具体疾病的临床试验终点, 因为并不存在需要治疗的 NR 缺乏状态。
source: PMID 27721479 (Trammell et al., Nat Commun 2016;7:12948; 2.7-fold rise from a single-subject pilot, mouse arm for oral-versus-intravenous handling); PMID 296857 ...

endogenous_note: Resveratrol is a plant stress compound, a stilbene assembled by stilbene synthase from 4-coumaroyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA in grapevine, peanut and Polygonum. Humans have no stilbene synthase and no phenylpropanoid pathway at all, so every molecule in the body arrived from food or a capsule. That means the endogenous axis gives resveratrol no free pass and no handicap: the whole case has to rest on clinical outcomes, and the practical obstacle is that absorbed resveratrol is conjugated almost immediately.
endogenous_note_zh: 白藜芦醇是植物的应激化合物, 属于芪类, 在葡萄藤、花生和 Polygonum 中由 stilbene synthase 以 4-coumaroyl-CoA 和 malonyl-CoA 为底物组装而成。人体既没有 stilbene synthase, 也完全没有 phenylpropanoid 通路, 所以体内的每一个分子都来自食物或胶囊。内源性这一维度对白藜芦醇既不加分也不减分: 全部论证只能落在临床结局上, 而现实障碍是被吸收的白藜芦醇几乎立刻被结合代谢。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant route only: phenylalanine to 4-coumaroyl-CoA via phenylalanine ammonia-lyase and downstream enzymes, then condensation with three malonyl-CoA by stilbene synthase. No human homologue of any step exists.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。只有植物途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 及下游酶生成 4-coumaroyl-CoA, 再由 stilbene synthase 与三个 malonyl-CoA 缩合。上述任何步骤在人体内都没有同源物。
daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans possess no biosynthetic route to resveratrol.
daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有合成白藜芦醇的途径。
still_matters_when: Only where trial evidence supports a defined endpoint. Bioavailability is the binding constraint: absorption of a dietary-relevant 25 mg oral dose was at least 70% in 6 volunteers, with peak plasma resveratrol plus metabolites at 491 +/- 90 ng/mL (about 2 micromol/L), yet only trace unchanged resveratrol was detectable (under 5 ng/mL) because of rapid glucuronidation and sulfation. Typical supplem ...
still_matters_when_zh: 仅在有试验证据支持某个明确终点时才有意义。生物利用度是决定性约束: 在 6 名志愿者中, 与膳食水平相当的 25 mg 口服剂量吸收率至少为 70%, 血浆中白藜芦醇及其代谢物峰值为 491 +/- 90 ng/mL (约 2 micromol/L), 但由于快速葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化, 只能检出痕量的未变化白藜芦醇 (低于 5 ng/mL)。常见补充剂剂量为 100 到 500 mg, 该剂量下的吸收比例尚未确立。
source: PMID 15333514 (Walle et al., Drug Metab Dispos 2004;32:1377-1382; 25 mg dose, n=6)

endogenous_note: Spermidine synthase builds spermidine from putrescine plus an aminopropyl group donated by decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine, with ornithine decarboxylase as the tightly regulated rate-limiting entry step; arginine decarboxylase plus agmatinase (AGMAT) provide a second, agmatine-derived route into the putrescine pool. Cells hold polyamines at high micromolar to millimolar concentrations, recycle them continuously through SSAT and polyamine oxidases, and also absorb polyamines produced by gut bacteria. How that supply splits between host synthesis, diet and microbiota has never been quantified in humans, so no c ...
endogenous_note_zh: Spermidine synthase 以 putrescine 加上由脱羧 S-adenosylmethionine 提供的氨丙基合成亚精胺, ornithine decarboxylase 是受严格调控的限速起始步骤; arginine decarboxylase 加 agmatinase (AGMAT) 构成另一条经 agmatine 进入 putrescine 池的途径。细胞把多胺维持在高微摩尔到毫摩尔浓度, 通过 SSAT 和多胺氧化酶持续回收, 也吸收肠道细菌产生的多胺。这一供给在宿主合成、膳食和菌群之间如何分配, 在人体中从未被定量, 因此无法断言哪个来源占主导。读者可以把亚精胺理解为机体按需制造并双向调节的物质, 因此对一个稳态系统施加固定日剂量是个别扭的干预。此处的 FULL 标签只针对宿主通路; 微生物来源单独计算, 同一标准也用于 urolithin A, 该条目对宿 ...

still_matters_when: Inherited polyamine pathway disorders such as spermine synthase loss in Snyder-Robinson syndrome, which oral polyamines do not correct. Otherwise only trial-supported endpoints, and the human data are observational (all-cause mortality fell across thirds of increasing dietary spermidine, fully adjusted HR 0.76 per 1-SD, 95% CI 0.67 to 0.86, P < 0.001; the paper translated top versus bottom third a ...
still_matters_when_zh: 遗传性多胺通路疾病, 例如 Snyder-Robinson 综合征中的 spermine synthase 缺失, 口服多胺并不能纠正。除此之外只看试验支持的终点, 而现有人体数据是观察性的 (随膳食亚精胺三分位升高, 全因死亡率下降, 完全校正后每 1-SD 的 HR 为 0.76, 95% CI 0.67 到 0.86, P < 0.001; 该论文把最高与最低三分位之间的差异折算为相当于 5.7 年, 3.6 到 8.1 年的年龄差)。也要注意相反的策略同样在研究中, 多胺耗竭是一种癌症化学预防思路, 因此摄入越多并不自动越好。
source: PMID 27268251 (Pegg, J Biol Chem 2016;291:14904-14912); PMID 21249159 (Atiya Ali et al., Food Nutr Res 2011;55:5572, Swedish food analyses); PMID 29955838 (Kiec ...

endogenous_note: Every human cell makes ubiquinone on the mevalonate pathway, attaching a decaprenyl tail made by PDSS1/PDSS2 to a 4-hydroxybenzoate ring via COQ2, then finishing the molecule with the COQ3 to COQ9 enzymes and reducing it to ubiquinol. Diet supplies only 3 to 5 mg a day, a small contribution next to the tissue pools that endogenous synthesis maintains, so a healthy person is not short of CoQ10. This is the clearest case in the group of a supplement filling a gap that does not exist. The statin link is real at the level of plasma measurement, where CoQ10 falls by about 0.44 micromol/L on treatment, and its interpre ...
endogenous_note_zh: 人体每个细胞都通过 mevalonate 通路合成泛醌, 由 PDSS1/PDSS2 制造癸异戊烯基尾链, 经 COQ2 接到 4-hydroxybenzoate 环上, 再由 COQ3 至 COQ9 一系列酶完成分子并还原为泛醇。膳食每天只提供 3 到 5 mg, 相对于内源合成维持的组织池只是很小的一部分, 因此健康人并不缺 CoQ10。在这一组条目中, 它最清楚地展示了一种补充剂在填补并不存在的缺口。他汀的关联在血浆测量层面确实存在, 治疗后 CoQ10 下降约 0.44 micromol/L, 但解读受限: 血浆 CoQ10 由 LDL 携带, 因此下降的一部分只是跟随载脂蛋白浓度的下降, 而组织或肌肉 CoQ10 耗竭尚未被证明。他汀确实抑制共用的 mevalonate 通路, 而这一机制并不是那项血浆水平荟萃分析所测量的内容。无论如何, 这里都没有暴露出任何膳食缺乏。

daily_amount_zh: 人体内源合成速率 NOT ESTABLISHED。有来源的对照数据: 膳食平均摄入 3-5 mg/day, 其中约 64% 来自肉类和禽类, 油炸破坏 14-32%, 水煮未检出破坏; 在 8 个汇总的安慰剂对照治疗组中, 他汀治疗使血浆 CoQ10 相对安慰剂降低 -0.44 micromol/L (95% CI - ...
still_matters_when: Primary CoQ10 deficiency caused by COQ2, COQ4, COQ8B, PDSS1 or PDSS2 mutations, where high-dose supplementation is standard care and early treatment matters. Also specific secondary deficiencies in mitochondrial disease, and clinician-supervised trials of statin-associated muscle symptoms, where results remain inconsistent.
still_matters_when_zh: 由 COQ2、COQ4、COQ8B、PDSS1 或 PDSS2 突变引起的原发性 CoQ10 缺乏, 此时高剂量补充是标准治疗, 且早期治疗很重要。此外还包括线粒体病中的特定继发性缺乏, 以及在临床医生监督下针对他汀相关肌肉症状的试验, 这类结果仍不一致。

endogenous_note: Human mitochondria make lipoic acid de novo: an octanoyl chain from the mitochondrial fatty acid synthase route is transferred onto a lysine residue of the target protein, and lipoyl synthase (LIAS) then inserts two sulfur atoms while the chain is already attached. The functional cofactor pool is protein-bound R-lipoyllysine on pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, BCKDH and the glycine cleavage H protein, and free lipoate is not a physiological cofactor form. It is wrong to say lipoate is never released: mammalian lipoamidase, the same protein as serum biotinidase, hydrolyses lipoyl substrat ...
endogenous_note_zh: 人体线粒体能从头合成硫辛酸: 来自线粒体脂肪酸合成途径的辛酰基链先被转移到靶蛋白的赖氨酸残基上, 随后 lipoyl synthase (LIAS) 在链已连接的状态下插入两个硫原子。具有功能的辅因子池是结合在 pyruvate dehydrogenase、alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase、BCKDH 和甘氨酸裂解系统 H 蛋白上的蛋白结合型 R-lipoyllysine, 游离硫辛酸并非生理性的辅因子形式。说硫辛酸从不被释放是错的: 哺乳动物 lipoamidase 与血清 biotinidase 是同一个蛋白, 能水解 lipoyl 底物 (PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462), 该活性存在于人血清和乳汁中 (PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386), 大鼠肝和肾也能水解 lipoyllysine 本身 (PMID 79 ...

LIAS activity depends on iron-sulfur cluster assembly machinery (NFU1, ...

Inherited LIAS, LIPT1 and LIPT2 defects, and the Fe-S cluster defects (NFU1, BOLA3, GLRX5) that cause the same lipoylation failure, produce severe multisystem disease. In patient fibroblasts, treatment with lipoate and  ...

endogenous_note: Dimethyl sulfone is a normal trace constituent of human blood and cerebrospinal fluid in people taking no supplement, measured at 0 to 25 micromol/L. Host enzymes do produce it: thiol S-methyltransferase methylates methanethiol to dimethyl sulfide, and flavin-containing monooxygenases oxidise that to DMSO and then to dimethyl sulfone. What is not endogenous is the precursor supply, which comes mostly from bacterial methionine catabolism in the gut and from diet, and no human enzyme has MSM as its designated end product. endogenous_note_zh: 二甲基砜是未服用任何补充剂的人血液和脑脊液中的正常微量成分, 实测浓度为 0 到 25 micromol/L。宿主的酶确实会生成它: thiol S-methyltransferase 把甲硫醇甲基化为二甲基硫, flavin-containing monooxygenases 再把它氧化为 DMSO, 进而氧化为二甲基砜。不属于内源的是前体供给, 它主要来自肠道细菌的 methionine 分解代谢和膳食, 而且没有任何人体酶以 MSM 作为其指定终产物。它没有需要量, 没有缺乏状态, 也没有已知生理功能, 因此内源性这一维度提供不了补足缺乏的理由: 没有东西需要补足, 任何主张只能依靠症状学试验。
pathway: No dedicated human biosynthetic pathway, though the terminal oxidation steps are host-catalysed. Methanethiol comes mainly from bacterial methionine catabolism in the gut and from the methionine transamination route; host thiol S-methyltransferase activity yields dimethyl sulfide, and further oxidation by flavin-containing monooxygenases  ...
pathway_zh: 人体没有专门的生物合成通路, 不过最后的氧化步骤由宿主酶催化。甲硫醇主要来自肠道细菌的 methionine 分解代谢和 methionine 转氨途径; 宿主 thiol S-methyltransferase 活性生成二甲基硫, 再经 flavin-containing monooxygenases 进一步氧化为 DMSO, 随后为二甲基砜。膳食是另一个来源。在 4 名重度 methionine adenosyltransferase I/III 缺乏症患者中有 3 名, ...
daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED. Only circulating concentrations are documented: 0 to 25 micromol/L in plasma and CSF of healthy unsupplemented controls, against gram-scale supplement doses.
daily_amount_zh: NOT ESTABLISHED。已记录的只有循环浓度: 未补充的健康对照者血浆和脑脊液为 0 到 25 micromol/L, 而补充剂剂量在克级。
still_matters_when: Nothing on a repletion basis, because no requirement or deficiency exists. Use would have to rest on trial evidence for a specific symptom, and the usual claim (osteoarthritis pain) comes from small short trials.
still_matters_when_zh: 从补足缺乏的角度没有任何适用情形, 因为既无需要量也无缺乏状态。使用只能依据针对具体症状的试验证据, 而常见的主张 (骨关节炎疼痛) 来自规模小、周期短的试验。
source: PMID 15996001 (Engelke et al., NMR Biomed 2005;18:331-336; MAT I/III finding in 3 of 4 patients)

endogenous_note: Astaxanthin is a ketocarotenoid produced by microalgae such as Haematococcus pluvialis and by some bacteria and yeasts, using a beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) plus a hydroxylase (CrtZ). Humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever and cannot convert beta-carotene into astaxanthin. Salmon and shrimp are pink from the astaxanthin in their food; they do not make it either. Everything in a human body reflects intake, there is no deficiency state to correct, and astaxanthin has no provitamin A activity to fall back on, so the supplement stands or falls on trial results.
endogenous_note_zh: 虾青素是一种酮式类胡萝卜素, 由 Haematococcus pluvialis 等微藻以及部分细菌和酵母利用 beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) 加羟化酶 (CrtZ) 生成。人体完全不合成任何类胡萝卜素, 也无法把 beta-carotene 转成虾青素。三文鱼和虾之所以呈粉色, 来自其食物中的虾青素, 它们自己也不合成。人体内的全部虾青素都反映摄入量, 没有需要纠正的缺乏状态, 而虾青素也没有维生素 A 原活性可以退守, 因此这种补充剂的成败完全取决于试验结果。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Algal and microbial route: beta-carotene to echinenone to canthaxanthin by BKT/CrtW ketolase, with CrtZ/CrtR-b hydroxylation to adonirubin and astaxanthin. No human homologue of any step.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。藻类和微生物途径: beta-carotene 经 BKT/CrtW 酮化酶生成 echinenone, 再生成 canthaxanthin, 并由 CrtZ/CrtR-b 羟化生成 adonirubin 和虾青素。上述任何步骤在人体内都没有同源物。
daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway.
daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路。
still_matters_when: Only where trial evidence supports a defined endpoint. With no requirement and no deficiency state, dose selection is entirely empirical.
still_matters_when_zh: 仅在有试验证据支持某个明确终点时才有意义。既没有需要量也没有缺乏状态, 剂量选择完全是经验性的。
source: PMID 24402174 (Ambati et al., Mar Drugs 2014;12:128-152)

endogenous_note: Curcuminoids are plant polyketides: Curcuma longa builds them from feruloyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA using two type III polyketide synthases, diketide-CoA synthase and curcumin synthase. Humans have no phenylpropanoid pathway and no type III polyketide synthase, so curcumin is a xenobiotic the body can only absorb, conjugate and clear. Endogenous synthesis is irrelevant to the buying decision here, and the operative limit is pharmacokinetic: oral curcumin is glucuronidated and sulfated so fast that free plasma concentrations stay very low.
endogenous_note_zh: 姜黄素类是植物聚酮化合物: Curcuma longa 以 feruloyl-CoA 和 malonyl-CoA 为底物, 通过两种 III 型聚酮合酶 (diketide-CoA synthase 和 curcumin synthase) 合成。人体没有 phenylpropanoid 通路, 也没有 III 型聚酮合酶, 因此姜黄素是一种外源物, 机体只能吸收、结合和清除。内源合成与这里的购买决策无关, 真正起作用的限制是药代动力学: 口服姜黄素被葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化的速度极快, 游离血浆浓度始终很低。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant route only: phenylalanine through phenylalanine ammonia-lyase to feruloyl-CoA, then DCS and CURS type III polyketide synthases in Curcuma longa rhizome.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。只有植物途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 生成 feruloyl-CoA, 随后在 Curcuma longa 根茎中由 DCS 和 CURS 两种 III 型聚酮合酶完成合成。
daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans have no biosynthetic route to curcuminoids.
daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有合成姜黄素类的途径。
still_matters_when: Only on trial evidence for a specific indication, with attention to the formulation used in that trial, since plain extract is poorly bioavailable, and to interactions through CYP and UGT pathways for anyone on prescription medicines.
still_matters_when_zh: 只能依据针对具体适应症的试验证据, 同时要注意该试验所用的制剂形式 (普通提取物生物利用度很低), 以及对正在服用处方药的人经 CYP 和 UGT 通路产生的相互作用。
source: PMID 19258320 (Katsuyama et al., J Biol Chem 2009;284:11160-11170)

endogenous_note: EGCG is a galloylated flavan-3-ol built in the tea plant by the shikimate and phenylpropanoid pathways plus chalcone synthase, with a dedicated epicatechin galloyltransferase adding the gallate group. Humans have none of those enzymes, starting with phenylalanine ammonia-lyase, so intake is the only source and no deficiency exists. On this axis EGCG is optional by definition, which shifts the whole question onto trial benefit and onto safety, where concentrated catechin extracts carry a documented liver injury signal that brewed tea does not.
endogenous_note_zh: EGCG 是一种没食子酰化的黄烷-3-醇, 在茶树中由莽草酸通路、phenylpropanoid 通路以及 chalcone synthase 合成, 并由专门的 epicatechin galloyltransferase 加上没食子酰基。人体从 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 起就没有这些酶, 因此摄入是唯一来源, 也不存在缺乏。在这个维度上 EGCG 按定义就是可选项, 于是全部问题落到试验获益和安全性上, 而浓缩儿茶素提取物有明确记录的肝损伤信号, 冲泡茶饮没有。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Camellia sinensis route: phenylalanine through phenylalanine ammonia-lyase to 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase and the flavonoid branch to epigallocatechin, then galloylation by ECGT using galloyl-1-O-beta-D-glucose as donor.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Camellia sinensis 途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 生成 4-coumaroyl-CoA, 再经 chalcone synthase 和类黄酮分支生成 epigallocatechin, 随后由 ECGT 以 galloyl-1-O-beta-D-glucose 为供体完成没食子酰化。
daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans have no flavonoid biosynthetic pathway.
daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有类黄酮生物合成通路。
still_matters_when: Only trial-supported endpoints. Dose and form are the safety-relevant variables, and there are usable thresholds: EFSA concluded that 800 mg EGCG/day or more taken as a food supplement produces a statistically significant rise in serum transaminases, with no evidence of hepatotoxicity below that level for up to 12 months, while catechins from traditionally brewed green tea infusion are generally c ...
still_matters_when_zh: 只看试验支持的终点。剂量和形式是与安全相关的变量, 而且有可用的阈值: EFSA 的结论是, 作为食品补充剂摄入 800 mg EGCG/day 或更多会使血清转氨酶出现统计学显著升高, 在此水平以下最长 12 个月未见肝毒性证据, 而按传统方式冲泡的绿茶中的儿茶素一般被认为是安全的 (EFSA Journal 2018;16(4):5239, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5239)。USP 对病例报告的评估结论是浓缩绿茶提取物可导致肝毒性, 空腹服用时尤其如此, 并建议在标签上加注警示。两者都支持谨慎使用而非常规服用。
source: PMID 23132863 (Liu et al., J Biol Chem 2012;287:44406-44417); PMID 32140423 (Oketch-Rabah et al., Toxicol Rep 2020;7:386-402); EFSA Panel on Food Additives and  ...

endogenous_note: Added because the dataset scored NMN and NR as two entries for one pathway while the cheap, pharmacopoeial forms of that pathway were missing. Humans do make NAD de novo from tryptophan, in liver, at an exchange rate of 60 mg dietary tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent, so the vitamin is partly substitutable by protein intake; that is what makes the label PARTIAL rather than NONE. Partial is not sufficient, and a genuine deficiency disease exists (pellagra), which is why niacin has an RDA. These two forms feed the same NAD pool that NMN and NR feed, at a small fraction of the price, and they are the forms with  ...
endogenous_note_zh: 补入这一条, 是因为原数据集把同一条通路拆成 NMN 和 NR 两个条目, 却漏掉了这条通路上价格低廉的药典形式。人体确实能在肝脏中由色氨酸从头合成 NAD, 换算比例是膳食色氨酸 60 mg 折合 1 mg 烟酸当量, 因此这种维生素可以被蛋白质摄入部分替代, 这也是标签为 PARTIAL 而非 NONE 的原因。部分合成并不够, 而且存在真正的缺乏病 (pellagra), 所以烟酸有 RDA。这两种形式与 NMN 和 NR 汇入同一个 NAD 池, 价格只有其零头, 并且它们才是拥有既定缺乏适应症的形式。两者在药理上并不能互换: 克级剂量的 nicotinic acid 是一种伴有面部潮红的调脂药, 而高剂量 nicotinamide 会经 NNMT 消耗甲基。

Nicotinic acid at pharmacological doses is a separate lipid indication with its own risk-benefit record. High-dose nicotinamide has been tri ...
still_matters_when_zh: Pellagra 以及导致它的各种状态 (长期饮酒、isoniazid 治疗、Hartnup 病、类癌、严重吸收不良), 此时维生素剂量的 nicotinamide 或 nicotinic acid 是既定纠正手段, 也是整个数据集中最便宜的选项。药理剂量的 nicotinic acid 属于另一个调脂适应症, 有其自身的风险获益记录。高剂量 nicotinamide 曾针对特定终点做过试验 (例如非黑色素瘤皮肤癌的化学预防), 这些属于药理用途, 与纠正缺乏无关。

endogenous_note: Added because it is the reference case for what NONE actually means, and because the antioxidant-during-chemotherapy entry leaned on it without naming the reason. Humans carry a non-functional pseudogene for L-gulonolactone oxidase (GULO), the last enzyme of ascorbate synthesis, so synthesis is zero and the loss is genetic, not dietary (PMID 8175804). Most mammals make their own; we do not. This is the opposite situation to the NAD intermediates: here the endogenous axis argues for intake, a deficiency disease exists with a defined clinical picture, and the supplement genuinely fills a gap when intake is low.
endogenous_note_zh: 补入这一条, 是因为它是理解 NONE 到底意味着什么的标杆案例, 而且化疗期间抗氧化剂那一条依赖它却没有说明原因。人类携带 L-gulonolactone oxidase (GULO) 的失活假基因, 该酶是抗坏血酸合成的最后一步, 因此合成量为零, 这一缺失属于遗传层面而非膳食层面 (PMID 8175804)。大多数哺乳动物能自己合成, 人不能。这与 NAD 中间物的情形正好相反: 在这里内源性这一维度支持摄入, 存在具有明确临床表现的缺乏病, 摄入不足时补充剂确实在填补真实缺口。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE in humans. In synthesising mammals: glucose to UDP-glucuronic acid to L-gulonate to L-gulonolactone, then L-gulonolactone oxidase to ascorbate, in liver. No organism synthesises an element; selenium must be ingested, full stop. What the body does synthesise is selenoproteins, using selenocysteine inserted co-translationally at a UGA codon through SECIS elements, SEPHS2, SEPSECS and the tRNA-Sec machinery. pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for the element. endogenous_note: Added because it is a contested classification the dataset needed: the body makes creatine and diet still matters. AGAT (GATM) makes guanidinoacetate, mainly in kidney, and GAMT methylates it to creatine in liver, consuming a large share of the body's SAM-derived methyl groups. Endogenous synthesis runs at roughly 1 g/day against total turnover of about 2 g/day in a 70 kg adult, with 1.5 to 2% of the creatine pool lost non-enzymatically as creatinine each day, so diet supplies the rest and vegetarians have measurably lower muscle stores. Typical supplement doses of 3 to 5 g/day exceed endogenous synthesis, which  ...
endogenous_note_zh: 补入这一条, 是因为它正是数据集需要的有争议分类: 机体自己合成肌酸, 而膳食仍然重要。AGAT (GATM) 主要在肾脏生成 guanidinoacetate, GAMT 在肝脏把它甲基化为肌酸, 消耗机体来自 SAM 的很大一部分甲基。在 70 kg 成人中, 内源合成约为 1 g/day, 而总周转约 2 g/day, 每天有 1.5 到 2% 的肌酸池非酶性地转为肌酐流失, 因此其余部分由膳食提供, 素食者的肌肉储量可测得偏低。常见补充剂剂量 3 到 5 g/day 超过内源合成量, 这也是加载有效的原因, 并使它成为少数几个能明确改变组织池的补充剂之一。
pathway: Arginine + glycine to guanidinoacetate + ornithine by AGAT (GATM), predominantly in kidney and pancreas; guanidinoacetate + SAM to creatine + SAH by GAMT, predominantly in liver; creatine is then taken up against a gradient by the SLC6A8 (CRT) transporter into muscle, heart and brain, phosphorylated by creatine kinase isoforms, and lost n ...
pathway_zh: Arginine + glycine 由 AGAT (GATM) 生成 guanidinoacetate + ornithine, 主要在肾脏和胰腺; guanidinoacetate + SAM 由 GAMT 生成肌酸 + SAH, 主要在肝脏; 肌酸随后由 SLC6A8 (CRT) 转运体逆梯度摄入肌肉、心脏和脑, 由肌酸激酶同工酶磷酸化, 并以非酶方式转为肌酐流失。这条通路是重要的甲基去路, 因此与 choline、betaine 和叶酸营养状态相互关联。
daily_amount: Roughly 1 g/day endogenous synthesis against about 2 g/day total turnover in a 70 kg adult, with 1.5 to 2% of the pool converted to creatinine daily (PMID 10893433). These are among the few genuine endogenous production  ...
daily_amount_zh: 在 70 kg 成人中, 内源合成约 1 g/day, 总周转约 2 g/day, 每天有 1.5 到 2% 的池转为肌酐 (PMID 10893433)。这是本数据集中少数真正可得的内源生成数字, 也正是收录这一条的理由。
still_matters_when: AGAT (GATM) and GAMT deficiency, where oral creatine is standard care and restores brain creatine; the SLC6A8 transporter defect does not respond to oral creatine, which is a clean demonstration that a supplement only works if the transport step exists. Beyond that, trial-supported endpoints in resistance exercise performance and specific clinical settings, plus a plausible dietary gap in strict v ...
still_matters_when_zh: AGAT (GATM) 和 GAMT 缺乏症, 此时口服肌酸是标准治疗, 可恢复脑内肌酸; SLC6A8 转运体缺陷对口服肌酸无反应, 这清楚地表明补充剂只在转运步骤存在时才起作用。除此之外, 是抗阻运动表现和特定临床场景中有试验支持的终点, 以及严格素食者和纯素者身上真实存在的膳食缺口。
source: PMID 10893433 (Wyss & Kaddurah-Daouk, Physiol Rev 2000;80:1107-1213)

endogenous_note: Added as a second contested PARTIAL case with hard pharmacokinetics attached. Humans synthesise carnitine from protein-bound trimethyllysine through TMLHE, HTMLA, ALDH9A1 and finally BBOX1 in liver, kidney and brain, and in omnivores diet still supplies most of the pool, while strict vegetarians depend mainly on synthesis. The supplement-relevant facts are absorption facts: dietary carnitine bioavailability is 54 to 87% and depends on the amount in the meal, whereas absorption of 0.5 to 6 g supplements is primarily passive with bioavailability of only 14 to 18% of dose, whole-body turnover time is 38 to 119 hours ...
endogenous_note_zh: 补入这一条, 作为第二个有争议的 PARTIAL 案例, 并带有硬性的药代动力学数据。人体从蛋白结合型 trimethyllysine 出发, 经 TMLHE、HTMLA、ALDH9A1, 最后由 BBOX1 在肝、肾和脑中合成肉碱; 在杂食者中膳食仍提供池中的大部分, 而严格素食者主要依赖自身合成。与补充剂相关的事实是吸收事实: 膳食肉碱生物利用度为 54 到 87%, 并取决于一餐中的含量; 而 0.5 到 6 g 补充剂的吸收以被动方式为主, 生物利用度仅为剂量的 14 到 18%; 全身周转时间为 38 到 119 小时; 肾脏对滤过负荷的重吸收率为 90 到 99%。一个几乎把滤过的全部都回收回来的机体, 并没有在发出短缺信号。

still_matters_when_zh: 由 OCTN2 (SLC22A5) 突变引起的原发性肉碱缺乏, 此时补充是可救命的标准治疗; 继发性缺乏见于 valproate 毒性、血液透析、部分有机酸血症和脂肪酸氧化障碍, 以及使用不含肉碱肠外营养的早产儿。健康杂食者没有需要纠正的缺乏, 补充剂偏低的生物利用度限制了给药能达到的效果, 而 TMAO 通路对每天摄入克级剂量的人来说是尚未解决的考量。

endogenous_note: Added because it gives the sharpest dose-versus-physiology contrast available in this space, which is exactly what an endogenous-synthesis dataset should be able to show. The pineal gland makes melatonin from tryptophan through TPH1, aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, AANAT and ASMT, under suprachiasmatic nucleus control and suppressed by light, and nocturnal output is small. In a dose-ranging trial in adults over 50, 0.3 mg restored sleep efficiency and raised plasma melatonin to normal nocturnal levels, while 3.0 mg raised it above the physiological range. Common capsules of 3 to 10 mg therefore sit one to tw ...

endogenous_note: Added because it is a textbook PARTIAL that the dataset needed for calibration: the body does synthesise the choline moiety, and not enough of it. PEMT converts phosphatidylethanolamine to phosphatidylcholine by three successive SAM-dependent methylations, mostly in liver, which covers part of phosphatidylcholine need; the rest has to be eaten, and depletion studies produce liver dysfunction and muscle damage that reverse on repletion. endogenous_note: Added because it is the only item in this space that turns on a measured conversion percentage, which makes it the best test of what PARTIAL should mean. Humans can elongate and desaturate alpha-linolenic acid to EPA and DHA through FADS2, ELOVL5, FADS1, ELOVL2 and a final peroxisomal beta-oxidation step, so the capacity exists and is inefficient. Stable-isotope tracer work shows conversion to EPA occurs but is limited in men, further transformation to DHA is very low, and fractional conversion is greater in women, plausibly an oestrogen effect. The 18-carbon precursor itself cannot be made at all: the omega-3 do ...

endogenous_note: Added as the cleanest case of a compound the human body accumulates on purpose and cannot make. Ergothioneine is synthesised only by fungi and certain bacteria, through the egtA-egtE genes in Mycobacterium and Egt1/Egt2 in fungi; humans have no homologue of any of those steps. What humans do have is a dedicated high-affinity transporter, OCTN1 (SLC22A4), which moves ergothioneine with far greater efficiency than any other proposed substrate and concentrates it in CD71+ erythroid cells, monocytes and other tissues. Blood levels are lower in people who eat few mushrooms, and low levels have been associated with disease in observational work, and neither observation establishes a deficiency state or a target intake. The dedicated transporter and long retention make it biologically interesting; interesting is not an indication.

endogenous_note: Iron is chemical element 26, and no enzyme can build an element out of anything else, so every iron atom in haemoglobin arrived in food, water or a pill. The body compensates by hoarding: macrophages strip iron from dying red cells and return roughly 20-25 mg/d to plasma, while only about 1-2 mg/d is absorbed to cover obligatory losses. Recycling only reuses atoms already present, so once losses outrun absorption the sole remedy is dietary iron, which means iron supplements are never redundant on this axis and stand or fall entirely on measured status and losses. endogenous_note: Iodine is chemical element 53, so there is no synthetic route to it and thyroid hormone output falls when dietary supply stops. What the body does make is the hormone itself: thyroid peroxidase attaches dietary iodide to tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin to build T4 and T3, and deiodinases salvage iodide when hormone is degraded. The enzymatic machinery is endogenous while every iodine atom is dietary, so iodine supplementation is genuinely useful wherever intake is low and pointless once intake is adequate.

An adult carries roughly 1.5-2.5 g of zinc, about 60% in skeletal muscle and 30% in bone, and there is no rapidly mobilisable dedicated store analogous to ferritin, although slow exchange from muscle and bone together with down-regulated faecal and urinary losses buffers intake gaps for weeks. At 200 µg/d the limiting issue is saturation. endogenous_note_zh: 硒是34号化学元素，本身完全无法合成，但它的功能形式部分是体内自制的：身体在自己的 tRNA 上组装硒代半胱氨酸，并把它插入被重新编码的 UGA 密码子，所用的硒全部来自膳食。在 200 µg/d 这个剂量上，关键问题是饱和。硒蛋白 P 是硒蛋白完整表达的标志物，在 98 名基线摄入仅 14 µg/d 的健康中国成年人中，估计摄入 49 µg/d 即可使其达到最优；以 l-硒代甲硫氨酸形式 75 µg Se/d 可让美国居民完整表达硒蛋白，这是推定值，并非实测值。因此多出来的 125 至 150 µg 换不来更多硒蛋白。该研究人群基线本身缺硒，限制了 49 µg/d 这一数值的外推。超过平台之后剂量已属药理范畴：在 Nutritional Prevention of Cancer 试验中，200 µg/d 平均服用 7.7 年提高了2型糖尿病发生率（总体风险比 1.55，95% CI 1. ...

In all of those, doses near 50 to 75 µg/d cover the requirement, so 200 µg/d sits above the useful range for repletion and carries a documented metabolic and onc ...
still_matters_when_zh: 只有低摄入或额外损失才构成理由：土壤缺硒地区（历史上的克山病和大骨节病地区、中国部分地区、历史上的芬兰）、长期肠外营养、严重吸收不良、部分危重症方案。在这些情形中，接近 50 至 75 µg/d 的剂量即可满足需要，因此 200 µg/d 高于补足所需的有用范围，对已经充足的人还带有明确的代谢和肿瘤学代价：NPC 试验中的糖尿病发生率，以及 SELECT 中的高级别前列腺癌。

endogenous_note: Magnesium is chemical element 12 and cannot be synthesised, so all of the roughly 25 g in an adult body came from food. Bone holds 50 to 60% of it and the kidney adjusts reabsorption tightly, which buffers short-term intake gaps and is also why serum magnesium is a poor guide to total body stores. With synthesis at zero, the only question is whether habitual intake, drug use or renal and gastrointestinal losses justify supplementing, and for a large share of the population intake alone does.
endogenous_note_zh: 镁是12号化学元素，无法合成，成人体内约 25 g 镁全部来自食物。骨骼中占其 50 至 60%，肾脏对重吸收有紧密调节，这既缓冲了短期摄入缺口，也是血清镁不能代表全身储量的原因。合成为零，剩下的问题只有：习惯摄入量、用药、肾脏和胃肠道损失是否构成补充的理由。对相当大一部分人群来说，仅摄入量这一条就已经构成理由。

daily_amount: 0 mg/d synthesised. Reference points: adult body content about 25 g, 50 to 60% of it in bone; RDA 400-420 mg/d men and 310-320 mg/d women; UL 350 mg/d for supplemental magnesium only, with food magnesium uncapped.
daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 mg/d。参照点：成人体内含量约 25 g，其中 50 至 60% 在骨骼；RDA 男性 400-420 mg/d，女性 310-320 mg/d；UL 350 mg/d 只针对补充剂形式的镁，食物中的镁不设上限。
still_matters_when: Justified by intake or loss: habitual intake below the EAR, proton pump inhibitors, loop and thiazide diuretics, chronic alcohol use, type 2 diabetes, Crohn disease or coeliac disease, refeeding, documented hypomagnesaemia. Not justified as a routine add-on on an already adequate diet, where the main effect of surplus oral magnesium salts is osmotic diarrhoea.
still_matters_when_zh: 摄入或损失构成理由：习惯摄入低于 EAR、质子泵抑制剂、环类和噻嗪类利尿剂、长期饮酒、2型糖尿病、克罗恩病或乳糜泻、再喂养、已记录的低镁血症。膳食本已充足时把它当常规附加品没有依据，多余的口服镁盐主要造成渗透性腹泻。

supplement: Calcium supplements on top of an adequate diet
endogenous_note: Calcium is chemical element 20, so none of the 1000 to 1200 g in an adult skeleton is manufactured and all of it is dietary in origin. The body defends blood calcium hard through PTH, calcitriol and bone turnover, and part of that defence is throttling absorption, since fractional intestinal absorption falls as intake rises. So a supplement added to an already adequate intake is absorbed inefficiently and largely excreted, which raises urinary calcium and is the mechanism behind the excess kidney stones seen in the Women's Health Initiative calcium plus vitamin D trial (hazard ratio 1.17, 95% CI 1.02 to 1.34). Th ...
endogenous_note_zh: 钙是20号化学元素，成人骨骼中 1000 至 1200 g 钙没有一克是体内制造的，全部来自膳食。身体通过 PTH、骨化三醇和骨转换严密维持血钙，其中一环就是抑制吸收：摄入升高时肠道分数吸收率随之下降。因此在摄入已经充足的基础上再补钙，吸收效率低且大部分被排出，尿钙升高，这正是 Women's Health Initiative 钙加维生素D试验中肾结石增多的机制（风险比 1.17，95% CI 1.02 至 1.34）。同一试验也显示了另一面：36,282 名绝经后女性服用 1000 mg 碳酸钙形式的元素钙加 400 IU 维生素D3，历时 7.0 年，髋部骨密度上升 1.06%（P<0.01），在剔除依从性差的数据后髋部骨折风险下降（风险比 0.71，95% CI 0.52 至 0.97）。总账是一点有限的骨骼收益，对应一份真实的结石风险。

daily_amount: 0 mg/d synthesised. Reference points: adult skeletal content 1000-1200 g; RDA 1000 mg/d for adults 19-50 and men to 70, 1200 mg/d for women 51 and over and men 71 and over; UL 2000-2500 mg/d depending on age.
daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 mg/d。参照点：成人骨骼含钙 1000-1200 g；RDA 19-50 岁成人及 70 岁以下男性 1000 mg/d，51 岁及以上女性和 71 岁及以上男性 1200 mg/d；UL 按年龄为 2000-2500 mg/d。

On an adequate diet the marginal supplement adds little and carries st ...
still_matters_when_zh: 摄入确实不足或体内处理出问题时才有理由：习惯摄入低于 EAR（老年女性和回避乳制品者常见）、以钙和维生素D达标为前提的骨质疏松药物治疗、甲状旁腺功能低下、吸收不良、长期糖皮质激素治疗、专科指导下的慢性肾病。膳食充足时边际补充作用很小，还带来结石风险，食物优先是更好的路径；确需补充时，WHI 依从人群分析中的收益出现在 1000 mg/d 加 400 IU 维生素D3 这一剂量。

endogenous_note: Humans can make EPA and DHA, yet only by remodelling a fatty acid they cannot make at all, the plant-derived precursor ALA, and the final steps are the bottleneck. In stable-isotope tracer work the fraction of ingested ALA reaching EPA is 21% in young women, while DHA reaches 9% in young women and stays undetectable in young men for 21 days after dosing. Because the pathway cannot be driven harder, tissue DHA tracks intake of preformed DHA and barely responds to ALA, so preformed EPA and DHA is one of the few supplements the endogenous route genuinely cannot make redundant. These percentages are not fixed constan ...
endogenous_note_zh: 人体能合成 EPA 和 DHA，但只能通过改造一种自己完全无法合成的脂肪酸，即来自植物的前体 ALA，而最后几步是瓶颈。稳定同位素示踪研究显示，摄入的 ALA 转化到 EPA 的比例在年轻女性中为 21%，到 DHA 在年轻女性中为 9%，在年轻男性中给药后 21 天内始终检测不到。由于这条通路无法被推得更快，组织 DHA 跟随现成 DHA 的摄入变化，对 ALA 几乎没有反应，所以现成的 EPA 和 DHA 属于少数几种内源途径确实无法使之变得多余的补充剂。这些百分比也不是固定常数：FADS1 和 FADS2 基因型是个体间转化效率最大的单一修饰因素，人群均值掩盖了很宽的分布。

endogenous: PARTIAL for EPA and DHA; NONE for astaxanthin
endogenous_note: The active omega-3s in krill oil are the same EPA and DHA the body can only build partially from dietary ALA, so the endogenous arithmetic is identical to fish oil: limited EPA synthesis, and DHA synthesis that is undetectable in young men. The second selling point, astaxanthin, has no human biosynthetic route at all, because vertebrates including humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway and can only cleave or modify what they eat. The rule is about vertebrates rather than animals in general, since aphids, spider mites and some other arthropods do synthesise carotenoids using genes acquired by horizontal tr ...
endogenous_note_zh: 磷虾油中起作用的 omega-3 就是身体只能从膳食 ALA 部分合成的 EPA 和 DHA，因此内源账目与鱼油完全相同：EPA 合成有限，DHA 合成在年轻男性中检测不到。第二个卖点虾青素在人体内完全没有生物合成途径，脊椎动物（包括人）不具备类胡萝卜素生物合成通路，只能对吃进来的类胡萝卜素做裂解或修饰。这条规则适用于脊椎动物，对动物整体并不成立：蚜虫、叶螨和另一些节肢动物通过从真菌横向转移获得的基因确实能从头合成类胡萝卜素，这个例外不影响关于人的结论。产品中没有任何成分重复身体已能充分制造的物质，所以真正需要提醒的是剂量，与冗余无关：磷虾油每克所含的 EPA 和 DHA 少于浓缩鱼油或藻油，标签上的毫克数比磷脂形式这套说法更重要。

endogenous_note: Two things hold at once. ALA itself cannot be made by humans at all, because we lack the omega-3 (delta-15) desaturase that plants have, and zero synthesis is what earns NONE for the substance in the bottle, exactly as it does for the six elements. endogenous_note: Vitamin C is the paradigm case of NONE arising from a lost pathway rather than from being an element. Humans carry the terminal enzyme L-gulonolactone oxidase only as a non-functional pseudogene (GULOP), which is why we develop scurvy while rats and dogs, which retain GULO, do not. Every milligram of ascorbate is dietary, so supplementation is never redundant on this axis and is justified purely by intake, losses and the plateau of tissue saturation.
endogenous_note_zh: 维生素C 是 NONE 来自通路丢失而非元素属性的典型例子。人类的终末酶 L-古洛糖酸内酯氧化酶只以无功能假基因（GULOP）形式存在，这就是人会得坏血病而保留 GULO 的大鼠和狗不会的原因。每一毫克抗坏血酸都来自膳食，所以在这一维度上补充永远不算多余，其理由完全取决于摄入量、损失量和组织饱和的平台。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE in humans, because the terminal enzyme is a pseudogene. In species that retain it: glucose → UDP-glucuronate → D-glucuronate → L-gulonate → L-gulono-1,4-lactone → GULO → L-ascorbate, hepatic in mammals and renal in birds and reptiles. Humans retain only downstream handling: SVCT1 (SLC23A1) for intestinal and renal uptake, S ...
pathway_zh: 在人体中 NOT APPLICABLE（不适用），终末酶是假基因。在保留该酶的物种中：葡萄糖 → UDP-葡糖醛酸 → D-葡糖醛酸 → L-古洛糖酸 → L-古洛糖酸-1,4-内酯 → GULO → L-抗坏血酸，哺乳动物在肝，鸟类和爬行类在肾。人体只保留下游处理：SVCT1（SLC23A1）负责肠道和肾脏摄取，SVCT2（SLC23A2）负责组织摄取，脱氢抗坏血酸由谷胱甘肽和硫氧还蛋白还原酶再生为抗坏血酸。

Gram doses for cold prevention in the general population are not requirement-based, and surplus is renally cleared with a rise in urinary oxalate.
still_matters_when_zh: NEVER ON THIS AXIS（在这一维度上永不成立）。理由基于摄入和损失：吸烟、水果蔬菜摄入极少、酒精使用障碍、吸收不良、血液透析，以及临床坏血病的治疗。一般人群用克级剂量预防感冒并非以需要量为依据，多余部分由肾脏清除，同时尿草酸升高。

supplement: Vitamin D (cholecalciferol) as a standalone supplement
endogenous_note: This is the strongest FULL case in nutrition and the one that tests the redundancy claim directly. Skin makes cholecalciferol from 7-dehydrocholesterol whenever UVB reaches it, and exposure alone can meet requirement without any toxicity risk, because previtamin D3 photodegrades to lumisterol and tachysterol and CYP24A1 clears the active hormone. So the supplement is genuinely redundant for someone with regular summer sun on bare skin, and genuinely necessary when UVB is absent. The verdict depends on exposure rather than on biochemistry, which is why blanket claims in either direction are wrong.
endogenous_note_zh: 这是营养学中最强的 FULL 案例，也直接检验了冗余这一判断。只要 UVB 照到皮肤，皮肤就用 7-脱氢胆固醇制造胆钙化醇，单靠日照即可满足需要量且没有中毒风险，因为前维生素D3 会光降解为光甾醇和速甾醇，CYP24A1 会清除活性激素。因此对夏季经常裸露皮肤晒太阳的人，这种补充剂确实多余；在没有 UVB 的情况下，它确实必要。结论取决于日照条件而非生化本身，所以两个方向的一概而论都站不住。

endogenous_note: CoQ10 is the clearest redundancy case in the supplement market. Every cell synthesises it de novo through the mevalonate pathway plus PDSS1, PDSS2 and COQ2 to COQ9, there is no DRI, no deficiency syndrome caused by low intake, and dietary intake of a few mg/d is small against endogenous production. Oral doses raise plasma CoQ10 carried in lipoproteins with little evidence of increased mitochondrial content in healthy tissue, so in a healthy adult the supplement duplicates a pathway already running at capacity.
endogenous_note_zh: 辅酶Q10 是补充剂市场上最清楚的冗余案例。每个细胞都通过甲羟戊酸通路加 PDSS1、PDSS2 和 COQ2 至 COQ9 从头合成它，没有 DRI，也没有由摄入不足引起的缺乏症，膳食提供的每天几毫克相对内源产量很小。口服剂量会升高血浆中由脂蛋白携带的 CoQ10，但健康组织线粒体含量升高的证据很少，所以对健康成人来说，补充重复的是一条本已满负荷运转的通路。

still_matters_when: Justified in primary CoQ10 deficiency from COQ2, COQ4, COQ6, COQ8A, COQ9, PDSS1 or PDSS2 variants, where high-dose supplementation is standard care and early treatment changes outcome. Weaker cases: statin-associated muscle symptoms (trial evidence mixed) and adjunctive use in heart failure. In healthy adults the redundancy argument holds.
still_matters_when_zh: 由 COQ2、COQ4、COQ6、COQ8A、COQ9、PDSS1 或 PDSS2 变异导致的原发性 CoQ10 缺乏症有理由使用，高剂量补充是标准治疗，早期治疗会改变结局。较弱的情形：他汀相关肌肉症状（试验证据不一）和心力衰竭的辅助使用。对健康成人，冗余这一判断成立。
source: Acosta MJ, Vazquez Fonseca L, Desbats MA, et al. Coenzyme Q biosynthesis in health and disease. Biochim Biophys Acta. 2016;1857(8):1079-85. PMID 27060254, DOI 1 ...

endogenous_note: Glutathione is synthesised in every cell by GCLC with GCLM and then GSS, at high and continuous flux, and the pathway is feedback-inhibited by glutathione itself, so intake cannot push cellular levels indefinitely. Cysteine availability is the usual rate-limiting input, which is the whole reason N-acetylcysteine works while oral glutathione largely does not: ingested glutathione is broken down by intestinal gamma-glutamyl transferase and peptidases before absorption and arrives as its constituent amino acids. The endogenous route is complete, so the defensible products are cysteine precursors used pharmacological ...
endogenous_note_zh: 谷胱甘肽由每个细胞通过 GCLC 与 GCLM 再经 GSS 合成，通量高且持续，这条通路还受谷胱甘肽本身的反馈抑制，所以靠摄入无法无限提高细胞内水平。半胱氨酸的可得性通常是限速输入，这正是 N-乙酰半胱氨酸有效而口服谷胱甘肽基本无效的原因：吃进去的谷胱甘肽在吸收前已被肠道 gamma-谷氨酰转移酶和肽酶分解，到达体内的是其组成氨基酸。内源途径完整，站得住的产品是按药理方式使用的半胱氨酸前体。
pathway: Glutamate + cysteine → glutamate cysteine ligase (GCLC catalytic subunit with GCLM modifier) → gamma-glutamylcysteine → + glycine → glutathione synthetase (GSS) → GSH; recycling through the gamma-glutamyl cycle (GGT1 and dipeptidases) and reduction of GSSG by glutathione reductase (GSR) using NADPH; cysteine also arrives from methionine b ...
pathway_zh: 谷氨酸 + 半胱氨酸 → 谷氨酸半胱氨酸连接酶（催化亚基 GCLC 与调节亚基 GCLM）→ gamma-谷氨酰半胱氨酸 → 加甘氨酸 → 谷胱甘肽合成酶（GSS）→ GSH；通过 gamma-谷氨酰循环（GGT1 和二肽酶）回收，GSSG 由谷胱甘肽还原酶（GSR）利用 NADPH 还原；半胱氨酸也可由甲硫氨酸经转硫途径（CBS、CTH）提供。
daily_amount: Whole-body glutathione synthesis in mg/d: NOT ESTABLISHED as a consensus figure, although hepatic pools turn over within hours and intracellular concentrations are 1-10 mmol/L. No DRI. N-acetylcysteine trial doses 600-18 ...
daily_amount_zh: 全身谷胱甘肽合成量（mg/d）：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立共识数值），但肝内储池在数小时内即完成周转，细胞内浓度为 1-10 mmol/L。没有 DRI。N-乙酰半胱氨酸试验剂量为口服 600-1800 mg/d，对乙酰氨基酚解毒方案的静脉剂量远高于此。
still_matters_when: Justified as intravenous N-acetylcysteine in paracetamol overdose (established antidote), in inborn errors of glutathione synthesis (GCLC or GSS deficiency), and in specific settings where cysteine supply is limited, such as severe malnutrition. Oral glutathione as a general antioxidant or skin-lightening product duplicates a substrate-regulated pathway and mostly does not survive digestion.
still_matters_when_zh: 对乙酰氨基酚过量时静脉用 N-乙酰半胱氨酸（公认解毒剂）、谷胱甘肽合成的先天缺陷（GCLC 或 GSS 缺乏）、以及半胱氨酸供应受限的特定情形（例如严重营养不良），这些有理由使用。把口服谷胱甘肽当作通用抗氧化剂或美白产品，重复的是一条由底物调控的通路，而且大部分在消化过程中就被破坏。
source: Lu SC. Glutathione synthesis. Biochim Biophys Acta. 2013;1830(5):3143-53. PMID 22995213.

supplement: Niacin and NAD precursors (nicotinamide, nicotinamide riboside, NMN)
endogenous_note: Niacin is the quantified partial case: NAD can be built de novo from tryptophan through the kynurenine pathway at roughly 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent, which is why the RDA is expressed in niacin equivalents rather than in milligrams of niacin. A protein-adequate diet therefore covers much of the requirement without any preformed niacin. The conversion is not free: it needs riboflavin, vitamin B6 and iron as cofactors, and pellagra appears when niacin and tryptophan are short together, as on maize-based diets or in Hartnup disease.
endogenous_note_zh: 烟酸是被量化的部分合成案例：NAD 可由色氨酸经犬尿氨酸通路从头合成，比例约为 60 mg 色氨酸对 1 mg 烟酸当量，这也是 RDA 用烟酸当量而非烟酸毫克数表达的原因。因此蛋白质充足的膳食即使不含现成烟酸，也能覆盖大部分需要量。这一转化并非没有条件：它需要核黄素、维生素B6 和铁作为辅助因子；当烟酸与色氨酸同时不足时会出现佩拉格拉，例如以玉米为主的膳食或 Hartnup 病。
pathway: De novo from tryptophan: TDO2 or IDO1 → kynurenine → KMO, KYNU and HAAO → quinolinate → QPRT → nicotinic acid mononucleotide → NMNAT1-3 → NAD. Salvage routes: nicotinamide → NAMPT → NMN → NMNAT → NAD; nicotinic acid through the Preiss-Handler route (NAPRT); nicotinamide riboside through NMRK1 and NMRK2.
pathway_zh: 由色氨酸从头合成：TDO2 或 IDO1 → 犬尿氨酸 → KMO、KYNU 和 HAAO → 喹啉酸 → QPRT → 烟酸单核苷酸 → NMNAT1-3 → NAD。补救途径：烟酰胺 → NAMPT → NMN → NMNAT → NAD；烟酸经 Preiss-Handler 途径（NAPRT）；烟酰胺核糖经 NMRK1 和 NMRK2。
daily_amount: Conversion ratio 60 mg dietary tryptophan to 1 mg niacin equivalent. RDA 16 mg NE/d men and 14 mg NE/d women; UL 35 mg/d for supplemental nicotinic acid and nicotinamide, set on flushing. Endogenous NAD synthesis in mg/d ...
daily_amount_zh: 转化比为 60 mg 膳食色氨酸对 1 mg 烟酸当量。RDA 男性 16 mg NE/d，女性 14 mg NE/d；补充形式的烟酸和烟酰胺 UL 35 mg/d，依据是潮红反应。内源 NAD 合成量（mg/d）：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。
still_matters_when: Justified in pellagra, low-protein maize-based diets, Hartnup disease, carcinoid syndrome, prolonged isoniazid therapy, and pharmacologically as nicotinic acid at 1-2 g/d for dyslipidaemia. Nicotinamide riboside and NMN sold for ageing are not correcting a deficiency, so their case rests on outcome trials rather than on synthesis arithmetic.
still_matters_when_zh: 佩拉格拉、以玉米为主的低蛋白膳食、Hartnup 病、类癌综合征、长期异烟肼治疗，以及以 1-2 g/d 烟酸治疗血脂异常（药理用途），这些有理由使用。以抗衰老为名销售的烟酰胺核糖和 NMN 并不在纠正缺乏，其依据只能来自结局试验，与合成量的算术无关。
source: IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Thiamin, Riboflavin, Niacin, Vitamin B6, Folate, Vitamin B12, Pantothenic Acid, Biotin, and Choline (1998), National Academie ...

endogenous: PARTIAL, as conversion of dietary vitamin K rather than de novo synthesis; NONE for the naphthoquinone ring itself
endogenous_note: MK-4 is routinely misrepresented in supplement marketing. Humans cannot make the naphthoquinone ring, so vitamin K itself is entirely dietary, but UBIAD1 prenylates menadione derived from dietary phylloquinone (K1) to MK-4 in most tissues, so the specific form sold as K2 MK-4 is one the body already produces from ordinary K1 intake. Supplementing MK-4 duplicates that conversion. The honest arguments for a K2 product are pharmacokinetic, since MK-7 has a much longer half-life than K1, and dietary, for people eating little natto, cheese or leafy greens.
endogenous_note_zh: MK-4 在补充剂营销中经常被误述。人体无法合成萘醌环，维生素K 本身完全来自膳食，但 UBIAD1 会把源自膳食叶绿醌（K1）的甲萘醌在大多数组织中异戊烯化为 MK-4，因此以 K2 MK-4 出售的这种特定形式，身体本来就能从普通 K1 摄入中生成。补充 MK-4 重复的正是这一转化。支持 K2 产品的合理理由在于药代动力学（MK-7 的半衰期远长于 K1）和膳食（纳豆、干酪或深色叶菜吃得很少的人）。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for the ring, since humans have no de novo vitamin K pathway. Conversion only: dietary phylloquinone K1 → side-chain removal to menadione → UBIAD1 geranylgeranylation → MK-4 in most tissues. Function runs through the vitamin K cycle, where GGCX carboxylates glutamate to gamma-carboxyglutamate in prothrombin, osteocalcin and ...
pathway_zh: 对萘醌环 NOT APPLICABLE（不适用），人体没有维生素K 的从头合成通路。只有转化：膳食叶绿醌 K1 → 去侧链生成甲萘醌 → UBIAD1 香叶基香叶基化 → 大多数组织中的 MK-4。功能通过维生素K 循环实现：GGCX 把凝血酶原、骨钙素和基质 Gla 蛋白中的谷氨酸羧化为 gamma-羧基谷氨酸，VKORC1 再生氢醌形式，这一步正是华法林阻断的位点。长链甲萘醌 MK-7 至 MK-10 来自细菌，可经膳食或结肠获得。
daily_amount: MK-4 formed endogenously in mg/d: NOT ESTABLISHED. Vitamin K AI 120 µg/d men and 90 µg/d women as phylloquinone; no UL has been set. Typical supplement doses MK-4 1.5-45 mg/d and MK-7 90-360 µg/d.
daily_amount_zh: 内源生成的 MK-4（mg/d）：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。以叶绿醌计的维生素K AI 男性 120 µg/d，女性 90 µg/d；未设 UL。常见补充剂量为 MK-4 1.5-45 mg/d，MK-7 90-360 µg/d。
still_matters_when: Justified in documented deficiency from fat malabsorption or cholestasis, in newborn prophylaxis (K1 by injection), and in warfarin users the issue is consistency of intake rather than supplementation. Bone and vascular calcification protocols exist but the trial evidence is mixed. Redundant as a way of obtaining MK-4 in anyone with adequate K1 intake and functioning UBIAD1.
still_matters_when_zh: 脂肪吸收不良或胆汁淤积导致的确诊缺乏、新生儿预防（注射 K1）有理由使用；服用华法林者需要的是摄入量稳定，并非补充。骨骼和血管钙化方面有相关方案，但试验证据不一。对 K1 摄入充足且 UBIAD1 功能正常的人，靠补充获得 MK-4 是多余的。
source: Nakagawa K, Hirota Y, Sawada N, et al. Identification of UBIAD1 as a novel human menaquinone-4 biosynthetic enzyme. Nature. 2010;468(7320):117-21. PMID 20953171 ...

endogenous_note: These four share one shape: a real human biosynthetic route whose output sits below what the marketed dose delivers, so each is partly endogenous. Taurine is made from cysteine by CDO1 and CSAD, though human CSAD activity is low compared with rodents, and strict vegans run lower plasma and urinary taurine without a defined deficiency syndrome. Betaine is made from choline by CHDH and ALDH7A1, so its endogenous supply depends on a dietary precursor. supplement: Fully endogenous small molecules sold as supplements: myo-inositol, glucosamine, hyaluronic acid, melatonin, alpha-lipoic acid and collagen peptides
endogenous_note: Every one of these is made by the body at a rate that matches or exceeds the marketed dose, so the redundancy argument applies directly, and any justification has to come from pharmacology rather than from replacing a shortfall. Renal myo-inositol synthesis approaches 4 g/d, several times dietary intake. Glucosamine 6-phosphate is made continuously by GFPT1 in every cell building glycosaminoglycans, and no deficiency state exists. An adult carries about 15 g of hyaluronan and turns over roughly 5 g/d, while ingested hyaluronan is depolymerised by gut bacteria. The pineal gland secretes only tens of micrograms of  ...
endogenous_note_zh: 这六种物质体内的生成速率都达到或超过市售剂量，冗余判断直接适用，任何理由都必须来自药理作用，与补足缺口无关。肾脏合成肌醇接近 4 g/d，是膳食摄入的数倍。葡糖胺-6-磷酸由 GFPT1 在每个构建糖胺聚糖的细胞中持续生成，不存在缺乏状态。成人体内约有 15 g 透明质酸，每天周转约 5 g，口服的透明质酸会被肠道细菌解聚。松果体每夜只分泌几十微克褪黑素，0.5-10 mg 的片剂是生理量的 10 至 1000 倍，其作用属于时相药理。硫辛酸由 LIAS 合成，只有以共价键结合在脱氢酶 E2 亚基上时才有功能，口服的游离硫辛酸不会被装入这些复合体。胶原由自身成纤维细胞用普通蛋白摄入提供的氨基酸合成，真正限制它的辅助因子是维生素C、铁和 2-氧化戊二酸，这也是坏血病属于胶原疾病的原因。

Hyaluronan: UDP-glucuronate + UDP-GlcNAc → HAS1, HAS2 and HAS3 at the plasma membrane ...

Glucosamine: symptomatic knee osteoarthritis only, with mixed and at best small effects. Hyaluronan: injected  ...

supplement: Other mineral elements sold as supplements (copper, potassium, sodium, phosphorus, chromium, manganese, molybdenum, boron, lithium, fluoride, silicon, vanadium, nickel)
endogenous: NONE for every one of them
endogenous_note: All thirteen are chemical elements, so synthesis is zero in each case and the element rule applies without exception: the redundancy axis never provides an argument, and each stands or falls on intake, losses and toxicity margin. Several have narrow windows. Copper deficiency in adults is most often iatrogenic, from high-dose zinc or bariatric surgery. Manganese accumulates in cholestasis and chromium in renal failure. Fluoride's benefit is topical and dental, with skeletal fluorosis at high chronic intake. Boron, silicon, vanadium and nickel have no established human requirement at all, so supplements of them ca ...
endogenous_note_zh: 这十三种都是化学元素，合成量都为零，元素规则无例外适用：冗余这一维度提供不了任何论证，每一种都取决于摄入量、损失量和中毒余量。其中几种的安全窗很窄。成人铜缺乏多为医源性，来自高剂量锌或减重手术。锰在胆汁淤积时蓄积，铬在肾衰竭时蓄积。氟的益处是局部的、针对牙齿的，长期高摄入会导致骨氟中毒。硼、硅、钒和镍没有已确立的人体需要量，因此以缺乏为由补充它们无法成立。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for all of them (chemical elements). Handling only, for example CTR1 (SLC31A1) with ATP7A and ATP7B for copper, ENaC and the SLC12 family under renin-angiotensin-aldosterone control for sodium and potassium, NaPi-2b (SLC34A2) with FGF23 for phosphate, DMT1 with ZIP8 and ZIP14 for manganese, and MOCS1, MOCS2 and GPHN for ass ...
pathway_zh: 全部 NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有体内处理，例如铜的 CTR1（SLC31A1）连同 ATP7A 和 ATP7B；钠和钾的 ENaC 与 SLC12 家族，受肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统调控；磷酸的 NaPi-2b（SLC34A2）与 FGF23；锰的 DMT1 与 ZIP8、ZIP14；以及组装钼辅因子的 MOCS1、MOCS2 和 GPHN。
