daily_amount_zh: 每一种的合成量均为 0。成人参照点：铜 RDA 900 µg/d，UL 10 mg/d；钾 AI 2600-3400 mg/d；钠的降低慢性病风险摄入量 2300 mg/d；磷 RDA 700 mg/d，UL 4000 mg/d；铬 AI 25-35 µg/d；锰 AI 1.8-2.3 mg/d，UL 11 mg/d； ...
still_matters_when: NEVER ON THIS AXIS. Justified only by documented deficiency or defined loss: copper after bariatric surgery or with high-dose zinc, potassium with diuretics or in hypokalaemia, phosphate in refeeding syndrome, molybdenum on long-term parenteral nutrition, fluoride mainly as topical dental prophylaxis. Chromium picolinate for glycaemia, vanadium for diabetes and boron for hormones have no requireme ...
still_matters_when_zh: NEVER ON THIS AXIS（在这一维度上永不成立）。只有确诊缺乏或明确损失才构成理由：减重手术后或使用高剂量锌时的铜、使用利尿剂或低钾血症时的钾、再喂养综合征中的磷酸、长期肠外营养中的钼、以及主要作为牙科局部预防的氟。以吡啶甲酸铬改善血糖、以钒治疗糖尿病、以硼调节激素，都没有基于需要量的依据；锰、钒和镍的补充剂还存在真实的中毒风险。
source: IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zi ...

supplement: Nutrients made by colonic bacteria (menaquinones, biotin, folate and vitamin B12)
endogenous: NOT HOST SYNTHESIS: a microbial route, and for vitamin B12 not absorbable at the site of production
endogenous_note: Colonic bacteria synthesise long-chain menaquinones (MK-10 to MK-13, largely from Bacteroides), biotin and folate, which is a third route that is neither host biosynthesis nor dietary intake, and it is routinely overstated in supplement discussions. Some colonic uptake of menaquinones and biotin does occur, but the contribution to human status is not quantified. The point worth stating plainly: bacteria in the human colon do make cobalamin, and it cannot be absorbed there, because intrinsic factor dependent uptake by cubilin and amnionless is confined to the ileum, upstream of where the bacteria produce it. Colon ...
endogenous_note_zh: 结肠细菌合成长链甲萘醌（MK-10 至 MK-13，主要来自拟杆菌属）、生物素和叶酸，这是第三条路线，既不属于宿主合成，也不属于膳食摄入，在补充剂讨论中经常被夸大。结肠对甲萘醌和生物素确实有一定摄取，但对人体营养状态的贡献没有被定量。有一点需要直说：人体结肠中的细菌确实生成钴胺素，而它在那里无法被吸收，因为依赖内因子、由 cubilin 和 amnionless 介导的摄取只发生在回肠，位于细菌产生它的部位之上游。因此结肠 B12 合成对 B12 状态毫无帮助，纯素者仍然需要膳食或补充来源。
pathway: Bacterial pathways in the colonic lumen: menaquinone biosynthesis through the men gene cluster and de novo corrinoid synthesis by Bacteroides, Propionibacterium and others. Host handling of what can be absorbed: SMVT (SLC5A6) for biotin, PCFT (SLC46A1) and the reduced folate carrier for folate. For B12 the host route is haptocorrin bindin ...
pathway_zh: 结肠腔内的细菌途径：经 men 基因簇合成甲萘醌，拟杆菌属、丙酸杆菌属等从头合成咕啉类化合物。宿主对可吸收部分的处理：生物素经 SMVT（SLC5A6），叶酸经 PCFT（SLC46A1）和还原型叶酸载体。B12 的宿主路径是：与结合咕啉结合，胃酸和胃蛋白酶释放，胃壁细胞提供内因子，随后在回肠上皮细胞由 cubilin 与 amnionless 介导摄取，血中由转钴胺素运输，组织经 CD320 摄取，整个过程没有任何结肠环节。
daily_amount: Contribution of colonic microbial synthesis to human vitamin status: NOT ESTABLISHED in µg/d for menaquinones, biotin and folate, and effectively 0 µg/d absorbable for vitamin B12. Reference points: biotin AI 30 µg/d, fo ...
daily_amount_zh: 结肠微生物合成对人体维生素状态的贡献：甲萘醌、生物素和叶酸的贡献量（µg/d）NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立），维生素B12 可吸收量实际为 0 µg/d。参照点：生物素 AI 30 µg/d，叶酸 RDA 400 µg DFE/d，维生素B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d，维生素K AI 男性 120 µg/d ...
still_matters_when: Vitamin B12 supplementation is genuinely required for vegans and long-term vegetarians, in pernicious anaemia, after gastrectomy or ileal resection, with metformin and long-term proton pump inhibitor use, and in older adults with atrophic gastritis, and colonic bacterial production never substitutes for it. Broad-spectrum antibiotics and colectomy reduce whatever microbial contribution exists for  ...
still_matters_when_zh: 纯素者和长期素食者、恶性贫血、胃切除或回肠切除后、使用二甲双胍和长期使用质子泵抑制剂者、以及伴萎缩性胃炎的老年人，确实需要补充维生素B12，结肠细菌的生成永远不能替代。广谱抗生素和结肠切除会削弱甲萘醌和生物素方面本就存在的那部分微生物贡献。
source: Ileal, intrinsic factor dependent B12 absorption via cubilin and amnionless: Nielsen MJ, Rasmussen MR, Andersen CB, Nexo E, Moestrup SK. Vitamin B12 transport f ...

endogenous_note: Berberine is a protoberberine isoquinoline alkaloid made by plants such as Coptis chinensis, Berberis species and Hydrastis canadensis. Human cells do form the upstream benzylisoquinolines: norlaudanosoline, 1(S)-reticuline and morphine were identified in human SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma and DAN-G pancreatic carcinoma cells and shown by labelled-precursor feeding to be of biosynthetic origin (PMID 15383669). What humans lack is berberine bridge enzyme and the protoberberine steps beyond reticuline, so every milligram of berberine in the blood came from a plant or a factory. The endogenous axis therefore cannot argue a ...
endogenous_note_zh: 小檗碱是原小檗碱型异喹啉生物碱, 由 Coptis chinensis, Berberis 属和 Hydrastis canadensis 等植物合成。人细胞确实能生成上游的苄基异喹啉: 在人 SH-SY5Y 神经母细胞瘤细胞和 DAN-G 胰腺癌细胞中鉴定出 norlaudanosoline, 1(S)-reticuline 和吗啡, 并用标记前体喂养证明它们来自生物合成 (PMID 15383669)。人缺的是 berberine bridge enzyme 以及 reticuline 之后的原小檗碱步骤, 所以血中每一毫克小檗碱都来自植物或工厂。因此内源合成这条轴既不能反对小檗碱, 也不能支持它; 判断依据是试验数据, 很差的口服生物利用度和药物相互作用负担。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for berberine itself. The plant benzylisoquinoline route runs from L-tyrosine through (S)-norcoclaurine and (S)-reticuline, then berberine bridge enzyme to (S)-scoulerine and on to berberine. Humans reach reticuline as part of the endogenous morphine pathway (PMID 15383669) but have no berberine bridge enzyme and none of th ...
pathway_zh: 对小檗碱本身 NOT APPLICABLE。植物苄基异喹啉途径从 L-tyrosine 经 (S)-norcoclaurine 和 (S)-reticuline, 再由 berberine bridge enzyme 生成 (S)-scoulerine 并继续生成小檗碱。人能走到 reticuline (内源吗啡途径的一部分, PMID 15383669), 但没有 berberine bridge enzyme, 也没有其下游的原小檗碱步骤。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway for berberine)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有小檗碱的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Every dose is exogenous by definition, so this axis is silent. Screen instead on clinical effect size, the low and variable oral bioavailability, and drug interactions through P-glycoprotein and CYP inhibition.
still_matters_when_zh: 按定义每一剂都是外源的, 所以这条轴没有发言权。改用临床效应量, 低且波动的口服生物利用度, 以及通过 P-glycoprotein 和 CYP 抑制产生的药物相互作用来筛查。
source: PMID 27671811 (Cicero AF, Adv Exp Med Biol 2016, Berberine and Its Role in Chronic Disease); PMID 15383669 (Poeaknapo C, PNAS 2004;101:14091-6, endogenous forma ...

endogenous_note: The active constituents are withanolides, steroidal lactones such as withaferin A and withanolide A, built in the plant from mevalonate-derived sterols. Humans make sterols but not withanolides, and there is no human enzyme that produces the withanolide lactone ring. Nothing about ashwagandha can be framed as replacing something the body has run short of.
endogenous_note_zh: 活性成分是 withanolides, 即 withaferin A 和 withanolide A 这类甾体内酯, 在植物体内由甲羟戊酸途径来源的甾醇构建。人能合成甾醇, 不能合成 withanolides, 也没有任何人类酶能生成 withanolide 的内酯环。因此不能把服用南非醉茄说成补充身体短缺的东西。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Withanolide biosynthesis proceeds in Withania somnifera from 24-methylenecholesterol through plant cytochrome P450 oxidations; absent from human tissue.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Withanolide 的生物合成在 Withania somnifera 中由 24-methylenecholesterol 经植物 cytochrome P450 氧化完成; 人体组织中不存在该途径。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on trial quality for the claimed indication (stress, sleep, testosterone), extract standardisation to withanolide content, and reported hepatotoxicity and thyroid effects.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用所声称适应症 (压力, 睡眠, 睾酮) 的试验质量, 提取物按 withanolide 含量的标准化, 以及已报告的肝毒性和甲状腺影响来筛查。
source: PMID 37063285 (Bashir A, Front Pharmacol 2023, An updated review on phytochemistry and molecular targets of Withania somnifera)

endogenous_note: The marker compounds are salidroside, a tyrosol glucoside, plus the cinnamyl glycosides rosavin, rosin and rosarin, all made in the rhizome. Tyrosol itself occurs endogenously in humans as a metabolite of tyramine (tyramine to 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde to tyrosol), and hydroxytyrosol arises the same way from dopamine, so the aglycone is present in humans. The missing capability is the specific UDP-glucosyltransferase that forms the salidroside O-glucoside, since human phase II conjugation of phenols runs to glucuronides and sulfates, and there is no route to the cinnamyl glycosides. NONE stands for salidroside  ...
endogenous_note_zh: 标志物是 salidroside (酪醇葡糖苷) 以及 cinnamyl 糖苷 rosavin, rosin 和 rosarin, 都在根茎中合成。酪醇本身在人体内源存在, 由 tyramine 代谢而来 (tyramine 经 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde 生成酪醇), 羟基酪醇同样由多巴胺经这条路生成, 所以苷元在人体中是有的。缺的是形成 salidroside O-葡糖苷的那个特定 UDP-glucosyltransferase, 因为人对酚类的二相结合走葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化, 而且也没有生成 cinnamyl 糖苷的途径。对 salidroside 和 rosavins 而言 NONE 成立, 所以这条轴既不给出服用的理由, 也不给出否定的理由, 判断完全落到临床证据上。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for salidroside and the rosavins. Plant phenylpropanoid and shikimate routes in Rhodiola rosea rhizome produce tyrosol, salidroside and the rosavins. Tyrosol is endogenous in humans via tyramine, but no human glucosyltransferase forms the salidroside O-glucoside and no human enzyme assembles the cinnamyl glycosides.
pathway_zh: 对 salidroside 和 rosavins 为 NOT APPLICABLE。Rhodiola rosea 根茎中的植物苯丙烷类和莽草酸途径生成酪醇, salidroside 和 rosavins。酪醇在人体经 tyramine 内源生成, 但没有人类 glucosyltransferase 形成 salidroside 的 O-葡糖苷, 也没有人类酶组装 cinnamyl 糖苷。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway for salidroside or the rosavins)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有合成 salidroside 或 rosavins 的途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on standardisation (typically 3 percent rosavins and 1 percent salidroside), frequent species substitution in commerce, and the modest and inconsistent trial evidence for fatigue and exercise performance.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用标准化 (通常 3% rosavins 和 1% salidroside), 商业上常见的物种冒充, 以及在疲劳和运动表现方面有限且不一致的试验证据来筛查。
source: PMID 37641937 (Tinsley GM, Br J Nutr 2024, Rhodiola rosea as an adaptogen to enhance exercise performance)

endogenous_note: Valerian's activity is attributed to valerenic acid and the valepotriates, sesquiterpenes whose carbon skeleton is built by a plant terpene synthase (valerenadiene synthase) found in Valeriana officinalis roots. Humans use farnesyl diphosphate for sterols, dolichol, the polyprenyl side chain of ubiquinone (CoQ10), the farnesyl group of heme A and protein farnesylation and geranylgeranylation, and have no sesquiterpene cyclase to close a valerenane ring. So nothing in a valerian capsule is endogenous, a deficiency framing is unavailable, and the modest and inconsistent insomnia evidence has to stand on its own.
endogenous_note_zh: 缬草的作用被归于 valerenic acid 和 valepotriates, 这些倍半萜的碳骨架由 Valeriana officinalis 根中的植物萜类合成酶 (valerenadiene synthase) 构建。人把 farnesyl diphosphate 用于甾醇, dolichol, 泛醌 (CoQ10) 的多聚异戊烯侧链, heme A 的法尼基基团以及蛋白的法尼基化和香叶基香叶基化, 但没有能闭合 valerenane 环的倍半萜环化酶。所以缬草胶囊里没有任何内源成分, 缺乏这套说法用不上, 有限且不一致的失眠证据只能自己站住。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Farnesyl diphosphate is cyclised by the plant sesquiterpene synthase valerenadiene synthase in Valeriana officinalis, then oxidised to valerenic acid. Human farnesyl diphosphate goes to sterols, dolichol, ubiquinone, heme A and prenylated proteins; there is no human sesquiterpene cyclase.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。在 Valeriana officinalis 中, farnesyl diphosphate 由植物倍半萜合成酶 valerenadiene synthase 环化, 再氧化为 valerenic acid。人的 farnesyl diphosphate 去向是甾醇, dolichol, 泛醌, heme A 和异戊烯化蛋白; 人体没有倍半萜环化酶。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the weak and heterogeneous insomnia trial data, wide variation in valerenic acid content between products, and additive sedation with alcohol and benzodiazepines.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用薄弱且异质的失眠试验数据, 不同产品间 valerenic acid 含量的巨大差异, 以及与酒精和苯二氮类的镇静叠加来筛查。
source: PMID 34898176 (Zinck GE, Biochemistry 2021, Structurally Guided Reprogramming of Valerenadiene Synthase)

endogenous_note: Standardised extracts contain flavonol glycosides of quercetin and kaempferol plus the terpene trilactones ginkgolide A, B, C, J and bilobalide, a group of molecules found only in Ginkgo biloba. No human tissue produces flavonoids or ginkgolides, so intake is entirely exogenous. That removes any deficiency-correction claim and leaves the outcome trials, which have been largely negative for preventing cognitive decline.
endogenous_note_zh: 标准化提取物含槲皮素和山奈酚的黄酮醇糖苷, 以及萜类三内酯 ginkgolide A, B, C, J 和 bilobalide, 这组分子只见于 Ginkgo biloba。人体任何组织都不产生类黄酮或银杏内酯, 所以摄入完全是外源的。这样一来纠正缺乏的说法就不成立, 只剩结局试验, 而这些试验在预防认知衰退上大体为阴性。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Flavonoids arise from the plant phenylpropanoid pathway and the terpene trilactones from plant terpenoid biosynthesis unique to Ginkgo biloba; neither pathway exists in humans.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。类黄酮来自植物苯丙烷类途径, 萜类三内酯来自 Ginkgo biloba 特有的植物萜类生物合成; 这两条途径人体都没有。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the negative large prevention trials, extract standardisation (EGb 761 type: 24 percent flavone glycosides, 6 percent terpene lactones), and bleeding risk with antiplatelet and anticoagulant drugs.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用大型预防试验的阴性结果, 提取物标准化 (EGb 761 型: 24% 黄酮糖苷, 6% 萜内酯), 以及与抗血小板和抗凝药合用的出血风险来筛查。
source: PMID 26604665 (Nash KM, Integr Med Insights 2015, Current Perspectives on the Beneficial Role of Ginkgo biloba in Neurological and Cerebrovascular Disorders)

endogenous_note: The active fraction is the bacosides, dammarane-type triterpenoid saponins from the plant. Humans cyclise 2,3-oxidosqualene through the protosteryl cation to lanosterol and then to cholesterol and have no dammarenediol synthase, so the dammarane skeleton is never formed at all, and no human glycosyltransferase attaches the bacoside sugar chains. There is no endogenous pool to top up, so the case rests on the cognition trials, which show a small effect on memory acquisition after weeks of dosing.
endogenous_note_zh: 活性组分是 bacosides, 属植物来源的达玛烷型三萜皂苷。人把 2,3-oxidosqualene 经原甾醇正离子环化为 lanosterol 再到胆固醇, 没有 dammarenediol synthase, 所以达玛烷骨架在人体中根本不会形成, 也没有人类 glycosyltransferase 接上 bacoside 的糖链。没有内源池可补, 所以判断靠认知试验, 而这些试验显示连续给药数周后对记忆获得有小幅作用。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant triterpenoid saponin biosynthesis in Bacopa monnieri routes 2,3-oxidosqualene through the dammarenyl cation via dammarenediol synthase, then glycosyltransferases. Human oxidosqualene cyclase routes the same substrate through the protosteryl cation to lanosterol, so no dammarane intermediate exists in humans.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Bacopa monnieri 的植物三萜皂苷合成把 2,3-oxidosqualene 经达玛烯基正离子由 dammarenediol synthase 处理, 再经 glycosyltransferases 糖基化。人的 oxidosqualene cyclase 把同一底物经原甾醇正离子导向 lanosterol, 所以人体中不存在达玛烷中间体。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the small measured effect (chiefly delayed word recall), the 12 week timescale before any effect appears, bacoside standardisation, and gastrointestinal side effects.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用实测效应之小 (主要是延迟词语回忆), 起效需要 12 周的时间尺度, bacoside 标准化, 以及胃肠道不良反应来筛查。
source: PMID 24252493 (Kongkeaw C, J Ethnopharmacol 2014, Meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials on cognitive effects of Bacopa monnieri extract)

endogenous_note: The compounds of interest are hericenones from the fruiting body, polyketide-terpenoid hybrids (meroterpenoids) built on a polyketide-derived resorcinol or benzaldehyde core carrying an added prenyl or geranyl chain and a fatty acyl group, and erinacines, cyathane diterpenoids, from the mycelium. These are fungal metabolites; human cells produce neither, and human cells also do not need them for anything. Any benefit has to come from the pharmacology of an ingested fungal compound, and the human evidence is one small trial in mild cognitive impairment (30 subjects, 16 weeks of dosing) with scores falling back 4 w ...
endogenous_note_zh: 受关注的成分是子实体中的 hericenones, 属聚酮与萜类的杂合分子 (meroterpenoids), 核心是聚酮来源的间苯二酚或苯甲醛结构, 上面带异戊烯或香叶基链和脂肪酰基; 以及菌丝体中的 erinacines, 属 cyathane 二萜。这些都是真菌代谢物; 人细胞既不产生它们, 也不需要它们做任何事。任何益处只能来自摄入真菌化合物的药理作用, 而人体证据是一项轻度认知障碍的小型试验 (30 名受试者, 给药 16 周), 停药 4 周后评分回落。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Hericenones are fungal polyketide-terpenoid hybrids (meroterpenoids) and erinacines are cyathane diterpenoids, both made in Hericium erinaceus; no human pathway to either.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Hericenones 是真菌聚酮萜类杂合物 (meroterpenoids), erinacines 是 cyathane 二萜, 两者都在 Hericium erinaceus 中生成; 人体对两者都没有合成途径。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the thin human evidence base (30 subjects, 16 weeks, benefit lost 4 weeks after cessation), whether a product is fruiting body or grain-based mycelium, and the fact that nerve growth factor induction is a cell and rodent finding rather than a human one.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用人体证据之薄 (30 名受试者, 16 周, 停药 4 周后获益消失), 产品是子实体还是谷物基菌丝体, 以及神经生长因子诱导只是细胞和啮齿类的发现, 不是人体发现, 来筛查。
source: PMID 18844328 (Mori K, Phytother Res 2009, Improving effects of the mushroom Yamabushitake (Hericium erinaceus) on mild cognitive impairment)

endogenous_note: The relevant constituents are hypericin, a naphthodianthrone, and hyperforin, a prenylated phloroglucinol, both made only by Hypericum perforatum. Humans synthesise neither, so nothing here is replacement. On this one the axis being silent matters less than the interaction profile: hyperforin activates PXR and induces CYP3A4, which cuts blood levels of oral contraceptives, ciclosporin, warfarin and HIV protease inhibitors.
endogenous_note_zh: 相关成分是 hypericin (一种萘骈二蒽酮) 和 hyperforin (一种异戊烯化间苯三酚), 只由 Hypericum perforatum 合成。人两者都不合成, 所以这里谈不上替代。这一条上, 这条轴无话可说的意义远小于相互作用特征: hyperforin 激活 PXR 并诱导 CYP3A4, 会降低口服避孕药, 环孢素, 华法林和 HIV 蛋白酶抑制剂的血药水平。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant polyketide and phloroglucinol pathways in Hypericum perforatum; no human homologue.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Hypericum perforatum 中的植物聚酮和间苯三酚途径; 人体没有同源途径。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. The screening question is drug interaction, not deficiency: CYP3A4 induction by hyperforin plus serotonergic additivity with SSRIs and triptans. Also check hyperforin content, since low-hyperforin extracts induce far less.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。筛查要问药物相互作用, 与缺乏无关: hyperforin 诱导 CYP3A4, 加上与 SSRI 和曲普坦的血清素能叠加。还要看 hyperforin 含量, 低 hyperforin 提取物的诱导作用弱得多。
source: PMID 13129991 (Markowitz JS, JAMA 2003;290:1500-4, Effect of St John's wort on drug metabolism by induction of cytochrome P450 3A4 enzyme)

endogenous_note: Every serotonin-producing cell makes its own 5-HTP continuously from dietary tryptophan, and none of it accumulates because the next enzyme converts it straight to serotonin. The label is INTERMEDIATE rather than FULL because 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, no dietary requirement and no measurable body pool, so a FULL label implying adequate endogenous quantity has no quantity to attach to. Tryptophan hydroxylase is the rate-limiting and regulated step, and swallowing 5-HTP forces the pathway past that control point. The consequence is serotonin production wherever aromatic L-ami ...
endogenous_note_zh: 每个产血清素的细胞都在用膳食色氨酸持续生成自己的 5-HTP, 而且不会积累, 因为下一个酶立刻把它转成血清素。这里标 INTERMEDIATE 不标 FULL, 因为 5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 没有膳食需要量, 也没有可测的体内池, 所以 FULL 所暗示的内源量根本没有数字可挂。tryptophan hydroxylase 是限速且受调控的一步, 口服 5-HTP 会把途径推过这个控制点。结果是在任何有 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的地方生成血清素, 主要是肠道, 而全身大部分血清素本来就在那里, 所以补充带来的是失控, 不构成对短缺的纠正。
pathway: L-tryptophan to 5-HTP by tryptophan hydroxylase (TPH1 in gut and pancreatic enterochromaffin cells, pinealocytes, mast cells, mononuclear leukocytes, spleen, thymus, pancreatic beta cells and peripheral tissues including heart, lung, kidney, duodenum, adrenal and female reproductive tract; TPH2 in raphe neurons). The liver is not a TPH1 s ...
pathway_zh: L-tryptophan 经 tryptophan hydroxylase 生成 5-HTP (TPH1 分布于肠道和胰腺的嗜铬细胞, 松果体细胞, 肥大细胞, 单核白细胞, 脾, 胸腺, 胰腺 beta 细胞, 以及心, 肺, 肾, 十二指肠, 肾上腺和女性生殖道等外周组织; TPH2 在中脑背侧的中脑背核神经元)。肝不是 TPH1 的部位: 肝内血清素来自血小板和肠道。TPH 限速并处于亚饱和状态, 因为它对色氨酸的 Km 接近或高于组织中实际的色氨酸浓度, 这也是色氨酸 ...
daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED. 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, and whole-body synthesis flux has not been quantified in humans. Flux anchor for scale: only about 1 to 2 percent of tryptophan flux ente ...
daily_amount_zh: NOT ESTABLISHED。5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 全身合成通量在人体中未被定量。用于把握量级的通量参照: 色氨酸通量只有约 1% 至 2% 进入羟化酶这条路, 超过 90% 走 kynurenine 途径, 所以 100 mg 的口服剂量远高于它所进入的那条生理支路。
still_matters_when: Only where bypassing tryptophan hydroxylase regulation is the deliberate aim, and preferably with a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor such as carbidopa to steer conversion centrally, as used in research settings. Otherwise NEVER ON THIS AXIS: tryptophan intake is the physiological lever, and unopposed 5-HTP alongside an SSRI or MAOI is a serotonin toxicity risk.
still_matters_when_zh: 只在刻意要绕过 tryptophan hydroxylase 调控时才有意义, 并且最好像研究场景那样合用外周脱羧酶抑制剂 (例如 carbidopa) 把转化引向中枢。其他情况 NEVER ON THIS AXIS: 色氨酸摄入才是生理杠杆, 而在使用 SSRI 或 MAOI 时单独加 5-HTP 有血清素毒性风险。
source: PMID 16023217 (Turner EH, Pharmacol Ther 2006;109:325-38, Serotonin a la carte: supplementation with the serotonin precursor 5-hydroxytryptophan)

endogenous_note: SAMe is not a botanical at all; it is the body's universal methyl donor, made in every cell from methionine and ATP and most heavily in the liver, so a healthy person cannot be deficient in it and oral SAMe is a pharmacological dose rather than a replacement. There is one CONDITIONAL carve-out: in chronic liver disease and cholestasis, MAT1A activity and hepatic SAMe fall, which is the only setting with a mechanistic replacement case. This row was split out of a combined saffron and SAMe row, because a single label cannot cover members sitting at opposite ends of the axis.
endogenous_note_zh: SAMe 完全不是植物成分; 它是全身通用的甲基供体, 每个细胞都能用 methionine 和 ATP 合成, 肝脏合成量最大, 所以健康人不会缺它, 口服 SAMe 属药理剂量, 不构成替代。有一个 CONDITIONAL 的例外: 慢性肝病和胆汁淤积时 MAT1A 活性和肝内 SAMe 下降, 这是唯一有机制依据的替代场景。本行是从原先把藏红花与 SAMe 合在一起的行里拆出来的, 因为一个标签无法覆盖处在这条轴两端的成员。
pathway: L-methionine plus ATP, catalysed by methionine adenosyltransferase (MAT1A in liver, MAT2A in other tissues); the liver metabolises about 50 percent of dietary methionine and hosts up to 85 percent of all transmethylation reactions. SAMe donates its methyl group to give S-adenosylhomocysteine, then homocysteine, which is either remethylate ...
pathway_zh: L-methionine 加 ATP, 由 methionine adenosyltransferase 催化 (肝为 MAT1A, 其他组织为 MAT2A); 肝代谢约 50% 的膳食 methionine, 并承担全身多达 85% 的转甲基反应。SAMe 交出甲基后生成 S-adenosylhomocysteine, 继而生成同型半胱氨酸, 后者或被再甲基化 (MTR, BHMT), 或进入转硫途径 (CBS)。
daily_amount: Not directly measured as a synthesis rate, but bounded by measured whole-body methionine transmethylation flux, which stable-isotope tracer work puts at a level corresponding to roughly a few grams of SAMe turnover per d ...
daily_amount_zh: 没有作为合成速率被直接测定, 但可由已测得的全身 methionine 转甲基通量给出上界, 稳定同位素示踪研究对应的 SAMe 每日周转量在 70 kg 成人约为数克 (Storch KJ, Am J Physiol 1988;255:E322-31, 用 [methyl-2H3]- 和 [1-13C]methion ...
still_matters_when: Chronic liver disease and cholestasis, where MAT activity and hepatic SAMe are genuinely reduced, is the one setting with a mechanistic replacement case. The mood indication is pharmacological, and it carries serotonergic additivity with antidepressants.
still_matters_when_zh: 慢性肝病和胆汁淤积中 MAT 活性和肝内 SAMe 确实降低, 这是唯一有机制依据的替代场景。情绪适应症属药理用途, 并且与抗抑郁药存在血清素能叠加。
source: PMID 23073625 (Lu SC & Mato JM, Physiol Rev 2012;92:1515-42, DOI 10.1152/physrev.00047.2011); PMID 23396728 (Mato JM, Ann Hepatol 2013;12:183-9); Storch KJ, Am  ...

supplement: Saffron and other plant mood botanicals
endogenous_note: Saffron's constituents are apocarotenoids, the crocins plus crocetin, picrocrocin and safranal, cleaved from zeaxanthin in Crocus sativus stigmas. Human tissue makes no part of them, so the axis is silent and the case rests entirely on trial evidence. This row was split from the former combined saffron and SAMe row, which carried a single FULL label over members at opposite ends of the axis.
endogenous_note_zh: 藏红花的成分是脱辅基类胡萝卜素, 即 crocins 以及 crocetin, picrocrocin 和 safranal, 由 Crocus sativus 柱头中的玉米黄质裂解而来。人体组织不合成其中任何部分, 所以这条轴无话可说, 判断完全依赖试验证据。本行从原先藏红花与 SAMe 合并的那一行拆出, 那一行用一个 FULL 标签盖住了处在轴两端的成员。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Apocarotenoids cleaved from zeaxanthin by carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase in Crocus sativus stigmas; no human counterpart.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。在 Crocus sativus 柱头中由 carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase 裂解玉米黄质生成脱辅基类胡萝卜素; 人体没有对应途径。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on trial size and independence (small trials, several from the same groups), adulteration of an expensive spice with dyed safflower or turmeric, the 28 to 30 mg/day extract dose used in trials, and serotonergic additivity.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用试验规模和独立性 (样本小, 多项出自同一批研究者), 昂贵香料被红花或姜黄染色掺假, 试验所用 28 至 30 mg/day 的提取物剂量, 以及血清素能叠加来筛查。
source: PMID 25384672 (Lopresti AL & Drummond PD, Hum Psychopharmacol 2014, Saffron for depression)

endogenous_note: Psyllium is a highly branched arabinoxylan that no human enzyme can cleave, which is the operational meaning of dietary fibre. Being non-digestible is the mechanism: the husk holds water into a viscous gel and the gel does the work on stool form and transit. So the axis has nothing to say against it, and psyllium is the one fibre with reasonable randomised support in IBS.
endogenous_note_zh: 车前子壳是高度分支的阿拉伯木聚糖, 人体没有酶能切开它, 这就是膳食纤维的操作性含义。不可消化本身就是机制: 壳把水保持成粘性凝胶, 凝胶作用于大便形态和转运。所以这条轴没有反对它的理由, 而车前子是在 IBS 中拥有较合理随机证据的那一种纤维。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Dietary fibre is defined by resistance to human digestive enzymes; humans lack the glycoside hydrolases that would depolymerise the arabinoxylan backbone.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。膳食纤维的定义就是耐受人体消化酶; 人缺少能把阿拉伯木聚糖主链解聚的糖苷水解酶。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway; intake is the only variable)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有生物合成途径; 摄入量是唯一变量)
still_matters_when: Every gram must be eaten, so intake is the whole question. In primary care IBS (n=275: 85 psyllium, 97 bran, 93 placebo, ages 18 to 65), 10 g/day psyllium gave adequate symptom relief in 57 percent versus 35 percent on placebo at month 1 (RR 1.60, 95 percent CI 1.13 to 2.26), also favoured psyllium at month 2 (59 percent versus 41 percent, RR 1.44, 95 percent CI 1.02 to 2.06), and reduced symptom  ...
still_matters_when_zh: 每一克都得吃进去, 所以摄入量就是全部问题。在基层医疗的 IBS 人群中 (n=275: 车前子 85 例, 麦麸 97 例, 安慰剂 93 例, 年龄 18 至 65 岁), 10 g/day 车前子在第 1 个月使 57% 的人症状得到充分缓解, 安慰剂为 35% (RR 1.60, 95% CI 1.13 至 2.26); 第 2 个月同样占优 (59% 对 41%, RR 1.44, 95% CI 1.02 至 2.06); 3 个月时症状严重度评分下降 90 分, 安慰剂为 49 分 (P=0.03)。从小剂量开始逐步加量, 因为胀气和腹胀与剂 ...
source: PMID 19713235 (Bijkerk CJ, BMJ 2009;339:b3154, Soluble or insoluble fibre in irritable bowel syndrome in primary care?); PMID 24725724 (Jones JM, Nutr J 2014, C ...

supplement: Wheat bran and insoluble fibre supplements for IBS
endogenous_note: Insoluble bran is non-digestible by definition, so nothing about it is endogenous and every gram is eaten. Here the axis being silent is not a licence, and the trial record has to be reported in full: in the same primary care trial that supported psyllium, 10 g/day bran did beat placebo at month 3 in the primary analysis (adequate relief 57 percent versus 32 percent, RR 1.70, 95 percent CI 1.12 to 2.57) but not in the worst-case sensitivity analysis of that same result (RR 1.45, 95 percent CI 0.97 to 2.16), and it reduced symptom severity by only 58 points versus 49 for placebo (P=0.61), with symptoms often worse ...
endogenous_note_zh: 不可溶麦麸按定义不可消化, 所以其中没有内源成分, 每一克都靠吃。这里这条轴无话可说并不等于放行, 而试验结果要完整报告: 在支持车前子的同一项基层医疗试验中, 10 g/day 麦麸在第 3 个月的主分析里确实优于安慰剂 (充分缓解 57% 对 32%, RR 1.70, 95% CI 1.12 至 2.57), 但在同一结果的最差情形敏感性分析中不显著 (RR 1.45, 95% CI 0.97 至 2.16); 症状严重度只下降 58 分, 安慰剂为 49 分 (P=0.61), 头几周症状常加重, 三组中脱落最多 (完成率: 车前子 64%, 麦麸 56%, 安慰剂 60%)。天然粗纤维本身仍不构成理由, 麦麸的信号比车前子更弱也更不稳定。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Insoluble cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin resist human digestive enzymes; no human synthesis and no human requirement for this specific material.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。不可溶的纤维素, 半纤维素和木质素耐受人体消化酶; 人体不合成它, 对这类具体材料也没有需要量。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis, and the trial evidence for bran in IBS is inconsistent: significant at month 3 in the primary analysis, null in the worst-case analysis, no effect on symptom severity, early worsening and the highest dropout. Insoluble fibre still has a role in ordinary constipation and general diet quality; in IBS, prefer a soluble gel-forming fibre.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由, 而麦麸在 IBS 中的试验证据不一致: 第 3 个月主分析显著, 最差情形分析为阴性, 对症状严重度无效, 早期加重, 脱落率最高。不可溶纤维在普通便秘和整体膳食质量上仍有作用; 在 IBS 中优先选可溶性成胶纤维。
source: PMID 19713235 (Bijkerk CJ, BMJ 2009;339:b3154); PMID 24725724 (Jones JM, Nutr J 2014)

endogenous_note: Inulin and fructo-oligosaccharides are beta(2->1) fructans, and commercial galacto-oligosaccharides are galactose oligomers of DP2 to DP6 usually carrying a terminal glucose, produced by beta-galactosidase transgalactosylation of lactose, so they are mixed galactose and glucose oligosaccharides rather than galactose homopolymers. The 2017 ISAPP consensus defines a prebiotic as a substrate that is selectively utilized by host microorganisms conferring a health benefit; it deliberately moved away from non-digestibility and imposes no such requirement, so the operative criteria are selective utilisation plus a demon ...
endogenous_note_zh: 菊粉和低聚果糖是 beta(2->1) 果聚糖, 商品化的低聚半乳糖是 DP2 至 DP6 的半乳糖寡聚物, 末端通常带一个葡萄糖, 由 beta-galactosidase 对乳糖进行转半乳糖基化制得, 因此是半乳糖与葡萄糖的混合寡糖, 不是半乳糖均聚物。2017 年 ISAPP 共识把益生元定义为被宿主微生物选择性利用并带来健康益处的底物; 该共识有意不再用不可消化性, 也没有这项要求, 所以实际判据是选择性利用加上已证实的健康益处。不可消化性仍然是常见果聚糖和 DP3 及以上 GOS 的实际性质, 也是它们能到结肠被发酵的原因。这里没有内源成分, 所以真正的问题是剂量耐受性, 因为产生益处的发酵同时产生气体。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE, with a degree-of-polymerisation caveat. Humans lack inulinase and beta-fructofuranosidase, and 96 +/- 25 percent of FOS with DP>=2 is recovered intact at the distal ileum. GOS at DP3 to DP6 also passes unchanged, but most GOS DP2 is hydrolysed by host brush-border enzymes in a linkage-dependent way, roughly 77 to 81 percen ...
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE, 但要按聚合度加限定。人缺 inulinase 和 beta-fructofuranosidase, DP>=2 的 FOS 有 96 +/- 25% 在远端回肠被完整回收。DP3 至 DP6 的 GOS 也原样通过, 但大部分 DP2 的 GOS 被宿主刷状缘酶按键型差异水解, beta(1<->1), beta(1->2) 和 beta(1->3) 约 77% 至 81%, beta(1->4) 和 beta(1->6) 约 32% 至 56 ...
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway; intake is the only variable). Note that the ISAPP 2017 definition imposes no non-digestibility requirement, so the axis argument here rests on the measured ileal recovery figures rather  ...
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有生物合成途径; 摄入量是唯一变量)。注意 ISAPP 2017 定义并未要求不可消化, 所以这条轴上的论证依据是实测的回肠回收率, 不是定义本身。
still_matters_when: All intake is dietary, so dose is the lever. Reasonable where the aim is to shift colonic fermentation, discounting the GOS DP2 fraction as host-digested, with the caveat that fermentable oligosaccharides are the F in FODMAP and often provoke bloating and pain in IBS at the doses used in studies.
still_matters_when_zh: 全部摄入来自膳食, 所以剂量是杠杆。若目标是改变结肠发酵, 使用是合理的, 计算时要把被宿主消化的 GOS DP2 部分扣掉; 需注意可发酵寡糖正是 FODMAP 里的 F, 在研究所用剂量下常在 IBS 中引起腹胀和腹痛。
source: PMID 28611480 (Gibson GR, Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2017;14:491-502, ISAPP consensus statement on the definition and scope of prebiotics); PMC11440495 (GOS  ...

endogenous_note: The synthesis axis does not fit here at all, because these are living organisms rather than molecules, which is why the label is NOT APPLICABLE rather than NONE: forcing NONE would make a live organism look like a plant alkaloid on a screening table. Human cells cannot manufacture a bacterium, and the resident microbiome is acquired at birth and from the environment and then renews itself, so nobody is deficient in a strain the way someone is deficient in a vitamin. The honest test for a probiotic is strain-level trial evidence for a named indication, since effects do not transfer between strains, let alone betwe ...
endogenous_note_zh: 合成这条轴在这里完全不适用, 因为对象是活体生物, 不是分子, 所以标签用 NOT APPLICABLE 而不用 NONE: 硬套 NONE 会让活菌在筛查表上看起来像一种植物生物碱。人细胞无法制造细菌, 常驻菌群在出生时和从环境中获得, 之后自我更新, 所以没人会像缺某种维生素那样缺某一个菌株。对益生菌诚实的检验标准是针对具体适应症的菌株级试验证据, 因为效应在菌株之间不能移植, 跨物种更不行。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are acquired, not synthesised. The resident microbiota is self-renewing and is defined by colonisation history rather than by any host biosynthetic capacity.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠获得, 不靠合成。常驻菌群自我更新, 由定植史决定, 与宿主的任何生物合成能力无关。
daily_amount: 0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism). No daily requirement exists; the resident microbiota replaces itself.
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)。不存在每日需要量; 常驻菌群自我替换。
still_matters_when: Where a specific, fully identified strain has randomised evidence for a specific indication, and in settings of documented disruption such as after antibiotics. Ingested strains are generally transient passengers and are cleared within days to weeks of stopping, so any benefit lasts only as long as dosing.
still_matters_when_zh: 当某个完全鉴定到菌株水平的具体菌株对具体适应症有随机证据时, 以及在有明确菌群扰动的场景 (例如抗生素之后)。摄入的菌株一般只是过路乘客, 停用后数天到数周内被清除, 所以获益只维持在持续服用期间。
source: PMID 24912386 (Hill C, Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-14, ISAPP consensus statement on the scope and appropriate use of the term probiotic); PMID 168 ...

endogenous_note: Same axis mismatch as any probiotic, with an additional problem specific to blends: labels that name only genus and species carry no evidence, because probiotic effects are strain-specific. Laboratory checking of commercial products supports this concern, though the cited evidence is one survey: Kesavelu 2020 tested 20 products sold in India (8 single-strain, 12 multi-strain) and reported poor correlation between label and laboratory values for viable count, genus and species identification and contaminants, without giving a numeric mismatch rate. Treat that as a reason to demand independent verification rather t ...

endogenous_note: Both enzymes are made by the body, and both have named states in which that synthesis stops being sufficient, which is what makes them genuine replacement therapy rather than supplements. Lactase is made by small-intestinal enterocytes and its decline after weaning is the normal human pattern; retaining it into adulthood is the derived trait, set by regulatory variants upstream of the LCT gene. Pancreatic enzymes are made by acinar cells, and replacement exists precisely because that synthesis fails in pancreatic disease. So these products are correct in the person with the named condition and pointless in everyo ...
endogenous_note_zh: 这两种酶身体都能合成, 而且都有明确的状态使合成不再够用, 这就是它们属于真正替代治疗而不属于保健补充的原因。乳糖酶由小肠上皮细胞合成, 断奶后活性下降是人类的常态; 成年后仍保留才是衍生性状, 由 LCT 基因上游的调控变异决定。胰酶由腺泡细胞合成, 替代疗法之所以存在, 正因为胰腺疾病使这种合成失效。所以这些产品对有明确诊断的人是对的, 对其他所有人没有意义。
pathway: Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase (LCT) synthesised by enterocytes of the jejunal brush border; adult expression is controlled by MCM6 enhancer variants: -13910C>T in Europeans, -13915T>G in Arabian populations, and -13907C>G and -14010G>C in African populations. Genotyping -13910C>T alone misclassifies most lactase-persistent Africans and Midd ...

The label is MIXED because the same capsule usually carries enzymes whose function the human gut lumen does not perform: fungal alpha-galactosidase for raffinose-family oligosaccharides, fungal cellulase, and the plant proteases bromelain and papain. Humans do synthesise an alpha-galactosidase, the lysosomal alpha-galactosidase A encoded by GLA whose deficiency causes Fabry disease, plus alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA); wha ...

Cellulase: fungal, no human enzyme ...

endogenous_note: These are living organisms, so the synthesis axis does not apply, and in the ICU the argument runs the other way entirely. The largest randomised trial found no reduction in ventilator-associated pneumonia with Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG, and genomic work traced bloodstream isolates in critically ill patients back to the probiotic capsules they had been given. A compromised gut barrier converts a harmless commensal into an exposure, so the absence of endogenous synthesis is no argument for adding one.
endogenous_note_zh: 这些是活体生物, 合成这条轴不适用, 而在 ICU 里论证方向完全相反。规模最大的随机试验发现 Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG 并未降低呼吸机相关肺炎, 基因组学工作把危重患者血流分离株追溯到他们服用的益生菌胶囊。肠屏障受损会把无害的共生菌变成一种暴露, 所以没有内源合成并不构成加用的理由。

Central lines, mucosal injury and immunosuppression are the reasons to withhold rather than to dose.

The screening question that does discriminate is adulteration: analytical surveys of herbal sexual enhancers repeatedly recover undeclared synthetic PDE5 inhibitors, including sildenafil and tadalafil and unlicensed structural analogues. That makes an unregulated capsule an undisclosed prescription drug, with the nitrate intera ...
endogenous_note_zh: 本行只限于植物原料, 主要是 yohimbe 树皮, Epimedium, 玛卡和蒺藜, 其中没有内源成分, 合成这条轴对它们完全无法筛查; 这一类别中真正内源的成员 L-citrulline, L-arginine 和 DHEA 已另列专行。真正能区分的筛查问题是掺假: 对草本性功能产品的分析调查反复检出未申报的合成 PDE5 抑制剂, 包括西地那非, 他达拉非以及未获批的结构类似物。这使一粒不受监管的胶囊成为隐藏的处方药, 并带来相应的硝酸盐相互作用和心脏风险。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant alkaloid, prenylflavonoid and saponin pathways; no human synthesis of yohimbine, icariin or the declared or undeclared PDE5 inhibitors.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。植物生物碱, 异戊烯基黄酮和皂苷途径; 人体不合成 yohimbine, icariin, 也不合成申报或未申报的 PDE5 抑制剂。

Screen on documented adulteration with undeclared PDE5 inhibitors and their analogues, contraindication with nitrates and alpha-blockers, yohimbine's pressor and anxiogenic effects, and the fact that erectile dysfunction is a cardiovascular warning sign that warrants clinical assessment.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用已记录的未申报 PDE5 抑制剂及其类似物掺假, 与硝酸盐和 alpha 受体阻滞剂的禁忌, yohimbine 的升压和致焦虑作用, 以及勃起功能障碍本身是需要临床评估的心血管警示信号来筛查。

endogenous_note: Caffeine, synephrine, green tea catechins and yohimbine are plant compounds with no human biosynthetic route, so the axis is silent on those. The label is MIXED because these blends routinely include ingredients the body does make: L-carnitine, which is endogenously synthesised and is CONDITIONAL in its own right (see its row), and sometimes CLA, whose c9,t11 isomer has a partial human route. endogenous_note_zh: 咖啡因, 辛弗林, 绿茶儿茶素和 yohimbine 是植物化合物, 人体没有合成途径, 所以这条轴对它们无话可说。标签用 MIXED, 因为这类复方常含身体确实能合成的成分: L-carnitine 属内源合成, 本身状态为 CONDITIONAL (见其专行), 有时还含 CLA, 其 c9,t11 异构体在人体有部分生成途径。这条轴也不是这一类别的正确筛查工具, 该类别反复出现的分析发现是未申报药物, 包括已撤市的减食欲药西布曲明和禁用兴奋剂, 出现在以草本减肥为卖点的产品中。

For the carnitine content, diet already supplies most body carnitine in omnivores, so it adds little i ...

endogenous_note: Tryptophan is an essential amino acid: humans cannot build the indole ring, so the whole supply is dietary. Both the melatonin and 5-HTP rows depend on this substrate, and because tryptophan hydroxylase runs below saturation, raising tryptophan is the physiological lever on serotonin synthesis, with the pathway's own regulation left intact. The one genuinely endogenous route worth stating runs downstream: hepatic conversion to niacin.
endogenous_note_zh: 色氨酸是必需氨基酸: 人无法构建吲哚环, 全部来源为膳食。褪黑素行和 5-HTP 行都依赖这个底物; 由于 tryptophan hydroxylase 处于亚饱和状态, 提高色氨酸就是作用于血清素合成的生理杠杆, 且途径自身的调控保持完好。真正值得提的内源路线在下游: 肝内转化为烟酸。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis of the amino acid. Catabolism: over 90 percent of tryptophan flux goes down the kynurenine pathway (TDO2 in liver, IDO1 elsewhere), with hepatic conversion to niacin at roughly 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent; about 1 to 2 percent enters the tryptophan hydroxylase route to serotonin.
pathway_zh: 氨基酸本身的合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。分解代谢: 超过 90% 的色氨酸通量走 kynurenine 途径 (肝为 TDO2, 其他部位为 IDO1), 肝内转化为烟酸的比例约为 60 mg 色氨酸对 1 mg 烟酸当量; 约 1% 至 2% 进入 tryptophan hydroxylase 途径生成血清素。
daily_amount: 0 synthesised. Adult requirement is on the order of 4 mg/kg/day in the WHO/FAO/UNU indispensable amino acid pattern (identifier not verified in this pass).
daily_amount_zh: 合成量为 0。按 WHO/FAO/UNU 必需氨基酸模式, 成人需要量约为 4 mg/kg/day (本轮未核验出处编号)。
still_matters_when: Where raising serotonin synthesis is the aim, tryptophan is the substrate that keeps tryptophan hydroxylase regulation in place, unlike 5-HTP which bypasses it. Also in pellagra-risk states, since niacin can come from tryptophan. Watch serotonergic additivity with SSRIs and MAOIs, and competition with other large neutral amino acids at LAT1 for brain entry.

supplement: Other sleep and calming botanicals: chamomile, passionflower, lemon balm, magnolia bark, L-theanine, kava, tart cherry
endogenous_note: All are plant products with no human biosynthetic route, so the axis is silent for the group. Two members are worth separating out. Kava's kavalactones carry the best short-term anxiolytic trial signal in this space and the worst safety signal, idiosyncratic severe hepatotoxicity including transplant cases, which drove regulatory withdrawal in several countries. Tart cherry blurs the line this dataset draws, because it contains plant-made melatonin, chemically identical to the endogenous hormone and still exogenous as ingested, at microgram-level doses per serving.
endogenous_note_zh: 这些都是植物产品, 人体没有合成途径, 所以这条轴对整组无话可说。其中两个成员值得单独指出。卡瓦的 kavalactones 在这一领域有最好的短期抗焦虑试验信号, 也有最差的安全信号, 即特异质性重度肝毒性, 包括需要移植的病例, 这促成多个国家的监管撤市。酸樱桃模糊了本数据集所划的界线, 因为它含植物合成的褪黑素, 与内源激素化学上完全相同, 但作为摄入物仍是外源的, 每份剂量在微克级。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant flavonoid (apigenin, chrysin), phenylpropanoid (rosmarinic acid), neolignan (honokiol, magnolol), styrylpyranone (kavalactone) and glutamate-ethylamide (L-theanine) pathways; humans have no ethylamine ligase for L-theanine and no flavonoid, neolignan or kavalactone biosynthesis. Tart cherry melatonin is made by the p ...
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。植物类黄酮 (芹菜素, 白杨素), 苯丙烷类 (迷迭香酸), 新木脂素 (和厚朴酚, 厚朴酚), 苯乙烯基吡喃酮 (kavalactone) 和谷氨酸乙酰胺 (L-theanine) 途径; 人没有生成 L-theanine 的乙胺连接酶, 也不合成类黄酮, 新木脂素或 kavalactone。酸樱桃中的褪黑素由植物用同样的 AANAT 和 ASMT 化学生成。
daily_amount: 0 synthesised. Tart cherry delivers melatonin in the microgram range per serving, orders of magnitude below the 0.5 to 3 mg used for circadian timing and comparable to or below a night's endogenous output of about 38.5 m ...
daily_amount_zh: 合成量为 0。酸樱桃每份提供的褪黑素在微克级, 比用于昼夜时相调节的 0.5 至 3 mg 低几个数量级, 与 70 kg 体重整夜约 38.5 microg 的内源产量相当或更低。
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on small and short trials, standardisation, additive sedation, and specific hazards: kava hepatotoxicity (avoid with alcohol, hepatotoxic drugs or liver disease, and check local legal status), apigenin and honokiol effects on CYP substrates, and the sugar load of cherry juice. L-theanine has modest acute anxiolytic and attention data at 200 to 400 mg. If circadian timi ...
still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用试验规模小且周期短, 标准化, 镇静叠加, 以及具体风险来筛查: 卡瓦的肝毒性 (避免与酒精, 肝毒性药物或肝病同用, 并核对当地法律状态), 芹菜素和和厚朴酚对 CYP 底物的影响, 以及樱桃汁的糖负荷。L-theanine 在 200 至 400 mg 有有限的急性抗焦虑和注意力数据。若目标是昼夜时相调节, 用明确剂量的褪黑素才可控。

supplement: Adaptogens, medicinal mushrooms and high-volume polyphenols: Panax ginseng, Eleutherococcus, cordyceps, reishi, chaga, turkey tail, curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin
endogenous_note: Ginsenosides, eleutherosides, cordycepin, ganoderic acids, fungal beta-glucans, curcuminoids, stilbenes and flavonols are all plant or fungal metabolites with no human pathway, so the axis is silent across the group; adaptogen is a marketing category, not a pharmacological class. Beta-glucans are the partial exception in interest rather than origin, since humans have receptors for them (CLEC7A/dectin-1, CR3) but no synthesis. The three polyphenols share one practical problem: extensive first-pass glucuronidation and sulfation, so plasma aglycone is very low and formulations exist mainly to defeat that metabolism.
endogenous_note_zh: 人参皂苷, 刺五加苷, 虫草素, 灵芝酸, 真菌 beta-葡聚糖, 姜黄素类, 芪类和黄酮醇全是植物或真菌代谢物, 人体没有相应途径, 所以这条轴对整组无话可说; adaptogen 是营销分类, 不是药理学类别。beta-葡聚糖只在关注度上算部分例外, 来源上不例外, 因为人有其受体 (CLEC7A/dectin-1, CR3), 但不合成它。三种多酚有一个共同的实际问题: 首过时大量葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化, 血浆中苷元浓度很低, 各种配方的存在主要是为了对抗这种代谢。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant triterpenoid saponin (dammarane ginsenosides), lignan, type III polyketide synthase (curcumin synthase, stilbene synthase) and flavonoid pathways, plus fungal polyketide, nucleoside and beta-glucan pathways. Human oxidosqualene cyclase gives lanosterol only, so the dammarane skeleton of ginsenosides is not formed in  ...
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。植物三萜皂苷 (达玛烷型人参皂苷), 木脂素, III 型聚酮合酶 (姜黄素合酶, 芪合酶) 和类黄酮途径, 以及真菌聚酮, 核苷和 beta-葡聚糖途径。人的 oxidosqualene cyclase 只生成 lanosterol, 所以人体不形成人参皂苷的达玛烷骨架。人对这些多酚的处理仅限于 UGT 和 SULT 结合以及结肠微生物降解。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway for any member of this group)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (本组任何成员在人体都没有生物合成途径)

endogenous_note: Carnitine is endogenously synthesised, which argues against routine supplementation, but only partly: in omnivores about 75 percent of body carnitine comes from diet and about 25 percent from biosynthesis, and skeletal and cardiac muscle cannot synthesise it at all, depending entirely on OCTN2 (SLC22A5) uptake. That combination makes it conditionally dispensable rather than fully endogenous, and it is why the weight-loss row above is MIXED rather than NONE.
endogenous_note_zh: 肉碱是内源合成的, 这一点不支持常规补充, 但只是部分成立: 杂食者体内肉碱约 75% 来自膳食, 约 25% 来自生物合成, 而骨骼肌和心肌完全不能合成, 全靠 OCTN2 (SLC22A5) 摄取。这一组合使它属于条件性可缺, 不属于完全内源, 这也是上面减肥复方那一行标 MIXED 不标 NONE 的原因。
pathway: Four steps from protein-derived trimethyllysine: TMLHE to hydroxytrimethyllysine, aldolytic cleavage to 4-trimethylaminobutyraldehyde, oxidation to gamma-butyrobetaine, then BBOX1 (gamma-butyrobetaine dioxygenase). BBOX1 is expressed in liver, kidney and brain and is absent from skeletal and cardiac muscle.
pathway_zh: 由蛋白来源的 trimethyllysine 经四步完成: TMLHE 生成 hydroxytrimethyllysine, 醛缩裂解生成 4-trimethylaminobutyraldehyde, 氧化生成 gamma-butyrobetaine, 再由 BBOX1 (gamma-butyrobetaine dioxygenase) 生成肉碱。BBOX1 表达于肝, 肾和脑, 骨骼肌和心肌不表达。
daily_amount: Endogenous biosynthesis about 1.2 micromol/kg body weight/day, that is 84 micromol/day or about 13.5 mg/day at 70 kg and MW 161.2, measured in strict vegetarians; diet supplies roughly 75 percent of body carnitine in omn ...
daily_amount_zh: 内源生物合成约 1.2 micromol/kg body weight/day, 即 84 micromol/day, 按 70 kg 和 MW 161.2 折算约 13.5 mg/day, 该值在严格素食者中测得; 膳食在杂食者中提供体内肉碱的约 75%, 在严格素食者中不到 10%。
still_matters_when: Primary carnitine deficiency (SLC22A5 mutations), secondary deficiency in dialysis, valproate therapy, some organic acidaemias and prematurity, and specified inborn errors of fatty acid oxidation. For exercise performance or fat loss in healthy people, NEVER ON THIS AXIS; note also colonic bacterial conversion of carnitine to trimethylamine and TMAO.
still_matters_when_zh: 原发性肉碱缺乏 (SLC22A5 突变), 透析, 丙戊酸治疗, 部分有机酸血症和早产导致的继发性缺乏, 以及特定的脂肪酸氧化先天缺陷。对健康人用于运动表现或减脂, NEVER ON THIS AXIS; 另需注意结肠细菌把肉碱转化为三甲胺和 TMAO。

endogenous_note: CLA is usually presented as purely dietary, and it has a real partial human route: trans-vaccenic acid from ruminant fat is desaturated to c9,t11-CLA by stearoyl-CoA desaturase (SCD1) in human tissue. The t10,c12 isomer that dominates commercial supplements and drives the claimed fat-loss effect has no human synthetic route at all, so the isomer sold differs from the one human tissue forms, and the weight-loss category is not uniformly NONE as originally claimed.
endogenous_note_zh: CLA 通常被说成完全来自膳食, 但它在人体确有部分生成途径: 来自反刍动物脂肪的反式异油酸在人体组织中由 stearoyl-CoA desaturase (SCD1) 去饱和生成 c9,t11-CLA。而在商品补充剂中占主导, 并被用来支撑减脂说法的 t10,c12 异构体在人体完全没有合成途径, 所以在售的异构体与人体组织生成的那个不同, 减肥这一类别也就不像原先所说的那样一律为 NONE。
pathway: trans-vaccenic acid (t11-18:1) to c9,t11-CLA by SCD1 in human tissue. The t10,c12 isomer is produced by rumen bacteria (Butyrivibrio) or by industrial isomerisation of linoleic acid: NOT APPLICABLE in humans.
pathway_zh: 人体组织中反式异油酸 (t11-18:1) 经 SCD1 生成 c9,t11-CLA。t10,c12 异构体由瘤胃细菌 (Butyrivibrio) 生成, 或由亚油酸工业异构化制得: 在人体为 NOT APPLICABLE。
daily_amount: Endogenous c9,t11-CLA formation depends entirely on dietary trans-vaccenic acid intake, so it is a conversion rather than de novo synthesis and has no fixed daily figure. t10,c12: 0.
daily_amount_zh: 内源 c9,t11-CLA 的生成完全取决于膳食反式异油酸的摄入, 属转化而非从头合成, 没有固定的每日数值。t10,c12: 0。
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis for the t10,c12 isomer that supplements deliver. Screen on the small weight effects and on the metabolic signals reported with t10,c12 (insulin resistance, raised liver fat, reduced HDL), which do not apply to the dairy-derived c9,t11 isomer.
still_matters_when_zh: 就补充剂提供的 t10,c12 异构体而言, 这条轴上没有理由。改用体重效应之小, 以及 t10,c12 已报告的代谢信号 (胰岛素抵抗, 肝脂增加, HDL 降低) 来筛查, 这些信号不适用于乳制品来源的 c9,t11 异构体。

supplement: Other gel-forming and bulking fibres: partially hydrolysed guar gum, methylcellulose, sterculia, calcium polycarbophil, resistant starch
endogenous_note: All are non-digestible by humans, so nothing here is endogenous and every gram is eaten. They compete directly with psyllium in the indication the psyllium row endorses, and they differ in the property that matters clinically: methylcellulose and calcium polycarbophil are essentially non-fermented and produce little gas, while partially hydrolysed guar gum and resistant starch are fermented and can worsen bloating in IBS.
endogenous_note_zh: 这些在人体都不可消化, 所以其中没有内源成分, 每一克都靠吃。它们在车前子那一行所认可的适应症上与车前子直接竞争, 而它们在临床上重要的那个性质上不同: 甲基纤维素和聚卡波非钙基本不被发酵, 产气很少; 部分水解瓜尔胶和抗性淀粉会被发酵, 在 IBS 中可能加重腹胀。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Humans lack the glycoside hydrolases for galactomannan, cellulose ethers, karaya polysaccharide and the resistant starch fractions that escape amylase (RS1 to RS4); calcium polycarbophil is a synthetic polyacrylic hydrogel with no biological pathway at all.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。人缺少针对半乳甘露聚糖, 纤维素醚, 刺梧桐胶多糖以及逃过淀粉酶的抗性淀粉部分 (RS1 至 RS4) 的糖苷水解酶; 聚卡波非钙是合成聚丙烯酸水凝胶, 完全没有生物途径。

daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有生物合成途径; 摄入量是唯一变量)

endogenous_note: This is the case the binary schema cannot express, which is why it is labelled MIXED. Butyrate, propionate and acetate are produced inside the body in gram quantities every day, by colonic bacteria fermenting fibre rather than by human enzymes, and human metabolism separately makes related species: acetate from acetyl-CoA and from ethanol metabolism, and the ketone body beta-hydroxybutyrate, a hydroxylated four-carbon acid with overlapping signalling. So the molecules are endogenous to the body while the production is microbial, and the way to raise colonic butyrate is to feed the bacteria that make it.
endogenous_note_zh: 这是二元标签无法表达的情形, 所以标为 MIXED。丁酸, 丙酸和乙酸每天在体内以克级产生, 由结肠细菌发酵纤维完成, 不是人类酶完成; 人体代谢另外生成相关分子: 由乙酰辅酶 A 和乙醇代谢生成乙酸, 以及酮体 beta-羟丁酸, 一种四碳羟基酸, 信号通路与丁酸有重叠。所以这些分子对身体是内源存在的, 生产却由微生物完成, 而提高结肠丁酸的办法是喂养产生它的细菌。
pathway: Bacterial fermentation of fibre and resistant starch to acetate, propionate and butyrate (butyryl-CoA:acetate CoA-transferase and butyrate kinase routes in Faecalibacterium, Roseburia and Eubacterium); colonocytes oxidise butyrate as their main fuel. Human ketogenesis makes beta-hydroxybutyrate from acetyl-CoA via HMGCS2 and BDH1, a diffe ...
pathway_zh: 细菌发酵纤维和抗性淀粉生成乙酸, 丙酸和丁酸 (Faecalibacterium, Roseburia 和 Eubacterium 中的 butyryl-CoA:acetate CoA-transferase 和 butyrate kinase 路线); 结肠上皮细胞以丁酸为主要燃料进行氧化。人的生酮作用经 HMGCS2 和 BDH1 由乙酰辅酶 A 生成 beta-羟丁酸, 这是另一种分子, 但信号通路有重叠 (HCAR2, 组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制)。
daily_amount: Colonic short-chain fatty acid production is conventionally put in the range of hundreds of millimoles per day on a fibre-containing diet, most of it absorbed and consumed locally (standard figure, identifier not verifie ...
daily_amount_zh: 在含纤维膳食下, 结肠短链脂肪酸产量通常被列在每日数百毫摩尔的范围, 大部分被就地吸收和消耗 (标准数值, 本轮未核验出处编号)。常见补充剂剂量的口服丁酸钠在小肠被吸收, 除非有肠溶保护, 到达结肠的很少。
still_matters_when: Where colonic butyrate exposure is the aim, fermentable substrate is the effective lever, and any oral butyrate salt needs colonic-release formulation to reach the target. Clinical evidence in ulcerative colitis and IBS is limited and comes mostly from small trials and butyrate enemas.
still_matters_when_zh: 若目标是结肠丁酸暴露, 可发酵底物才是有效杠杆, 任何口服丁酸盐都需要结肠释放配方才能到达靶部位。溃疡性结肠炎和 IBS 的临床证据有限, 多来自小型试验和丁酸灌肠。

supplement: Saccharomyces boulardii CNCM I-745 and other named strains with indication-level evidence
endogenous_note: S. boulardii is a yeast, which tests the acquired-not-synthesised framing from the other direction: it is not a resident human commensal at all and does not colonise, so it acts as a transient pharmacological agent that happens to be alive. It carries the strongest evidence in this category for antibiotic-associated diarrhoea and as an adjunct in Clostridioides difficile infection. Other strains with indication-level randomised evidence, absent from the original dataset, include Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG for antibiotic-associated diarrhoea, the VSL#3 and Visbiome eight-strain formulation for pouchitis, and  ...
endogenous_note_zh: S. boulardii 是酵母, 从另一侧检验了获得而非合成这一框架: 它根本不是人体常驻共生生物, 也不定植, 所以它像一种恰好是活体的短期药物。它在本类别中对抗生素相关性腹泻以及作为 Clostridioides difficile 感染的辅助治疗证据最强。原数据集缺席的其他有适应症级随机证据的菌株包括用于抗生素相关性腹泻的 Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG, 用于储袋炎的 VSL#3 和 Visbiome 八菌株配方, 以及用于婴儿肠绞痛的 Limosilactobacillus reuteri DSM 17938。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are ingested or acquired, never synthesised by host tissue, and S. boulardii is not part of the resident human microbiota.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠摄入或获得, 宿主组织从不合成, 而 S. boulardii 不属于人体常驻菌群。
daily_amount: 0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism). Doses are strain-specific and expressed as cfu, and the trialled dose is part of the evidence.
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)。剂量按菌株而定, 以 cfu 表示, 试验所用剂量是证据的一部分。
still_matters_when: Antibiotic-associated diarrhoea and C. difficile adjunct (S. boulardii CNCM I-745, LGG), pouchitis maintenance (VSL#3 or Visbiome), infant colic (L. reuteri DSM 17938). Withhold live yeast or bacteria with central venous access, severe immunosuppression and critical illness, where fungaemia and bacteraemia traced to probiotic products are documented. Benefit stops when dosing stops.
still_matters_when_zh: 抗生素相关性腹泻和 C. difficile 辅助治疗 (S. boulardii CNCM I-745, LGG), 储袋炎维持治疗 (VSL#3 或 Visbiome), 婴儿肠绞痛 (L. reuteri DSM 17938)。有中心静脉导管, 严重免疫抑制和危重病时不要给活酵母或活菌, 已有追溯到益生菌产品的真菌血症和菌血症记录。停药即失去获益。

supplement: Ox bile, bile acids, betaine HCl and pepsin
endogenous_note: These are the structural analogue of the pancreatic-enzyme row and were missing from it. Bile acids are made from cholesterol in hepatocytes and recycled with about 95 percent efficiency through the enterohepatic circulation, and pepsinogen and gastric acid come from gastric chief and parietal cells, so all are amply endogenous in a healthy person. The label is CONDITIONAL because named states remove them: cholestasis, biliary obstruction or diversion, ileal resection or Crohn ileitis and short bowel for bile acids; atrophic gastritis, autoimmune achlorhydria, post-gastrectomy states and long-term proton pump inh ...
endogenous_note_zh: 这一行是胰酶那一行的结构性对应, 原数据集缺失。胆汁酸由肝细胞从胆固醇合成, 经肠肝循环以约 95% 的效率回收; 胃蛋白酶原和胃酸来自胃主细胞和顶细胞, 所以健康人这些都充足内源。标签用 CONDITIONAL, 因为有明确的状态使它们消失: 胆汁酸方面是胆汁淤积, 胆道梗阻或分流, 回肠切除或 Crohn 回肠炎以及短肠; 酸和胃蛋白酶方面是萎缩性胃炎, 自身免疫性胃酸缺乏, 胃切除术后状态以及长期使用质子泵抑制剂。这两类产品的销售范围远大于这些疾病的发生范围。
pathway: Cholesterol to bile acids via CYP7A1 (classic) and CYP27A1 with CYP7B1 (alternative), conjugated by BAAT and secreted by BSEP (ABCB11), reabsorbed in the terminal ileum by ASBT (SLC10A2). Pepsinogen from chief cells is activated to pepsin by parietal-cell HCl below about pH 3, which is also why acid suppression reduces peptic activity.
pathway_zh: 胆固醇经 CYP7A1 (经典途径) 以及 CYP27A1 与 CYP7B1 (替代途径) 生成胆汁酸, 由 BAAT 结合, 经 BSEP (ABCB11) 分泌, 在末端回肠由 ASBT (SLC10A2) 重吸收。主细胞分泌的胃蛋白酶原在顶细胞 HCl 使 pH 低于约 3 时活化为胃蛋白酶, 这也是抑酸会降低蛋白水解活性的原因。
daily_amount: Bile acid pool about 3 g, cycling 4 to 12 times a day, with hepatic synthesis replacing only the 0.2 to 0.6 g/day lost in stool (standard physiology figures, identifiers not verified in this pass). Gastric acid and pepsi ...
daily_amount_zh: 胆汁酸池约 3 g, 每日循环 4 至 12 次, 肝合成只补充随粪便丢失的 0.2 至 0.6 g/day (标准生理学数值, 本轮未核验出处编号)。胃酸和胃蛋白酶原属分泌速率, 不是每日总量, 通常按每小时酸输出量测定。
still_matters_when: Bile acid or ox bile where bile delivery is genuinely impaired (cholestasis, biliary obstruction or diversion, short bowel), noting that bile acid diarrhoea after ileal resection is treated with sequestrants instead, and that ursodeoxycholic acid is the licensed bile acid with an evidence base. Betaine HCl and pepsin only in documented hypochlorhydria; with normal acid secretion, NEVER ON THIS AXI ...
still_matters_when_zh: 当胆汁输送确实受损时用胆汁酸或牛胆 (胆汁淤积, 胆道梗阻或分流, 短肠), 注意回肠切除后的胆汁酸性腹泻要用胆汁酸螯合剂治疗, 而熊去氧胆酸是有证据基础的获批胆汁酸。甜菜碱盐酸盐和胃蛋白酶只用于有明确记录的胃酸不足; 胃酸分泌正常时 NEVER ON THIS AXIS, 两者都有黏膜刺激风险, 合用 NSAID 时更明显。
source: Row added to close a coverage gap flagged in the check report; enterohepatic circulation and gastric physiology figures are standard, primary identifiers not ve ...

endogenous_note: Vitamin D is the one true CONDITIONAL vitamin: humans synthesise vitamin D3 in skin from 7-dehydrocholesterol under UVB, so with adequate sun exposure there is no dietary requirement, and with inadequate exposure there is. Latitude, season, skin pigmentation, age, clothing, sunscreen and indoor living decide which state applies, so this axis decides the whole question rather than being silent. Vitamin K is different: the naphthoquinone ring is dietary, but MK-4 is endogenously produced by UBIAD1 conversion of dietary phylloquinone (K1) and menadione in extrahepatic tissue, so MK-4 supplementation duplicates a con ...
endogenous_note_zh: 维生素 D 是唯一真正 CONDITIONAL 的维生素: 人在皮肤中由 7-dehydrocholesterol 在 UVB 作用下合成维生素 D3, 所以日照充足时没有膳食需要量, 日照不足时就有。纬度, 季节, 皮肤色素, 年龄, 衣着, 防晒和室内生活决定处于哪一种状态, 所以这条轴在这里决定全部问题, 不是无话可说。维生素 K 不同: 萘醌环来自膳食, 但 MK-4 是内源生成的, 由 UBIAD1 在肝外组织把膳食叶绿醌 (K1) 和甲萘醌转化而来, 所以补充 MK-4 重复了身体本来执行的转化; 而 MK-7 等长链甲基萘醌是细菌产物, 人体不合成。本行标 MIXED, 因为这两种维生素在轴上位置不同。

Vitamin K: phylloquinone side-chain removal to menadione, prenylation by UBIAD1 to MK-4 in brain, pa ...
pathway_zh: 维生素 D: 7-dehydrocholesterol 在 UVB (290 至 315 nm) 作用下生成前维生素 D3, 经热异构化生成维生素 D3, 在肝经 25 羟化 (CYP2R1) 生成 25(OH)D, 在肾经 1alpha 羟化 (CYP27B1) 生成 1,25(OH)2D, 由 CYP24A1 灭活。维生素 K: 叶绿醌去掉侧链生成甲萘醌, 在脑, 胰腺, 动脉壁等组织由 UBIAD1 异戊烯化生成 MK-4; K 族维生素作为 gamma-glutamy ...
daily_amount: Vitamin D: cutaneous synthesis ranges from effectively zero (winter above about 40 degrees latitude, full cover, indoor living) to thousands of IU from a short whole-body summer exposure, so no single daily figure applie ...
daily_amount_zh: 维生素 D: 皮肤合成量从基本为零 (约北纬 40 度以上的冬季, 全身遮盖, 室内生活) 到夏季短时全身暴露可达数千 IU, 所以没有单一每日数值适用, 状态用血清 25(OH)D 衡量。维生素 K: 环结构没有从头合成, 供给由摄入决定; MK-4 的生成是对摄入 K1 的转化, 没有固定每日速率, 肠道细菌产生的 ...
still_matters_when: Vitamin D where UVB exposure is low or blocked, in dark skin at high latitude, in older and institutionalised people, in malabsorption, and where the active metabolite is needed; this is genuine replacement of a synthesis shortfall, which puts it in a different class from the botanicals here, and testing beats guessing where the answer changes management. Vitamin K in deficiency states (newborns b ...
still_matters_when_zh: 维生素 D 适用于 UVB 暴露少或被阻断, 高纬度深色皮肤, 高龄和机构居住者, 吸收不良, 以及需要活性代谢物的情形; 这属于对合成不足的真正替代, 与本表中的植物成分完全不同类, 而在结果会改变处理时应当检测而不是猜测。维生素 K 适用于缺乏状态 (未接受预防的新生儿, 脂肪吸收不良, 胆汁淤积, 长期广谱抗生素合并摄入不足); 用 MK-4 或 MK-7 追求骨骼和血管终点属药理性押注, 而任何维生素 K 摄入变化都会干扰华法林的控制。

supplement: Creatine, CoQ10, glutathione and alpha-lipoic acid
endogenous_note: All four are endogenously synthesised, which is the axis argument against them, and each then succeeds or fails for its own separate reason. Creatine is made at roughly half of daily turnover, and oral dosing raises muscle total creatine and phosphocreatine above habitual levels, so the mechanism is supra-normal loading rather than deficiency correction; vegetarians start lower and respond more. CoQ10 is made by the mevalonate pathway in every cell, so statins reduce its synthesis, and oral absorption is poor and formulation-dependent. Glutathione is synthesised intracellularly and oral glutathione is largely deg ...
endogenous_note_zh: 四者都是内源合成的, 这就是这条轴反对它们的理由, 而它们各自成败的原因彼此不同。肌酸的合成量约占每日周转的一半, 口服可把肌肉总肌酸和磷酸肌酸提高到平常水平之上, 所以机制是超常负荷, 不是纠正缺乏; 素食者起点更低, 反应更大。CoQ10 由每个细胞的甲羟戊酸途径合成, 所以他汀会减少其合成, 而口服吸收差且依赖配方。谷胱甘肽在细胞内合成, 口服谷胱甘肽在肠道大部分被降解为其氨基酸, 所以通过 N-acetylcysteine 提供半胱氨酸才是机制上说得通的提升方式。硫辛酸由 LIAS 合成, 在体内只以共价结合于酶的赖氨酸残基的形式存在, 所以游离形式的补充剂与内源形式是不同的分子, 任何作用都属药理性。

supplement: Taurine, choline and betaine, inositol, NAD precursors (NR, NMN), glucosamine and chondroitin
endogenous_note: MIXED because these sit at different points on the axis. Taurine is made from cysteine by CDO1 and CSAD and is conditionally essential, adequate in healthy adults and inadequate in preterm infants and long-term parenteral nutrition. Choline is synthesised only in small amount by PEMT and is a recognised dietary essential (adequate intake 550 mg/day for men, 425 mg/day for women), since deficiency causes fatty liver and muscle damage; betaine is made from choline by CHDH and can spare choline for methylation without replacing its structural role. Inositol is synthesised endogenously from glucose-6-phosphate in gra ...
endogenous_note_zh: 标 MIXED 是因为这些成分在轴上的位置不同。牛磺酸由半胱氨酸经 CDO1 和 CSAD 合成, 属条件性必需, 健康成人足够, 早产儿和长期肠外营养者不足。胆碱只有少量由 PEMT 合成, 是公认的膳食必需物 (适宜摄入量男性 550 mg/day, 女性 425 mg/day), 因为缺乏会导致脂肪肝和肌肉损伤; 甜菜碱由胆碱经 CHDH 生成, 能在甲基化上替胆碱省力, 但不能取代其结构作用。肌醇由 6-磷酸葡萄糖内源合成, 量在克级, 主要在肾, 所以属 FULL, 用于 PCOS 属药理剂量。NAD+ 有三条生成路线, 所以烟酸或色氨酸摄入充足的人不缺生成能力, NR 和 NMN 作为药理性成分进入补救途径。氨基葡萄糖和硫酸软骨素都是内源的, 由 6-磷酸果糖和谷氨酰胺经己糖胺途径生成, 所以软骨并不像营销说法那样缺底物。

Choline: PEMT methylates phosphatidylethanolamine using three SAMe; CHDH oxidises choline to betaine, which donates a methyl group through BHMT. supplement: Mineral and element supplements (magnesium, zinc, iron, selenium, iodine, calcium, potassium and others)
endogenous_note: No biological process transmutes elements, so every element is NONE on this axis without exception, and intake is the only source. The legitimate nuance concerns compounds containing an element, which the body does synthesise: heme from iron and protoporphyrin IX, selenoproteins from selenium through selenocysteine, and thyroid hormone from iodine and tyrosine. That distinction matters clinically, because an element can be adequate while the compound built from it fails for a separate reason, for example sideroblastic anaemia with adequate iron, or impaired selenoprotein synthesis with adequate selenium in SECISB ...
endogenous_note_zh: 没有任何生物过程能进行元素转变, 所以每一种元素在这条轴上一律为 NONE, 没有例外, 摄入是唯一来源。合理的细分在于含该元素的化合物, 身体确实合成这些: 由铁和原卟啉 IX 生成血红素, 由硒经硒代半胱氨酸生成硒蛋白, 由碘和酪氨酸生成甲状腺激素。这一区分在临床上重要, 因为元素可能充足而由它构建的化合物因另外的原因出问题, 例如铁充足时的铁粒幼细胞性贫血, 或 SECISBP2 缺陷时硒充足而硒蛋白合成受损。原来的 22 行中没有出现任何元素, 那是覆盖缺口, 不是标签错误。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for any element. Human pathways handle absorption, transport and incorporation rather than creation: DMT1 and ferroportin under hepcidin control for iron with ALAS2 and ferrochelatase for heme, SEPHS2 and SEPSECS for selenocysteine insertion, and NIS (SLC5A5) with TPO for iodide uptake and organification.
pathway_zh: 任何元素都为 NOT APPLICABLE。人体途径处理吸收, 转运和掺入, 不创造元素: 铁由 DMT1 和 ferroportin 在 hepcidin 调控下处理, 血红素由 ALAS2 和 ferrochelatase 生成; 硒代半胱氨酸的插入由 SEPHS2 和 SEPSECS 完成; 碘化物摄取和有机化由 NIS (SLC5A5) 和 TPO 完成。

supplement: Classification rules for this dataset (definitions row, not a supplement)
endogenous_note: Four labels are used, and adequate quantity is judged against basal physiological function at the tissue's normal set point, not against a storage ceiling and not against the dose a trial happened to use. FULL: the human pathway is complete and output covers basal need in health. PARTIAL: the pathway exists but output is structurally capped below what the relevant pool or function needs, so dietary supply routinely contributes. endogenous_note_zh: 全表用四个标签, 判断供应是否充足的基准是健康状态下组织在正常设定点的基础生理功能, 不按储存池上限, 也不按某项试验所用剂量。FULL: 人体通路完整, 健康时自身产量覆盖基础需要。PARTIAL: 通路存在, 但产量在结构上被限制在相关池或功能所需之下, 饮食供应经常性参与。CONDITIONAL: 健康时够用, 在明确点名的状态下不够用。NONE: 人体完全没有该生物合成通路, 所有化学元素都归此类, 因为没有生物能合成元素。标签是描述性的: NONE 不含需求含义 (caffeine 和 quercetin 是 NONE 且无需求, vitamin C 和 zinc 是 NONE 但有需求也有缺乏症), FULL 也不能判定药理剂量是否有效 (melatonin 即是)。

daily_amount_zh: 本行 NOT APPLICABLE。其余条目的约定: 只有在有引用的人体测量或明确标注的推导支持时才给数字; 没有经过验证的人体速率时写 NOT ESTABLISHED, 改为给出酶学或摄入侧参照; 合成在原理上不可能时写 0。
still_matters_when: Use the axis to decide whether a product has a target, then use pharmacology and trial evidence to decide whether it works. It never settles efficacy on its own.
still_matters_when_zh: 先用这条轴判断产品有没有可作用的目标, 再用药理学和试验证据判断它是否有效。这条轴能否掉某些前提 (glucosamine, 作为分子的 collagen, 睾酮增强类产品), 也能支持某些前提 (creatine, beta-alanine, 摄入不足时的 vitamin C, 纯素者的 B12), 但它本身从不判定疗效。

A normal omnivorous diet supplies a similar amount to cover the 1 to 3 g/day lost as creatinine. endogenous_note: Humans have no caffeine biosynthetic pathway. There is no caffeine synthase and no route from purine nucleotides to caffeine in any animal, so every milligram in your blood was eaten or drunk. Human caffeine enzymology is purely disposal, dominated by hepatic CYP1A2. Note what NONE does and does not imply: caffeine is a drug and not a nutrient, there is no deficiency to correct and no redundancy to worry about, so this axis neither supports nor undermines it and the decision rests entirely on pharmacology and dose.
endogenous_note_zh: 人体没有 caffeine 的生物合成通路。没有 caffeine synthase, 任何动物体内也没有从嘌呤核苷酸到 caffeine 的路线, 所以血里的每一毫克都是吃进或喝进去的。人体与 caffeine 有关的酶学纯属处置, 由肝内 CYP1A2 主导。要注意 NONE 在这里的含义: caffeine 属于药物, 不算营养素, 没有可纠正的缺乏, 也不存在与自身合成重复的问题, 所以这条轴对它既不支持也不反驳, 判断完全落在药理学和剂量上。

daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day, 没有内源合成。在处置一侧, CYP1A2 代谢摄入 caffeine 的约 95% (PMID 29514871)。
still_matters_when: Whenever acute adenosine receptor antagonism is the goal: alertness, reduced perceived effort, endurance and sprint performance, typically 3 to 6 mg/kg. The endogenous axis is silent on caffeine; the real constraints are habitual tolerance, CYP1A2 genotype, sleep disruption and cumulative daily dose.
still_matters_when_zh: 凡以急性拮抗 adenosine 受体为目的时: 清醒度, 主观用力感下降, 耐力和冲刺表现, 常用 3 到 6 mg/kg。内源轴对 caffeine 无话可说; 真正的限制是习惯性耐受, CYP1A2 基因型, 睡眠干扰和每日累积剂量。

endogenous_note: Relabelled PARTIAL, because humans do produce nitrate in quantity: about 1 mmol/day appears from the oxidation of NO, roughly 37 percent of the total body nitrate pool against a dietary intake of about 1700 micromol/day. That output is not inert waste either, since it re-enters the enterosalivary circuit, is concentrated in saliva and is reduced back to nitrite and NO by the same route a beetroot dose exploits. Two limits carry the practical conclusion. Endogenous appearance cannot be up-regulated on demand, and raising plasma nitrite enough to lower the O2 cost of exercise needs dietary loading well above endoge ...
endogenous_note_zh: 标签改为 PARTIAL, 因为人体确实以可观的量生成 nitrate: NO 氧化每天产生约 1 mmol, 约占全身 nitrate 池的 37%, 而膳食摄入约 1700 micromol/day。这部分产物也不是惰性废物, 它重新进入唾液肠循环, 在唾液中被浓缩, 再沿甜菜根剂量所利用的同一路线还原为 nitrite 和 NO。支撑实用结论的是两条限制。内源生成无法按需上调, 而要把血浆 nitrite 提高到足以降低运动氧耗的程度, 需要的膳食负荷远高于内源周转量, 所以吃 nitrate 并不多余。两条路线也要分开看: nitric oxide 由 arginine 经 nitric oxide synthase 内源生成, 这条通路与膳食 nitrate 到 nitrite 到 NO 的路线彼此独立。
pathway: Endogenous nitrate arises from oxidation of NOS-derived NO through nitrite, with essentially all NOS output ending as nitrate, which is why endogenous nitrate appearance and NOS-dependent NO production are the same order of magnitude. endogenous_note: HMB is a normal human metabolite of leucine, made whenever leucine is metabolised, but only about 5 percent of whole-body leucine flux takes that branch, which comes to roughly 0.2 to 0.4 g/day in a 70 kg adult. The studied dose is 3 g/day, and reaching that from food would take about 60 g of leucine, over 600 g of high quality protein. So endogenous production is real yet roughly a tenth of the dose being tested, which makes supplementation a coherent premise and hardly a duplication. Whether 3 g/day does anything useful in healthy trained people is a separate and much weaker question, and the form matters, sinc ...
endogenous_note_zh: HMB 是 leucine 的正常人体代谢产物, leucine 被代谢时就会生成, 但只有全身 leucine 通量的约 5% 走这个分支, 在 70 kg 成人相当于每天约 0.2 到 0.4 g。被研究的剂量是 3 g/day, 靠食物达到这个量需要约 60 g leucine, 即超过 600 g 优质蛋白。所以内源生成真实存在, 却只有受试剂量的十分之一左右, 补充因此是一个自洽的前提, 谈不上重复。3 g/day 在健康训练人群里是否有用, 是另一个证据弱得多的问题; 剂型也有影响, 游离酸与钙盐在吸收速率和血浆峰浓度上不同, 而机制性主张假定的正是这些浓度。
pathway: Leucine is reversibly transaminated to alpha-ketoisocaproate (KIC) by mitochondrial branched-chain aminotransferase (BCAT2) in muscle. A minority of KIC is oxidised in the cytosol, largely in liver, to HMB by the enzyme identified as 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPD), so HMB production is a side activity of a tyrosine-catabolism e ...
pathway_zh: leucine 在肌肉中由线粒体 branched-chain aminotransferase (BCAT2) 可逆转氨为 alpha-ketoisocaproate (KIC)。少部分 KIC 在胞质中被氧化为 HMB, 主要在肝, 催化该反应的酶已鉴定为 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPD), 因此 HMB 的生成是一个 tyrosine 分解酶的副反应。HMB 部分转化为 HMG-CoA, 在肌细胞内进入胆固醇合成。
daily_amount: About 0.2 to 0.4 g/day in a 70 kg adult, varying with dietary leucine (Nissen S, Abumrad NN, J Nutr Biochem 1997;8:300-11; reviewed PMID 28493406). Roughly 5 percent of whole-body leucine flux is converted to HMB (PMID 2 ...

still_matters_when: Catabolic and disuse states where the muscle-sparing data are strongest: bed rest, immobilisation, sarcopenia, cachexia, hypocaloric dieting and clinical recovery. In trained, well-fed lifters the effect sizes are small and contested. The axis does not rule HMB out, because supplemental doses are an order of magnitude above endogenous output.
still_matters_when_zh: 肌肉保护数据最强的分解代谢和失用状态: 卧床, 制动, 肌少症, 恶病质, 低热量饮食和临床康复期。在训练有素, 营养充足的举重者中, 效应量小且有争议。这条轴并不排除 HMB, 因为补充剂量比内源产量高出一个数量级。

endogenous_note: Two different verdicts in one row, so take them separately. Quercetin is a plant flavonol and no animal synthesises flavonoids at all, since the pathway requires chalcone synthase, which humans lack; every microgram is dietary, there is no deficiency state and no requirement, so any case for it must be pharmacological and runs into poor bioavailability and heavy conjugation. Plants build it from phenylalanine via PAL, 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase, flavanone 3-hydroxylase and flavonol synthase; human enzymology is limited to conjugation and degradation (intestinal and hepatic UGT, SULT, COMT, plus gut microbial ring fission). endogenous: FULL (the protein) / CONDITIONAL (glycine and proline supply, contested)
endogenous_note: You build every collagen fibril in your body yourself, from glycine, proline and lysine, with vitamin C and copper as cofactors, and there is no dietary requirement for collagen as a molecule. Nothing you swallow is installed intact: ingested collagen is digested to amino acids and short peptides before absorption. That makes oral collagen a weak premise as replacement therapy for a molecule you are not short of. The second label covers precursors, where the picture is genuinely unsettled: if the Melendez-Hevia calculation of a roughly 10 g/day glycine shortfall holds, precursor supply is conditional rather than  ...

endogenous_note: Cartilage manufactures both of these on site from glucose and glutamine. endogenous_note: Glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in the body, about 20 percent of the free amino acid pool in blood and 40 to 60 percent in muscle and liver, and whole-body endogenous production is 40 to 80 g/day, with skeletal muscle the dominant synthetic site and net exporter to enterocytes and immune cells while lung, liver, brain and adipose also contribute. A healthy adult eating normally is nowhere near short, so a 5 g scoop for leaky gut is a rounding error against the flux already arriving at the gut wall, and leaky gut is not a validated clinical entity in the first place, so the scoop has no defined targ ...
endogenous_note_zh: glutamine 是体内含量最高的游离氨基酸, 约占血中游离氨基酸池的 20%, 在肌肉和肝占 40% 到 60%, 全身内源生成 40 到 80 g/day, 骨骼肌是主要合成部位和净输出者, 向肠上皮细胞和免疫细胞输送, 肺, 肝, 脑和脂肪组织也有贡献。正常进食的健康成人远谈不上缺乏, 所以为肠漏而吃的 5 g 一勺, 相对已抵达肠壁的通量只是舍入误差, 而肠漏本身也不是经过验证的临床实体, 这一勺没有明确的作用目标。在严重分解代谢疾病中情况确实变化, 需求超过合成, 血浆 glutamine 下降, 这就是条件性必需的含义: 通常自给, 在特定状态下不足。
pathway: Glutamate plus ammonia gives glutamine via ATP-dependent glutamine synthetase (GLUL), predominantly in skeletal muscle, also liver, lung, brain and adipose. daily_amount: Whole-body endogenous production is 40 to 80 g/day by isotopic and pharmacokinetic estimates, with muscle the dominant site rather than the sole one (PMC6266414, Cruzat V et al., Nutrients 2018;10:1564).

Dose and route are not neutral: high-dose glutamine given to unselected critically ill patients with multiorgan failure increased mortality in the REDOXS trial (PMID 23594003). For a healthy adult with digestive complaints, the 40 ...

supplement: Zinc, magnesium and other mineral elements
endogenous_note: No organism synthesises a chemical element, so zinc, magnesium, iron, selenium, iodine, calcium, potassium, copper, chromium, manganese, boron and lithium are all NONE, and this is the cleanest category on the whole axis. It is also the category where NONE does imply need: several of these have an RDA and a described deficiency disease, so the axis supports repletion when intake or status is low and says nothing for dosing above requirement, where upper limits and interactions start to bite. endogenous_note: This row joins two halves the dataset already carried separately: enterocytes turn glutamine into citrulline, the kidney turns citrulline into arginine, and NOS turns arginine into NO. In health that axis plus the urea cycle covers arginine, so arginine is conditionally indispensable in the IOM sense, required from the diet in growth, trauma, sepsis, small bowel failure and urea cycle defects. endogenous_note_zh: 本条把数据集里原本分开的两半连起来: 肠上皮细胞把 glutamine 变成 citrulline, 肾把 citrulline 变成 arginine, NOS 再把 arginine 变成 NO。健康状态下这条轴加上尿素循环足以覆盖 arginine, 所以在 IOM 的意义上 arginine 属条件性必需, 在生长, 创伤, 脓毒症, 小肠功能衰竭和尿素循环缺陷时需要从饮食获得。实际操作上, 口服 arginine 提高血浆 arginine 的效率很差, 因为肠和肝的 arginase 1 在首过时销毁了大部分剂量; 口服 citrulline 绕过 arginase, 每克提升血浆 arginine 更多, 这也是补剂市场转向 citrulline 的原因。creatine 合成还消耗 arginine 胍基的 20% 到 30%, 所以这两条目取自同一个池。

endogenous_note_zh: 两组共用一个标签, 实际读法相反。leucine, isoleucine 和 valine 是必需氨基酸, 所以这里的 NONE 确实意味着必需; 它不能为单独购买二十种里的三种提供理由: 肌肉蛋白合成需要所有必需氨基酸同时在场, 孤立的 BCAA 只提高 leucine 信号, 不提供用来建造的底物, 而与全蛋白或 leucine 配平对照相比的试验通常更支持全蛋白。至于这些维生素, 人体都没有相应合成通路, 缺乏症也很清楚 (B12 和 folate 的巨细胞性贫血与亚急性联合变性, thiamine 的 Wernicke 脑病与脚气病, B6 的癫痫发作与皮炎)。三条限定比标签更重要。肠道细菌确实在结肠内生成 folate, biotin, riboflavin 和 B12 类似物, 但结肠吸收有限, 对人体状态的贡献未定量, 所以本数据集把它算作不确定的外源供应。B12 是通常在吸 ...
pathway: BCAA: NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis, since the bacterial and plant route through acetohydroxyacid synthase, ketol-acid reductoisomerase and dihydroxyacid dehydratase is absent in humans. Human enzymology is degradative: BCAT2 in muscle transaminates leucine, isoleucine and valine to KIC, KMV and KIV, then the branched-chain alpha-ketoacid  ...
pathway_zh: BCAA: 合成为 NOT APPLICABLE, 细菌和植物经 acetohydroxyacid synthase, ketol-acid reductoisomerase 和 dihydroxyacid dehydratase 的路线在人体不存在。人体酶学是分解性的: 肌肉中的 BCAT2 把 leucine, isoleucine 和 valine 转氨为 KIC, KMV 和 KIV, 随后分支链 alpha 酮酸脱氢酶复合体 (BCKDHA, BCKDHB, DBT ...
