daily_amount_zh: BCAA: 0 g/day, 人体不合成; 成人需求 (FAO/WHO/UNU 2007) 为 leucine 39 mg/kg/day, valine 26 mg/kg/day, isoleucine 20 mg/kg/day, 70 kg 成人约 2.7 g, 1.8 g 和 1.4 g/day, 56 g 混合蛋 ...
still_matters_when: BCAA: hepatic encephalopathy, where BCAA formulations have a specific rationale and Cochrane-level support for encephalopathy endpoints, plus some cirrhosis and ICU nutrition; maple syrup urine disease is the mirror image, where BCAA must be restricted. For a lifter already at 1.6 g/kg/day of protein the isolated powder adds nothing. Vitamins: vegans and long-term vegetarians (B12, the clearest su ...
still_matters_when_zh: BCAA: 肝性脑病, 此时 BCAA 配方有明确依据, 在脑病终点上有 Cochrane 级别支持, 另有部分肝硬化和重症营养; 枫糖尿病是镜像情形, 必须限制 BCAA。对已经摄入 1.6 g/kg/day 蛋白的举重者, 孤立的 BCAA 粉不增加任何东西。维生素: 纯素者和长期素食者 (B12, 营养学中最明确的补充指征); 恶性贫血, 胃切除, 回肠切除, metformin 和长期质子泵抑制剂; 孕前和妊娠 (叶酸 400 micrograms/day 预防神经管缺陷, 有结局证据); 酒精依赖和再喂养 (thiamine 要在葡萄糖之前给, ...
source: FAO/WHO/UNU, Protein and Amino Acid Requirements in Human Nutrition, WHO Tech Rep Ser 935, 2007; Wolfe RR, Branched-chain amino acids and muscle protein synthes ...

endogenous_note: Skin makes vitamin D3 photochemically: UVB at 290 to 315 nm opens 7-dehydrocholesterol to previtamin D3, which isomerises thermally, after which CYP2R1 in liver makes 25(OH)D and renal CYP27B1 makes the hormone 1,25(OH)2D. The route exists in everyone and fails predictably with high latitude, winter, sun avoidance, clothing, sunscreen, dark skin pigmentation, age and obesity, which makes this the strongest case in existence for an endogenous pathway that can fail. It is also the calibration point for the FULL and PARTIAL boundary in this dataset: here deficiency is common, cheaply measurable as serum 25(OH)D, and ...
endogenous_note_zh: 皮肤以光化学方式生成维生素 D3: 290 至 315 nm 的 UVB 使 7-dehydrocholesterol 开环成为 previtamin D3, 后者再经热异构化, 随后肝脏的 CYP2R1 生成 25(OH)D, 肾脏的 CYP27B1 生成激素形式 1,25(OH)2D。这条路线人人具备, 但会随高纬度, 冬季, 避光, 衣物遮盖, 防晒霜, 深色皮肤, 年龄与肥胖而可预期地失效, 这使它成为现存最有力的例子: 内源通路存在, 却可能失效。它也是本数据集中 FULL 与 PARTIAL 分界的校准点: 这里的缺乏很常见, 可通过血清 25(OH)D 廉价测量, 并在佝偻病与骨软化中具有临床后果, 而本组其他内部中间体恰恰不具备这些特征。
pathway: 7-dehydrocholesterol (a mevalonate pathway intermediate and the DHCR7 substrate) plus UVB to previtamin D3 in epidermis, then thermal isomerisation to vitamin D3; 25-hydroxylation by CYP2R1 in liver; 1alpha-hydroxylation by CYP27B1 in kidney under PTH and FGF23 control; inactivation by CYP24A1; carried on DBP (GC) and acting through VDR.
pathway_zh: 表皮中的 7-dehydrocholesterol (mevalonate 通路中间体, 也是 DHCR7 的底物) 在 UVB 作用下生成 previtamin D3, 再经热异构化成为维生素 D3; 肝脏 CYP2R1 进行 25 位羟化; 肾脏 CYP27B1 在 PTH 与 FGF23 调控下进行 1alpha 位羟化; CYP24A1 负责失活; 由 DBP (GC) 转运, 通过 VDR 起作用。
daily_amount: No single endogenous rate applies, because production scales with UVB dose, skin type and exposed area. Sourced anchors: RDA 600 IU/day (15 micrograms) for ages 1 to 70 and 800 IU/day above 70, UL 4,000 IU/day, all defin ...
daily_amount_zh: 没有单一的内源速率可用, 因为生成量随 UVB 剂量, 皮肤类型与暴露面积变化。有来源的参照值: 1 至 70 岁 RDA 600 IU/day (15 micrograms), 70 岁以上 800 IU/day, UL 4,000 IU/day, 这些数值都以日照极少为前提设定 (IOM 2011); 血清 25( ...
still_matters_when: Deficiency and its risk groups: institutionalised or housebound people, those who cover the skin or avoid sun, dark skin at high latitude, fat malabsorption, obesity, and anticonvulsant or glucocorticoid therapy, plus infants, pregnancy and lactation. CYP24A1 and DHCR7 related disorders need specialist care. Excess causes hypercalcaemia, so mega-dosing is not a stronger version of adequacy, and in ...
still_matters_when_zh: 缺乏及其高危人群: 长期居于机构或足不出户者, 遮盖皮肤或避光者, 高纬度地区的深色皮肤人群, 脂肪吸收不良, 肥胖, 以及使用抗癫痫药或糖皮质激素者, 另有婴儿, 妊娠与哺乳期。CYP24A1 与 DHCR7 相关疾病需要专科处理。过量会引起高钙血症, 因此超大剂量并非更强的充足状态, 而在骨折与跌倒试验中, 间断超大剂量给药的表现不如每日给药。
source: IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D (2011), NCBI Bookshelf NBK56070; Holick, N Engl J Med 2007;357:266-281

supplement: Omega-3 EPA and DHA (fish or algal oil)
endogenous_note: No animal enzyme introduces a double bond at the n-3 position, so alpha-linolenic acid is strictly dietary and genuinely essential; what exists endogenously is conversion. FADS2, ELOVL5, FADS1, ELOVL2 and one peroxisomal beta-oxidation step turn ALA into EPA and then DHA, and the efficiency of that conversion is the entire decision for this product class. It is low and unusually well quantified, with DHA the bottleneck because the last steps compete for the same FADS2 enzyme. Women of reproductive age convert appreciably better than men, and FADS1 and FADS2 haplotypes shift it further, so preformed EPA and DHA fr ...
endogenous_note_zh: 动物体内没有任何酶能在 n-3 位引入双键, 因此 alpha-linolenic acid 严格依赖膳食, 是真正的必需脂肪酸; 内源存在的只是转化。FADS2, ELOVL5, FADS1, ELOVL2 以及一步过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化把 ALA 转成 EPA 再转成 DHA, 而这一转化效率就是这一类产品的全部决策依据。该效率很低, 且被量化得异常清楚, DHA 是瓶颈, 因为最后几步与同一个 FADS2 酶竞争。育龄女性的转化明显优于男性, FADS1 与 FADS2 单倍型会进一步改变结果, 因此来自鱼油或藻油的预成型 EPA 与 DHA 是绕过这一步的唯一可靠办法。
pathway: ALA (18:3n-3) to 18:4n-3 by FADS2, to 20:4n-3 by ELOVL5, to EPA (20:5n-3) by FADS1; EPA to 22:5n-3 by ELOVL5, to 24:5n-3 by ELOVL2, desaturated by FADS2 to 24:6n-3, then one round of peroxisomal beta-oxidation gives DHA (22:6n-3). Mainly hepatic endoplasmic reticulum plus peroxisomes; the same enzymes handle the n-6 series, so linoleic ac ...
pathway_zh: ALA (18:3n-3) 经 FADS2 生成 18:4n-3, 经 ELOVL5 生成 20:4n-3, 经 FADS1 生成 EPA (20:5n-3); EPA 经 ELOVL5 生成 22:5n-3, 经 ELOVL2 生成 24:5n-3, 由 FADS2 去饱和为 24:6n-3, 再经一轮过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化生成 DHA (22:6n-3)。主要在肝内质网与过氧化物酶体; 同一组酶也处理 n-6 系列, 因此 linoleic acid 摄入会直接竞争 ...
daily_amount: 0 mg/day for ALA itself, which must be eaten. Isotope-tracer estimates of conversion from ALA are roughly 8% to EPA and 0 to 4% to DHA in men, and about 21% to EPA and 9% to DHA in young women. Adequate Intake for ALA is ...
daily_amount_zh: ALA 本身为 0 mg/day, 必须由食物摄入。同位素示踪估计的转化率为男性约 8% 转为 EPA, 0 至 4% 转为 DHA; 年轻女性约 21% 转为 EPA, 9% 转为 DHA。ALA 的适宜摄入量为男性 1.6 g/day, 女性 1.1 g/day (IOM 2005); 常见补充剂提供 EPA 加  ...
still_matters_when: Low or absent intake of preformed EPA and DHA, which covers vegetarian, vegan and low-fish diets, where algal DHA is the direct fix. Pregnancy and lactation, because fetal and infant DHA accretion is high. Severe hypertriglyceridaemia, where prescription icosapent ethyl at 4 g/day has outcome trial support under a clinician. High doses raise bleeding risk in combination with anticoagulants, and so ...
still_matters_when_zh: 预成型 EPA 与 DHA 摄入很低或为零的情形, 包括素食, 纯素与少鱼饮食, 此时藻源 DHA 是直接的解决办法。妊娠与哺乳期, 因为胎儿与婴儿的 DHA 沉积需求高。严重高甘油三酯血症, 此时处方 icosapent ethyl 4 g/day 在临床医生管理下有结局试验支持。大剂量与抗凝药合用会增加出血风险, 部分试验报告 4 g/day 时心房颤动增多。
source: Burdge & Wootton, Br J Nutr 2002;88:411-420 (women); Burdge, Jones & Wootton, Br J Nutr 2002;88:355-363 (men); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Energy, Carboh ...

endogenous_note: Glutathione is synthesised in every cell from glutamate, cysteine and glycine by GCLC/GCLM and glutathione synthetase, held at millimolar intracellular concentrations, and the human rate is one of the few in this dataset that has actually been measured: 747 +/- 216 micromol/L/day in whole blood with 65% of the pool replaced daily. Cysteine availability is the usual limiting input, which is what NAC supplies, so NAC is best understood as substrate delivery rather than glutathione replacement, and GlyNAC adds glycine on the argument that both precursors fall with age. Swallowed glutathione itself is largely broken  ...
endogenous_note_zh: Glutathione 在每个细胞中由 glutamate, cysteine 与 glycine 经 GCLC/GCLM 与 glutathione synthetase 合成, 细胞内维持毫摩尔浓度, 而它的人体合成速率是本数据集中少数真正被实测过的: 全血 747 +/- 216 micromol/L/day, 池中 65% 每天被替换。通常的限制性输入是 cysteine 的可获得量, 这正是 NAC 所提供的, 因此 NAC 更应理解为底物供给, 而非替代 glutathione; GlyNAC 再加上 glycine, 理由是两种前体都随年龄下降。吞服的 glutathione 本身大部分被肠道与肝脏的 gamma-glutamyl transferase 与二肽酶分解回同样的三种氨基酸, 这也是口服形式提高细胞内池效果很弱的原因。
pathway: Glutamate + cysteine to gamma-glutamylcysteine by GCLC/GCLM, which is feedback inhibited by GSH, then + glycine to GSH by GSS; export and recovery through the gamma-glutamyl cycle (GGT1 and dipeptidases); recycling from GSSG by glutathione reductase using NADPH. Cysteine comes from dietary cysteine or from methionine through transsulfurat ...
pathway_zh: Glutamate 加 cysteine 经 GCLC/GCLM 生成 gamma-glutamylcysteine, 该步受 GSH 反馈抑制, 再加 glycine 经 GSS 生成 GSH; 通过 gamma-glutamyl 循环 (GGT1 与二肽酶) 输出与回收; GSSG 由 glutathione reductase 利用 NADPH 再生。Cysteine 来自膳食 cysteine, 或由 methionine 经转硫途径生成 (CBS, CTH, 需要维 ...
daily_amount: Whole-blood synthesis 747 +/- 216 micromol/L/day, a per-litre-of-blood rate that understates whole-body synthesis since liver dominates; whole-body turnover is usually described as multi-gram per day. Oral NAC is dosed a ...
daily_amount_zh: 全血合成 747 +/- 216 micromol/L/day, 这是按每升血液计的速率, 由于肝脏占主导, 它低估了全身合成量; 全身周转通常被描述为每天数克量级。口服 NAC 剂量为 600 至 1,800 mg/day, 而对乙酰氨基酚中毒的标准院内方案是 21 小时静脉输注。
still_matters_when: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) overdose, where intravenous NAC is life-saving and strictly time-dependent, mucolysis in cystic fibrosis and chronic bronchitis, selected toxicological settings under a clinician, and inborn errors such as glutathione synthetase deficiency or 5-oxoprolinuria. Diets poor in sulfur amino acids lower synthesis measurably, which is a protein intake problem before it is a su ...
still_matters_when_zh: 对乙酰氨基酚过量, 此时静脉 NAC 可救命且严格依赖时间窗; 囊性纤维化与慢性支气管炎的化痰; 临床医生管理下的特定毒理情形; 以及 glutathione synthetase 缺乏或 5-oxoprolinuria 等先天缺陷。含硫氨基酸不足的膳食会可测量地降低合成, 这首先是蛋白摄入问题, 其次才是补充剂问题。在细胞毒化疗期间, 适用与抗氧化剂那一行相同的谨慎原则。
source: PMID 10792033 (Lyons et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2000;97:5071-5076); Prescott et al., BMJ 1979;2:1097-1100 (intravenous NAC in paracetamol poisoning)

endogenous_note: Humans make taurine from cysteine through CDO1 and then CSAD, with decarboxylation the limiting step, and human CSAD activity is low compared with rodents, so plasma and tissue taurine depend appreciably on intake from fish, shellfish and meat. Adults on very low intakes fall in plasma taurine without usually reaching a clinical deficiency, and the real failure cases are long-term parenteral nutrition, preterm infants and cats, which cannot synthesise it at all. Recent longevity claims rest on animal work plus observational human data, so on the endogenous axis this is a genuine PARTIAL with no established human  ...
endogenous_note_zh: 人体由 cysteine 经 CDO1 再经 CSAD 合成 taurine, 限速步骤是脱羧, 而人类 CSAD 活性与啮齿类相比很低, 因此血浆与组织 taurine 在相当程度上依赖来自鱼类, 贝类与肉类的摄入。摄入极低的成人血浆 taurine 会下降, 但通常达不到临床缺乏, 真正的失效情形是长期肠外营养, 早产儿, 以及完全不能合成的猫。近期关于长寿的主张依据动物研究加观察性人体数据, 因此在内源合成这一维度上它是真正的 PARTIAL, 普通饮食下并无既定的人体缺乏。
pathway: Cysteine to cysteine sulfinate by CDO1, decarboxylation by CSAD to hypotaurine, then oxidation to taurine; a parallel route runs through cysteamine and ADO. Liver is the main site. Taurine is conjugated to bile acids by BAAT and retained in tissue by the transporter SLC6A6 (TauT), which is what actually sets muscle, heart and retinal leve ...
pathway_zh: Cysteine 经 CDO1 生成 cysteine sulfinate, 经 CSAD 脱羧生成 hypotaurine, 再氧化为 taurine; 另有一条经 cysteamine 与 ADO 的平行路线。主要合成部位是肝脏。Taurine 由 BAAT 与胆汁酸结合, 并由转运体 SLC6A6 (TauT) 在组织中保留, 真正决定肌肉, 心脏与视网膜水平的是这个转运体。
daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED as a measured human de novo rate; endogenous synthesis is generally described as low, on the order of tens of milligrams per day. Dietary intake is roughly 40 to 400 mg/day in omnivores and close to zero  ...
daily_amount_zh: 人体从头合成速率 NOT ESTABLISHED, 内源合成通常被描述为很低, 在每天数十毫克量级。杂食者膳食摄入约 40 至 400 mg/day, 严格纯素者接近于零。补充剂量为 500 至 3,000 mg/day, 一罐能量饮料约含 1,000 mg。
still_matters_when: Taurine-free long-term parenteral nutrition and preterm infants, where supplementation is standard practice, and SLC6A6 mutations causing retinal degeneration and cardiomyopathy, where it is treatment. Strict vegan diets give the lowest intakes and the lowest plasma levels. Otherwise use rests on trial endpoints, and the ageing claims do not yet have a human trial behind them.
still_matters_when_zh: 不含 taurine 的长期肠外营养与早产儿, 此时补充是标准做法; SLC6A6 突变导致的视网膜退化与心肌病, 此时补充属于治疗。严格纯素饮食的摄入量与血浆水平最低。除此之外只看试验终点, 而关于衰老的主张目前还没有人体试验支撑。
source: Ripps & Shen, Mol Vis 2012;18:2673-2686; Stipanuk, Annu Rev Nutr 2004;24:539-577

endogenous_note: Humans do make choline de novo: PEMT methylates phosphatidylethanolamine three times using SAM to give phosphatidylcholine, mostly in liver and strongly oestrogen responsive. That output does not cover requirement, which is why choline is classified as conditionally essential with an Adequate Intake rather than treated as fully endogenous: controlled depletion studies produce liver and muscle damage in most men and postmenopausal women within weeks, reversed by refeeding choline. Betaine sits downstream, made from choline by CHDH and ALDH7A1, and is fully endogenous given choline; it is used as a drug in homocyst ...
endogenous_note_zh: 人体确实能从头合成 choline: PEMT 利用 SAM 对 phosphatidylethanolamine 进行三次甲基化生成 phosphatidylcholine, 主要在肝脏, 并明显受雌激素调节。这一产出不足以覆盖需求, 因此 choline 被归为条件必需并设适宜摄入量, 而非视为完全内源: 受控耗竭研究在数周内即在多数男性与绝经后女性中造成肝与肌肉损伤, 补回 choline 后可逆转。Betaine 位于下游, 由 choline 经 CHDH 与 ALDH7A1 生成, 在 choline 充足的前提下完全内源, 并在 homocystinuria 中作为药物使用。常见的 PEMT 与 MTHFD1 变异会改变膳食需要提供的份额, 这是少数基因型会改变补充剂决策的场合之一。
pathway: De novo: phosphatidylethanolamine plus three SAM to phosphatidylcholine by PEMT (liver). From dietary choline, the CDP-choline (Kennedy) pathway runs CHKA/CHKB, PCYT1A and CHPT1. Oxidation to betaine by CHDH then ALDH7A1 in mitochondria feeds BHMT, which remethylates homocysteine to methionine. Acetylcholine synthesis by ChAT is a small b ...
pathway_zh: 从头合成: phosphatidylethanolamine 加三个 SAM 经 PEMT 生成 phosphatidylcholine (肝脏)。以膳食 choline 为起点的 CDP-choline (Kennedy) 通路依次是 CHKA/CHKB, PCYT1A 与 CHPT1。在线粒体中经 CHDH 再经 ALDH7A1 氧化为 betaine, 供给 BHMT, 后者把 homocysteine 再甲基化为 methionine。ChAT 合成乙酰胆碱是一条量小 ...
daily_amount: PEMT contributes roughly 15 to 30% of hepatic phosphatidylcholine, and no whole-body endogenous choline synthesis rate is established. Adequate Intake is 550 mg/day for men and 425 mg/day for women, UL 3,500 mg/day (IOM  ...
daily_amount_zh: PEMT 贡献肝脏 phosphatidylcholine 的大约 15 至 30%, 全身内源 choline 合成速率没有既定数值。适宜摄入量为男性 550 mg/day, 女性 425 mg/day, UL 3,500 mg/day (IOM 1998), 而调查数据显示多数成人低于适宜摄入量。Betaine 补 ...
still_matters_when: Depletion states with hard endpoints: parenteral nutrition associated liver disease, pregnancy and lactation where fetal and infant demand is high, and postmenopausal women, who lose the oestrogen driven induction of PEMT. Betaine is established treatment in homocystinuria and is used in MTHFR related hyperhomocysteinaemia. High choline or betaine intake raises TMAO through gut bacteria, and very  ...
still_matters_when_zh: 有硬终点的耗竭状态: 肠外营养相关肝病, 胎儿与婴儿需求高的妊娠与哺乳期, 以及失去雌激素驱动 PEMT 诱导的绝经后女性。Betaine 是 homocystinuria 的既定治疗, 也用于 MTHFR 相关高同型半胱氨酸血症。高 choline 或 betaine 摄入会经肠道菌提高 TMAO, 而极高剂量 choline 会引起鱼腥体味与低血压。
source: Zeisel & da Costa, Nutr Rev 2009;67:615-623; IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Thiamin, Riboflavin, Niacin, Vitamin B6, Folate, Vitamin B12, Pantothenic Acid,  ...

endogenous_note: SAM is made from methionine and ATP by MAT1A in liver and MAT2A elsewhere, and human flux through it is on the order of grams per day, because it donates methyl groups to DNA and histones, phospholipids, creatine synthesis, catecholamine inactivation and nicotinamide clearance. Nothing about a capsule is repletion in someone eating normal protein. The interesting direction runs the other way: several products in this dataset draw on the same methyl pool, since NNMT methylates surplus nicotinamide from NAM, NMN or NR, and GAMT spends a methyl group on every molecule of creatine, which is the mechanistic link that  ...
endogenous_note_zh: SAM 由 methionine 与 ATP 经肝脏的 MAT1A 或其他组织的 MAT2A 生成, 人体通过它的通量在每天数克量级, 因为它向 DNA 与组蛋白, 磷脂, creatine 合成, 儿茶酚胺失活与 nicotinamide 清除提供甲基。对蛋白摄入正常的人来说, 胶囊与补足缺口无关。真正值得关注的方向相反: 本数据集中若干产品都动用同一个甲基池, NNMT 会甲基化来自 NAM, NMN 或 NR 的多余 nicotinamide, GAMT 每合成一分子 creatine 消耗一个甲基, 这条机制联系说明该检查的是 B12, folate 与 B6 状态, 而非 SAM 摄入。口服 SAMe 化学上不稳定且生物利用度差, 所以才有肠溶盐与注射剂型。
pathway: Methionine + ATP to SAM by MAT1A (liver) or MAT2A/MAT2B; methyl transfer by roughly 200 methyltransferases yields S-adenosylhomocysteine, hydrolysed by AHCY to homocysteine, which is either remethylated by MTR using 5-methyl-THF and vitamin B12 or by BHMT using betaine, or committed to transsulfuration by CBS with vitamin B6. SAM is also  ...
pathway_zh: Methionine 加 ATP 经 MAT1A (肝脏) 或 MAT2A/MAT2B 生成 SAM; 约 200 种甲基转移酶进行甲基转移后生成 S-adenosylhomocysteine, 由 AHCY 水解为 homocysteine, 后者或由 MTR 利用 5-methyl-THF 与维生素 B12 再甲基化, 或由 BHMT 利用 betaine 再甲基化, 或经 CBS 在维生素 B6 参与下进入转硫途径。SAM 也可由 AMD1 脱羧, 为多胺合成提供 am ...
daily_amount: Whole-body transmethylation flux is on the order of several grams of SAM per day in adults, with hepatic synthesis dominant, and no single consensus figure is established. Supplement doses are 400 to 1,600 mg/day, well b ...
daily_amount_zh: 成人全身转甲基通量在每天数克 SAM 量级, 以肝脏合成为主, 没有统一的公认数值。补充剂量为 400 至 1,600 mg/day, 远低于每日通量。
still_matters_when: MAT1A deficiency and related methylation disorders under specialist care, and trial-supported pharmacological use in depression or intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy. What is actually correctable is folate, B12 and B6 deficiency, which governs the cycle. Caution in bipolar disorder because of switch to mania, and with serotonergic drugs because of serotonin syndrome reports.
still_matters_when_zh: 专科管理下的 MAT1A 缺乏与相关甲基化疾病, 以及在抑郁或妊娠期肝内胆汁淤积中有试验支持的药理性使用。真正可纠正的是 folate, B12 与 B6 缺乏, 它们决定整个循环。双相情感障碍者需谨慎, 因为可能诱发转向躁狂; 与血清素能药物合用需谨慎, 因为已有血清素综合征报告。
source: Mato, Martinez-Chantar & Lu, Semin Liver Dis 2010;30:180-197; Lu & Mato, Physiol Rev 2012;92:1515-1542

endogenous_note: Alpha-ketoglutarate is an ordinary TCA cycle intermediate, produced continuously by isocitrate dehydrogenase and by transamination of glutamate, and consumed just as continuously by the OGDH complex and by a large family of 2-oxoglutarate dependent dioxygenases. The internal intermediate logic that applies to NMN applies here with even less ambiguity, because cellular flux through this metabolite dwarfs anything a 1 g capsule delivers, and most of an oral dose is metabolised in the gut wall and liver before it reaches the circulation. The human evidence is thin: the widely cited result is a mouse lifespan and hea ...
endogenous_note_zh: Alpha-ketoglutarate 是普通的 TCA 循环中间体, 由 isocitrate dehydrogenase 与 glutamate 转氨持续生成, 也被 OGDH 复合体以及一大类依赖 2-oxoglutarate 的双加氧酶同样持续消耗。适用于 NMN 的内部中间体逻辑在这里更加没有含糊之处, 因为细胞内经过该代谢物的通量远远超过 1 g 胶囊所能提供的量, 而口服剂量的大部分在到达循环之前已在肠壁与肝脏被代谢。人体证据薄弱: 被广泛引用的结果是一项使用 calcium AKG 的小鼠寿命与健康期研究, 人体数据则是一项无对照组的单臂生物学年龄标志物研究。
pathway: Isocitrate to alpha-ketoglutarate by IDH2 and IDH3 in mitochondria and IDH1 in cytosol; glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate by GLUD1 and by transaminases GOT1/GOT2 and GPT; consumed by the OGDH complex to succinyl-CoA and used as cosubstrate by prolyl hydroxylases (EGLN1-3, P4HA collagen hydroxylases), TET1-3 DNA demethylases, KDM histone de ...
pathway_zh: Isocitrate 经线粒体的 IDH2 与 IDH3 以及细胞质的 IDH1 生成 alpha-ketoglutarate; glutamate 经 GLUD1 以及转氨酶 GOT1/GOT2 与 GPT 生成 alpha-ketoglutarate; 由 OGDH 复合体消耗生成 succinyl-CoA, 并作为 prolyl hydroxylases (EGLN1-3, P4HA 胶原羟化酶), TET1-3 DNA 去甲基化酶, KDM 组蛋白去甲基化酶与 FTO ...
daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED as a discrete synthesis rate, because alpha-ketoglutarate is a flux intermediate rather than a pool that gets filled. TCA cycle flux underlies whole-body ATP turnover on the order of tens of moles per day ...
daily_amount_zh: 作为一个独立的合成速率 NOT ESTABLISHED, 因为 alpha-ketoglutarate 是通量中间体, 而非一个需要填满的池子。TCA 循环通量支撑着每天数十摩尔量级的全身 ATP 周转, 比作为 Ca-AKG 售卖的 1 至 2 g/day 高出若干个数量级。
still_matters_when: No deficiency state exists, so there is nothing to replete. Clinical use is confined to specific protocols such as ornithine alpha-ketoglutarate in some surgical, burn and dialysis nutrition settings, and otherwise to trial endpoints, of which there is currently no controlled human longevity trial. The calcium load matters for anyone with hypercalcaemia risk or on a calcium-restricted intake.
still_matters_when_zh: 不存在缺乏状态, 因此没有需要补足的对象。临床使用限于特定方案, 例如某些外科, 烧伤与透析营养场景中的 ornithine alpha-ketoglutarate, 其余只能依据试验终点, 而目前没有关于人体长寿的对照试验。对有高钙血症风险或需限钙者, 其钙负荷是需要考虑的问题。
source: Asadi Shahmirzadi et al., Cell Metab 2020;32:447-456.e6 (mice); Demidenko et al., Aging (Albany NY) 2021;13:24485-24499 (single-arm human study)

endogenous_note: Humans convert dietary phylloquinone (K1) and menadione to menaquinone-4 in tissue using UBIAD1, which prenylates the menadione ring, so the MK-4 in artery wall, bone and brain is partly endogenous even though the quinone ring itself is strictly dietary and cannot be synthesised. Colonic bacteria make long-chain menaquinones from MK-7 to MK-13, and their contribution to human vitamin K status is modest and hard to quantify because much of it stays unabsorbed in the colon. That combination is what makes vitamin K a real PARTIAL: the ring cannot be made, the specific K2 form largely can, given K1 in the diet.
endogenous_note_zh: 人体利用 UBIAD1 把膳食 phylloquinone (K1) 与 menadione 在组织中转化为 menaquinone-4, 该酶对 menadione 环进行异戊烯化, 因此动脉壁, 骨与脑中的 MK-4 部分是内源的, 尽管醌环本身严格依赖膳食且无法合成。结肠细菌合成 MK-7 至 MK-13 的长链 menaquinones, 它们对人体维生素 K 状态的贡献不大且难以量化, 因为其中很大一部分留在结肠未被吸收。这个组合使维生素 K 成为真正的 PARTIAL: 环无法自制, 而在膳食提供 K1 的前提下, 具体的 K2 形式基本可以自制。
pathway: K1 or menadione plus geranylgeranyl-PP to MK-4 by UBIAD1 in most tissues, after side-chain removal from phylloquinone. The vitamin acts as cofactor for GGCX, which gamma-carboxylates glutamate residues in prothrombin and factors VII, IX, X, in osteocalcin and in matrix Gla protein, and is regenerated by VKORC1, the warfarin target. Coloni ...
pathway_zh: 在多数组织中, K1 或 menadione 加 geranylgeranyl-PP 经 UBIAD1 生成 MK-4, phylloquinone 需先脱去侧链。该维生素作为 GGCX 的辅因子, 后者对 prothrombin 与因子 VII, IX, X, 对 osteocalcin 以及 matrix Gla protein 中的 glutamate 残基进行 gamma 羧化, 并由 warfarin 的靶点 VKORC1 再生。结肠细菌合成 MK-7 及更长链的  ...
daily_amount: No established endogenous rate for MK-4 conversion or for the microbial contribution. Adequate Intake for vitamin K is 120 micrograms/day for men and 90 micrograms/day for women, with no UL set (IOM 2001). Typical MK-7 s ...
daily_amount_zh: MK-4 转化速率与微生物贡献都没有既定的内源数值。维生素 K 适宜摄入量为男性 120 micrograms/day, 女性 90 micrograms/day, 未设 UL (IOM 2001)。常见 MK-7 补充剂提供 90 至 180 micrograms/day, 而 MK-4 产品的剂量常为数十毫克, 远 ...
still_matters_when: Newborns, who receive prophylactic vitamin K to prevent haemorrhagic disease of the newborn, and fat malabsorption from cholestasis, cystic fibrosis, coeliac disease or bariatric surgery. Also prolonged broad-spectrum antibiotics with poor intake, and VKORC1 or GGCX defects. Anyone on warfarin must not change vitamin K intake without clinician input, because the vitamin directly opposes the drug.
still_matters_when_zh: 新生儿, 需接受预防性维生素 K 以防新生儿出血症; 以及胆汁淤积, 囊性纤维化, 乳糜泻或减重手术导致的脂肪吸收不良。还包括长期广谱抗生素合并摄入不足, 以及 VKORC1 或 GGCX 缺陷。使用 warfarin 者不得在没有临床医生意见的情况下改变维生素 K 摄入, 因为该维生素与药物直接拮抗。
source: Nakagawa et al., Nature 2010;468:117-121 (UBIAD1 identified as the MK-4 biosynthetic enzyme); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic,  ...

endogenous_note: This is the row that the NMN and NR entries keep pointing at without having. Nicotinamide is regenerated continuously inside cells as NAD is consumed by CD38, PARPs and sirtuins, and liver makes the pyridine ring de novo from tryptophan through the kynurenine pathway, so part of the supply is genuinely endogenous. The vitamin requirement exists because that de novo route is limited, runs essentially only in liver, and starts from tryptophan, which is itself dietary. Practically, plain nicotinamide and nicotinic acid are the established correction for niacin deficiency, feed exactly the same NAD pool as NMN and NR ...
endogenous_note_zh: 这是 NMN 与 NR 条目反复指向却一直缺失的一行。当 NAD 被 CD38, PARPs 与 sirtuins 消耗时, nicotinamide 在细胞内不断再生, 而肝脏可由 tryptophan 经 kynurenine 通路从头合成吡啶环, 因此供给中有一部分确实是内源的。维生素需求之所以存在, 是因为这条从头合成路线容量有限, 基本只在肝脏运行, 且起点 tryptophan 本身依赖膳食。实际层面上, 普通 nicotinamide 与 nicotinic acid 是烟酸缺乏的既定纠正手段, 供给的正是与 NMN 和 NR 相同的 NAD 池, 而价格只是后者的一个零头, 这正是购买新产品的人应当看到的对比。
pathway: De novo: tryptophan through IDO1 or TDO2, kynurenine, 3-hydroxyanthranilate, past the ACMSD branch point, then QPRT to nicotinic acid mononucleotide, NMNAT and NADSYN1 to NAD+, dominated by liver. Salvage: nicotinamide plus PRPP to NMN by NAMPT; nicotinic acid enters through NAPRT in the Preiss-Handler route. Clearance: NNMT methylates ni ...
pathway_zh: 从头合成: tryptophan 经 IDO1 或 TDO2, kynurenine, 3-hydroxyanthranilate, 越过 ACMSD 分支点, 再经 QPRT 生成 nicotinic acid mononucleotide, 由 NMNAT 与 NADSYN1 生成 NAD+, 以肝脏为主。补救合成: nicotinamide 加 PRPP 经 NAMPT 生成 NMN; nicotinic acid 经 NAPRT 进入 Preiss-Handler 路 ...
daily_amount: No separate endogenous rate is established. RDA is 16 mg NE/day for men and 14 mg NE/day for women, with 60 mg dietary tryptophan equal to 1 mg NE, and the UL is 35 mg/day for supplemental nicotinic acid and nicotinamide ...
daily_amount_zh: 没有单独确立的内源速率。RDA 为男性 16 mg NE/day, 女性 14 mg NE/day, 膳食 tryptophan 60 mg 折合 1 mg NE; 补充型 nicotinic acid 与 nicotinamide 的 UL 为 35 mg/day, 依据是面部潮红 (IOM DRI 1998)。药理 ...
still_matters_when: Pellagra and its risk settings: chronic alcohol use, isoniazid therapy, Hartnup disease, carcinoid syndrome and severe malabsorption, where vitamin-dose repletion resolves the disease cheaply. Nicotinamide at 500 mg twice daily reduced new keratinocyte cancers in high-risk patients in the ONTRAC trial. High-dose nicotinic acid causes flushing, hepatotoxicity and worse glycaemic control, and added  ...
still_matters_when_zh: Pellagra 及其高危情形: 长期饮酒, isoniazid 治疗, Hartnup disease, 类癌综合征与严重吸收不良, 此时维生素剂量的补足即可低成本解决疾病。在 ONTRAC 试验中, nicotinamide 500 mg 每天两次减少了高危患者的新发角化细胞癌。大剂量 nicotinic acid 会引起潮红, 肝毒性与血糖控制恶化, 在 AIM-HIGH 与 HPS2-THRIVE 中加用于 statin 未能改善心血管结局, 因此药理剂量并不等于更强的维生素。
source: IOM DRI 1998, Niacin chapter, NCBI Bookshelf NBK114304; Chen et al., N Engl J Med 2015;373:1618-1626 (ONTRAC); PMID 29685734 (Liu et al., Cell Metab 2018;27:106 ...

endogenous_note: Quercetin is a plant flavonol, and no animal synthesises flavonoids at all, since the pathway requires chalcone synthase, which humans lack. Every microgram is dietary, there is no requirement and no deficiency state, so any case for it has to be pharmacological, and that case runs straight into poor bioavailability and heavy first-pass conjugation.
endogenous_note_zh: 槲皮素是植物黄酮醇，任何动物都不合成类黄酮，因为该途径需要 chalcone synthase，而人体没有这个酶。摄入的每一微克都来自饮食，既无需求量也无缺乏状态，所以任何理由都只能是药理学层面的，而这一路径立刻遇到生物利用度低和首过结合代谢强两个问题。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE in humans. Plants build it from phenylalanine via PAL, 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase, flavanone 3-hydroxylase and flavonol synthase. Human enzymology is limited to conjugation and degradation: intestinal and hepatic UGT, SULT and COMT, plus gut microbial ring fission.
pathway_zh: 在人体 NOT APPLICABLE。植物以苯丙氨酸为起点，经 PAL、4-coumaroyl-CoA、chalcone synthase、flavanone 3-hydroxylase 和 flavonol synthase 合成。人体的相关酶学只有结合与降解：肠道和肝的 UGT、SULT、COMT，以及肠道微生物的开环裂解。
daily_amount: 0 mg/day, no human synthesis. Dietary intake comes almost entirely as glycosides from onions, apples, tea and capers.
daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day，人体不合成。膳食摄入几乎全部以糖苷形式来自洋葱、苹果、茶和刺山柑。
still_matters_when: NEVER ON THIS AXIS, since there is no requirement and no deficiency. It can only be argued as a drug, and at ordinary oral doses free aglycone barely reaches plasma.
still_matters_when_zh: 在这条轴上 NEVER，因为既无需求量也无缺乏状态。它只能按药物来论证，而在常规口服剂量下，游离苷元几乎进不到血浆。
source: Winkel-Shirley B, Flavonoid biosynthesis: a colorful model for genetics, biochemistry, cell biology, and biotechnology, Plant Physiol 2001;126:485-93

endogenous_note: A healthy man's testes already make about 7 mg of testosterone a day, and output is pinned where it is by LH feedback through the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, so there is no idle synthetic capacity for a capsule to unlock. The compounds that reliably move testosterone are drugs (anabolic steroids, SARMs, hCG, aromatase inhibitors) and they work by overriding or suppressing that feedback loop, a pharmacological intervention with its own consequences and not nutritional repletion.
endogenous_note_zh: 健康男性的睾丸每天已生成约 7 mg 睾酮，产量由下丘脑-垂体-性腺轴的 LH 反馈钉在当前水平，不存在等待某粒胶囊释放的闲置合成能力。能可靠改变睾酮水平的化合物都是药物 (合成类固醇、SARMs、hCG、芳香化酶抑制剂)，其作用方式是压制或绕过这一反馈环，属于有自身后果的药理干预，与营养补足无关。

Human Leydig cells favour the delta-5 route: pregnenolone to 17-hydroxypregnenolone to DHEA to androstenedione or androstenediol to test ...
pathway_zh: 胆固醇由 StAR 转运进线粒体，这是类固醇生成的限速步骤；随后 CYP11A1 催化第一个定向酶促步骤，即侧链裂解生成孕烯醇酮。人的 Leydig 细胞偏好 delta-5 路线：孕烯醇酮到 17-羟孕烯醇酮到 DHEA 到雄烯二酮或雄烯二醇再到睾酮，3-beta-HSD 在后段起作用。CYP17A1 一个酶带两种活性，17-alpha-hydroxylase 和 17,20-lyase，人的 17,20-lyase 对 delta-4 底物活性差，这正是 delta-5  ...
daily_amount: About 7 mg/day of testosterone in healthy adult men (NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031, Endotext). The testes are the dominant source, with small adrenal and peripheral contributions; NBK279031 does not quantify that split, so th ...
daily_amount_zh: 健康成年男性每天约 7 mg 睾酮 (NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031, Endotext)。睾丸是主要来源，肾上腺和外周转化贡献很小；NBK279031 未对这一比例给出数值，因此这里不采用常被引用的超过 95 percent 来自睾丸和约 5 亿个 Leydig 细胞两个数字，后者在不同形态计量研究 ...
still_matters_when: Diagnosed hypogonadism, which is treated with prescription testosterone and clinician monitoring rather than with a booster; correcting a measured deficiency of a real cofactor such as vitamin D or zinc; and repairing the inputs that suppress the axis, meaning sleep, energy availability, alcohol and body fat.
still_matters_when_zh: 已确诊的性腺功能减退，治疗手段是处方睾酮加临床监测，与所谓增强剂无关；纠正实测存在缺乏的真实辅因子，例如维生素 D 或锌；修复压制该轴的输入因素，即睡眠、能量可得量、酒精和体脂。
source: NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031 (O'Donnell L, Smith LB, Endocrinology of the Testis and Spermatogenesis, Endotext); Payne AH, Hales DB, Overview of steroidogenic enzym ...

supplement: Test-booster plant ingredients (tribulus, fenugreek, ashwagandha withanolides)
endogenous_note: No animal synthesises any of these plant compounds, so they score NONE, but that NONE carries no implication of need: there is no requirement and no deficiency state for withanolides, protodioscin, fenugreek saponins or any of their relatives. NONE here means the same thing it means for caffeine and quercetin, which is that the axis is silent and the entire case has to be made pharmacologically, on human outcome data these ingredients mostly lack.
endogenous_note_zh: 任何动物都不合成这些植物成分，所以标为 NONE，但这个 NONE 不含任何需求含义：withanolides、protodioscin、葫芦巴皂苷及其同类都没有需求量，也没有缺乏状态。这里的 NONE 与咖啡因和槲皮素处的含义相同，即这条轴不作判断，全部论证只能落在药理学上，而这些成分大多缺少相应的人体结局数据。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE in humans, no biosynthetic pathway exists for any of these compounds. Plants build them from isoprenoid and steroid skeletons (withanolides from the mevalonate and steroid pathway, steroidal saponins such as protodioscin from cholesterol-derived sapogenins). Human enzymology is limited to phase I and phase II metabolism plu ...
pathway_zh: 在人体 NOT APPLICABLE，这些化合物都没有对应的生物合成途径。植物以类异戊二烯和固醇骨架合成它们 (withanolides 来自甲羟戊酸和固醇途径，protodioscin 等固醇皂苷来自胆固醇衍生的皂苷元)。人体的相关酶学只有 I 相和 II 相代谢，以及肠道微生物对糖基部分的水解。
daily_amount: 0 mg/day, no human synthesis of any of them.
daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day，其中任何一种人体都不合成。
still_matters_when: NEVER ON THIS AXIS. An analysis of best-selling online testosterone-boosting supplements found most ingredient claims unsupported by human data, with some products carrying very large vitamin and mineral doses (PMID 30621919, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12). Ashwagandha has separate stress and sleep literature that should be judged on its own outcome data, not on an endogenous-synthesis argument.
still_matters_when_zh: 在这条轴上 NEVER。一项针对网络热销睾酮增强类补剂的分析发现，多数成分宣称缺乏人体数据支持，部分产品还含有极大剂量的维生素和矿物质 (PMID 30621919, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12)。南非醉茄在压力和睡眠方面有独立文献，应按其自身的结局数据评判，与内源合成的论证无关。
source: PMID 30621919 (Balasubramanian A et al., Testosterone imposters: an analysis of popular online testosterone boosting supplements, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12)

supplement: Omega-3 EPA and DHA (fish and algal oil)
endogenous_note: Humans cannot make the parent omega-3, alpha-linolenic acid, at all, and the conversion of dietary ALA to the functional long-chain forms runs into a hard ceiling: roughly 5 to 8 percent to EPA and under 0.5 to 4 percent to DHA, higher in women than in men. The pathway is present and rate-limited at FADS2, and it competes with the much larger linoleic acid flux for the same desaturase, so a high omega-6 intake lowers the yield further. That combination, a required precursor plus a capped conversion, is what makes preformed EPA and DHA a coherent supplement rather than a duplicate of your own synthesis.
endogenous_note_zh: 人体完全无法合成母体 omega-3，即 alpha-linolenic acid，而膳食 ALA 向功能性长链形式的转化存在硬上限：到 EPA 约 5 to 8 percent，到 DHA 低于 0.5 to 4 percent，女性高于男性。该途径存在，限速点在 FADS2，并且要与通量大得多的亚油酸争夺同一去饱和酶，所以 omega-6 摄入偏高会进一步压低产率。需要外源前体加上转化受限，这一组合使得直接补充现成的 EPA 和 DHA 成立，而不是重复自身合成。

Oral glutathione is the weakest premise in this dataset: it is largely hydrolysed to its constituent amino acids by intestinal gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase and peptidases before it reaches the circulation, so what gets absorbed is the raw material the cell already had. The one part of the story that holds is substrate: cysteine is the limiting input and GCLC is feedback-inhibited by glutathione itself, which is why N-acetylcysteine ...

Capacity is also unevenly distributed: oestrogen upregulates PEMT, so premenopausal women are partly protected, while common PEMT and MTHFD1 variants raise the dietary requirement. Betaine is one step downstream of choline and feeds the same methylation economy that creatine synthesis ...

supplement: NAD precursors (NMN, NR, nicotinamide riboside marketing)
endogenous_note: NAD is not something you can be short of in the way the marketing implies. Humans make niacin from tryptophan at the canonical 60 mg tryptophan to 1 mg niacin equivalent ratio, and far more importantly, the NAMPT salvage pathway recycles nicotinamide released by NAD-consuming enzymes at high flux, which is where most NAD turnover comes from. So the vitamin requirement is real and modest, deficiency is pellagra, and the de novo route from tryptophan plus salvage covers ordinary needs. That makes NR and NMN pharmacological rather than repletion products: they raise blood NAD metabolites reliably, and the claim that ...
endogenous_note_zh: NAD 并不像营销暗示的那样会缺。人体可由色氨酸生成烟酸，换算比例是 60 mg 色氨酸对 1 mg 烟酸当量；更重要的是 NAMPT 补救途径以很高的通量回收由 NAD 消耗酶释放的烟酰胺，NAD 周转的大部分正来自这条路。所以维生素需求真实存在且量不大，缺乏症是烟酸缺乏病 (pellagra)，色氨酸从头合成加补救途径足以覆盖常规需要。这使 NR 和 NMN 属于药理学产品而非补足缺乏的产品：它们确实能稳定提高血中 NAD 代谢物，而这一变化能否在健康人身上带来临床或寿命方面的获益是另一个问题，人体试验尚未给出答案。

Nicotinic acid at gram doses is a lipid drug with flushing and hepatic and glycaemic effects, a pharmacological use with poor outcome data since the AIM-HIGH and HPS2-THRIVE trials. For NR and N ...
still_matters_when_zh: 烟酸缺乏病及其高风险情形：未经碱法处理的玉米为主食、长期饮酒、Hartnup 病、类癌综合征和异烟肼治疗，这些都会消耗色氨酸或阻断其转化。克级剂量的烟酸是一种调脂药物，伴有面部潮红以及肝和血糖方面的影响，属药理学用途，自 AIM-HIGH 和 HPS2-THRIVE 试验以来其结局数据不佳。对健康成人使用 NR 和 NMN，血中 NAD 代谢物确实升高，但临床价值未被证实，高通量的补救途径正是应对缺乏叙事保持怀疑的理由。

endogenous_note: Saffron's constituents are apocarotenoids: crocins, picrocrocin and safranal, cleaved from zeaxanthin in the stigmas of Crocus sativus. Human tissue makes no part of them, so the axis is silent and the case rests entirely on trial evidence. That evidence is positive but thin: mostly short trials at 30 mg/day, several from the same research groups, with independence and adulteration as the main things to check. The same reading applies to the other plant members of this group.
endogenous_note_zh: 番红花的成分是脱辅基类胡萝卜素：crocins、picrocrocin 和 safranal，由 Crocus sativus 柱头中的 zeaxanthin 裂解而来。人体组织不合成其中任何部分，因此这条判据无话可说，论据完全依赖试验证据。这些证据是阳性的但很薄：多为 30 mg/day 的短期试验，其中几项来自同一批研究组，主要要核查独立性和掺假。本组其他植物成分同理。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Apocarotenoids cleaved from zeaxanthin by carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase (CCD2) in Crocus sativus stigmas, then glycosylated to crocins; no human counterpart.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Crocus sativus 柱头中由 carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase (CCD2) 从 zeaxanthin 裂解出脱辅基类胡萝卜素，再糖苷化为 crocins，人体没有对应通路。
daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有生物合成通路)
still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on trial size and independence, on adulteration of one of the world's most expensive spices with safflower, dyes or other Crocus material, on the 30 mg/day dose used in most trials, and on serotonergic additivity with antidepressants.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条判据上没有适用情形。改为筛查试验规模和独立性、这种世界上最贵香料被红花、色素或其他 Crocus 材料掺假的情况、多数试验采用的 30 mg/day 剂量，以及与抗抑郁药的血清素能叠加。
source: PMID 25384672 (Lopresti AL & Drummond PD, Hum Psychopharmacol 2014, Saffron for depression)

supplement: B. longum subsp. longum 35624 (marketed historically as B. infantis 35624)
endogenous_note: Human cells never make bacteria, so the axis reads NONE, and the older rationale for this product has to be dropped: core-genome phylogeny reclassified strain 35624 as Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum, a common adult coloniser, so the infant-coloniser and adult colonisation-gap argument does not apply to it (Altmann, PLOS One 2016, PMC5033381). What distinguishes 35624 is the trial record: a fully identified single strain tested against placebo at a stated dose, which is the standard the rest of the category should be held to. Take it for that result, together with the dose and formulation caveats that come w ...
endogenous_note_zh: 人体细胞从不合成细菌，所以这条判据判为 NONE；同时该产品原有的生物学理由必须放弃：核心基因组系统发生分析把 35624 重新归类为 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum，这是成人常见的定植菌，因此婴儿定植菌和成人定植缺口的论证对它不适用 (Altmann, PLOS One 2016, PMC5033381)。35624 的特点在于试验记录：一个完全鉴定的单一菌株，在明确剂量下与安慰剂对照，这也是这一类产品其余成员应达到的标准。服用它的理由是这个结果，同时要接受随之而来的剂量和配方限定。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Acquired by colonisation; not synthesised by host tissue. Taxonomy: Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum by whole-genome core-genome phylogeny, revised from the earlier subsp. infantis assignment.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。通过定植获得，宿主组织不合成。分类学：按全基因组核心基因组系统发生分析为 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum，由早先的 subsp. infantis 归类修订而来。

The 1 x 10^6 dose did not separate from placebo, and the authors reported significant formulation problems at 1 x 10^ ...
still_matters_when_zh: 缓解 IBS 症状，依据是一项纳入 362 名初级医疗 IBS 女性患者的随机试验：1 x 10^8 cfu/mL 在腹痛和复合症状评分上显著优于安慰剂，总体评估上超出安慰剂 20 percent 以上 (P<0.02)。1 x 10^6 剂量与安慰剂无区别，而作者报告 1 x 10^10 存在明显的配方问题，所以高剂量的阴性结果反映的是产品本身，并非真正的倒 U 型剂量反应。效应依赖持续服用。

endogenous_note: These are plant materials, mainly yohimbe bark, Epimedium, maca and Tribulus, so nothing in them is endogenous and the synthesis axis cannot screen them at all. The screening question that does discriminate is adulteration: analytical surveys of herbal sexual enhancers repeatedly recover undeclared synthetic PDE5 inhibitors, including sildenafil and tadalafil and unlicensed structural analogues. That makes an unregulated capsule an undisclosed prescription drug, with the nitrate interaction and cardiac risk that go with it.
endogenous_note_zh: 这类产品是植物材料，主要是 yohimbe 皮、Epimedium、maca 和 Tribulus，其中没有任何内源成分，合成判据完全无法筛查它们。真正有区分力的筛查问题是掺假：对草药性功能产品的分析调查反复检出未申报的合成 PDE5 抑制剂，包括 sildenafil、tadalafil 以及未获批的结构类似物。这使一粒不受监管的胶囊变成未披露的处方药，并带来相应的硝酸酯类相互作用和心脏风险。
pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant alkaloid, prenylflavonoid and saponin pathways; no human synthesis of yohimbine, icariin or the declared or undeclared PDE5 inhibitors.
pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。植物生物碱、异戊烯基黄酮和皂苷途径；人体不合成 yohimbine、icariin，也不合成申报或未申报的 PDE5 抑制剂。

still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on documented adulteration with undeclared PDE5 inhibitors and their analogues, contraindication with nitrates and alpha-blockers, yohimbine's pressor and anxiogenic effects, and the fact that erectile dysfunction is a cardiovascular warning sign that warrants clinical assessment.
still_matters_when_zh: 这条判据上没有适用情形。改为筛查已记录的未申报 PDE5 抑制剂及其类似物掺假、与硝酸酯类和 alpha 受体阻滞剂的禁忌、yohimbine 的升压和致焦虑作用，以及勃起功能障碍本身是心血管警示信号，需要临床评估。
source: PMID 27338710 (Skalicka-Wozniak K, Food Chem Toxicol 2017;108:355-64, Adulteration of herbal sexual enhancers and slimmers)

endogenous_note: Niacin is the case in this set with a real conversion ratio to compute. The body makes niacin equivalents from tryptophan along the kynurenine pathway at roughly 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent, so 1 g of dietary tryptophan yields about 16.7 mg NE, close to the 16 mg NE/day RDA for men. Conversion needs riboflavin, vitamin B6 and iron for the pathway enzymes, which is why pellagra appears where maize-based diets bind niacin and protein quality is poor, and in Hartnup disease and carcinoid where tryptophan is lost or diverted.

endogenous_note: This is the cleanest quantitative conditional case in the supplement space. Humans cannot build the omega-3 backbone at all, because no human desaturase places a double bond at the n-3 position, so alpha-linolenic acid (ALA, 18:3n-3) is strictly essential and dietary. What humans can do is elongate and desaturate ALA to EPA and DHA, and that conversion is poor: roughly 5 to 8 percent of ALA reaches EPA and under 0.5 to 4 percent reaches DHA, higher in women because oestrogen upregulates the pathway, lower when linoleic acid intake is high because both series compete for the same FADS2 and FADS1 enzymes. So the pa ...

Glucosamine is an intermediate of the hexosamine pathway made in every cell from fructose-6-phosphate and glutamine, and oral dosing reaches synovial fluid at low micromolar levels, which fits the negative independent osteoarthritis trials. endogenous_note: Three conditionally essential compounds: the body makes them, and named states make that synthesis insufficient. Taurine is made in liver from cysteine, but human cysteine sulfinic acid decarboxylase activity is low compared with rodents, which is why taurine is treated as conditionally essential in preterm infants, in long-term parenteral nutrition and in some hepatic disease. Arginine is made through the intestinal-renal axis, where enterocytes produce citrulline and the kidney converts it to arginine, and it becomes limiting in trauma, sepsis, burns, rapid growth and renal failure. endogenous_note: NAD+ is made continuously in every cell, mostly by salvage from nicotinamide, with de novo synthesis from tryptophan and the Preiss-Handler route from nicotinic acid as the other inputs. Nobody on a normal diet lacks NAD+ precursors; the deficiency state is pellagra and it requires a severely restricted diet. NR and NMN do raise blood NAD+ in human trials, so the axis is not a veto, and the open question is whether raised NAD+ changes any clinical outcome, which trials so far have not shown. Oral NMN is also largely dephosphorylated to NR before absorption, so the two products converge.
endogenous_note_zh: NAD+ 在每个细胞内持续合成，主要靠从 nicotinamide 的补救途径，另外还有由色氨酸的从头合成和由 nicotinic acid 的 Preiss-Handler 路线。正常饮食的人不会缺 NAD+ 前体；其缺乏状态是 pellagra，需要极度受限的饮食才会出现。NR 和 NMN 在人体试验中确实提高血中 NAD+，所以这条判据不构成否决，未决的问题是提高 NAD+ 是否改变任何临床结局，目前试验尚未显示。口服 NMN 在吸收前大部分被去磷酸化为 NR，因此两种产品实际趋同。

still_matters_when_zh: Pellagra 和极度受限的饮食，此时治疗用烟酸或 nicotinamide，价格也便宜。除此之外，NAD+ 前体属实验性干预：试验证实血中 NAD+ 上升，但没有显示一致的功能获益。克级剂量的 nicotinic acid 仍是有自身作用谱的调脂药，而 nicotinamide 500 mg 每天两次在皮肤癌化学预防方面有独立的试验支持。
source: Bogan KL & Brenner C, Annu Rev Nutr 2008;28:115-30, Nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and nicotinamide riboside; Trammell SA et al., Nat Commun 2016;7:12948, Nicoti ...

endogenous_note: DHEA and DHEA-sulfate are made by the adrenal zona reticularis and are the most abundant circulating steroids in a young adult, so the pool is entirely endogenous. Two features make a conditional case real: output rises at adrenarche, peaks in the twenties and falls by roughly 70 to 80 percent by age 70 to 80, and it collapses in adrenal insufficiency. Because DHEA is a prohormone that peripheral tissues convert to testosterone and oestradiol, a supplement dose is an androgen and oestrogen dose with the corresponding effects, which is why it is banned in sport and prescription-only in several countries.
endogenous_note_zh: DHEA 和 DHEA 硫酸盐由肾上腺网状带合成，是年轻成年人循环中含量最高的类固醇，因此这一储备完全是内源的。两个特征使条件性情形真实存在：产量在肾上腺功能初现期上升，二十多岁达峰，到 70 至 80 岁下降约 70 到 80 percent；在肾上腺皮质功能不足时则骤降。由于 DHEA 是前激素，外周组织会把它转成睾酮和雌二醇，所以一剂补充剂等于一剂雄激素和雌激素，并带来相应作用，这也是它在体育运动中被禁用、在若干国家仅凭处方供应的原因。
pathway: Cholesterol to pregnenolone by CYP11A1 in adrenal mitochondria, then 17-alpha-hydroxylation and the 17,20-lyase activity of CYP17A1 (favoured by cytochrome b5 in the zona reticularis) to DHEA, then sulfation by SULT2A1 to DHEA-S, the circulating reservoir. Peripheral tissues run intracrine conversion by steroid sulfatase, 3-beta-HSD, 17-b ...
pathway_zh: 胆固醇在肾上腺线粒体内由 CYP11A1 生成 pregnenolone，再经 CYP17A1 的 17-alpha 羟化和 17,20 裂解活性 (网状带中由 cytochrome b5 促进裂解一侧) 生成 DHEA，随后由 SULT2A1 硫酸化为 DHEA-S，即循环储备形式。外周组织通过 steroid sulfatase、3-beta-HSD、17-beta-HSD 和芳香化酶进行胞内转化，生成睾酮和雌二醇；网状带中 3-beta-HSD 表达低，正是 DHEA  ...
daily_amount: Adrenal DHEA and DHEA-S production is on the order of several to tens of milligrams per day in young adults, with DHEA-S circulating in the micromolar range, orders of magnitude above testosterone, and falling steeply wi ...
daily_amount_zh: 年轻成年人肾上腺 DHEA 和 DHEA-S 的产量在每天数毫克到数十毫克量级，DHEA-S 血中浓度为微摩尔级，比睾酮高出几个数量级，并随年龄陡降。在没有原始来源的情况下此处不给出精确产率；血清 DHEA-S 随年龄变化的梯度是记录更充分的锚点。
still_matters_when: Adrenal insufficiency, including hypopituitarism, where replacement has trial support for wellbeing and androgen status in women, and severe androgen deficiency in women after adrenalectomy. Studied for age-related decline and for ovarian response in assisted reproduction with inconsistent results. Otherwise treat it as an unmonitored androgen and oestrogen precursor: contraindicated in hormone-se ...
still_matters_when_zh: 肾上腺皮质功能不足 (包括垂体功能低下)，此时替代治疗在女性的健康感受和雄激素状态方面有试验支持；肾上腺切除后女性的重度雄激素缺乏也适用。用于年龄相关下降和辅助生殖中的卵巢反应已有研究，结果不一致。其他情况下应把它当作未受监测的雄激素和雌激素前体：激素敏感性肿瘤为禁忌，涉及兴奋剂问题，也是激素检测结果异常的常见原因。
source: Arlt W et al., N Engl J Med 1999;341:1013-20, Dehydroepiandrosterone replacement in women with adrenal insufficiency; Labrie F et al., J Steroid Biochem Mol Bio ...

endogenous_note: Both molecules are built by the body from small precursors, and neither is absorbed intact in any meaningful quantity. Collagen is synthesised by fibroblasts, chondrocytes and osteoblasts from ordinary amino acids, with vitamin C-dependent prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases doing the modifications that stabilise the triple helix; ingested collagen is digested to amino acids and small peptides, and the mechanistic claim rests on specific di- and tripeptides such as prolyl-hydroxyproline surviving digestion and acting as signals, which is plausible and unsettled. Hyaluronic acid is made at the plasma membrane by HAS1, H ...
endogenous_note_zh: 这两种分子都由人体用小分子前体自行构建，且都不会以完整形式被显著吸收。胶原由成纤维细胞、软骨细胞和成骨细胞用普通氨基酸合成，依赖维生素 C 的脯氨酰羟化酶和赖氨酰羟化酶完成使三螺旋稳定的修饰；摄入的胶原被消化为氨基酸和小肽，机制层面的说法依赖 prolyl-hydroxyproline 一类二肽三肽经消化后残存并起信号作用，这有可能但尚未定论。透明质酸由细胞膜上的 HAS1、HAS2 和 HAS3 合成，70 kg 成年人体内约有 15 g，其中约三分之一每天更新，因此内源通量为每天克级，而胶囊只有几十毫克。两者都不构成替代，所以论据全部落在试验上，而这些试验多为小样本且常由厂家资助。

daily_amount: Collagen synthesis: NOT ESTABLISHED as a single daily figure, though collagen is roughly 30 percent of total body protein and skin and bone turnover proceed continuously. Hyaluronic acid: total body content about 15 g in ...
daily_amount_zh: 胶原合成：单一每日数值 NOT ESTABLISHED，但胶原约占全身蛋白质的 30 percent，皮肤和骨的周转持续进行。透明质酸：70 kg 成年人全身含量约 15 g，其中约三分之一每天被降解并重新合成，因此内源产量约为每天 5 g，而常见口服剂量为 80 到 200 mg/day。
still_matters_when: Almost nothing on this axis for a well-nourished person, since amino acid supply is rarely limiting; vitamin C status is the input that genuinely gates collagen synthesis. Protein-restricted or scorbutic states and healing wounds with high protein demand are the real deficits, and total protein intake plus vitamin C addresses them. If a collagen peptide product is used, judge it on the specific hy ...
still_matters_when_zh: 对营养良好的人来说这条判据几乎没有适用情形，因为氨基酸供应很少成为限制因素；真正制约胶原合成的输入是维生素 C 状态。真实的缺口是蛋白质受限或坏血病状态，以及蛋白质需求高的创面愈合，处理办法是总蛋白摄入加维生素 C。若使用胶原肽产品，应按试验用过的具体水解物和剂量判断 (皮肤和关节终点常用 2.5 到 10 g/day)，并看这些试验的独立性。
